**Description**


Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

  

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainable. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

 **Your greatest work is ahead!**

  

Leidos’ Defense Systems Electrical Systems department is seeking a talented **Embedded Firmware Developer** to join our team. The **Electrical Systems Department** is a design\-focused group of engineers specializing in advanced hardware\-based products. The individual selected for this position will be an embedded design engineer with varied technical interests and demonstrated engineering and leadership skills. The individual must be a self\- starter with experience working with inter\-disciplinary teams to solve challenging technical problems. The engineer will lead efforts on and develop architectures for embedded systems integrated into a diverse range of aerospace and military systems including manned/unmanned ground/air vehicles, missiles, defensive radars, and space systems.

  

The selected candidate will be a key technical leader in a fast\-paced, environment through all phases of the product life cycle from concept development and detailed design through manufacturing, qualification testing, and post\-delivery support. Additional skills such as communications data\-link design, digital\-signal processing (DSP) design, system design, experience with technical trade studies, and evaluation of technology improvements are a plus.

jobs.title: Rust Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who Are We?**


At Parry Labs we believe the modern combat advantage relies on the speed and scale of open systems. We’re redefining the edge of the ever\-changing and increasingly ever\-changing battlespace by delivering game changing capabilities to our warfighters through digital engineering, software, and hardware solutions that are essential to our core of being a Digital Systems Integrator.


Born digital and agile, Parry Labs is building a winning team to be the premier provider for Next Generation Mission Systems Integration across air, land, sea, space and cyber.


Are you ready to be an instrumental part of experts in the industry? Join us in the innovation of integration at Parry and apply to help develop the technologies of tomorrow while reaching new heights in your career today.

**About the Job**


You will build and test Rust software for distributed mission systems under senior engineer guidance. You will develop defined components, investigate defects and learn systems programming through code reviews and integration work. You will report to a functional software engineering manager, with technical direction from the Chief Engineer.


The target start is November 2026\.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Implement defined Rust components and fixes from agreed requirements with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write unit and integration tests for expected behavior, error handling and boundary conditions.
* Debug software issues using logs, tests and development tools. Document steps to reproduce defects.
* Build simple interfaces, message handling and telemetry features using established team designs.
* Use Cargo, Git and automated checks to build, test and submit changes for review.
* Participate in code reviews and apply feedback on correctness, readability and memory safety.
* Support laboratory integration and test activities with software, systems and security engineers.
* Maintain setup instructions and component documentation. Communicate progress and raise technical blockers early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field, or equivalent training and practical experience.
* Hands\-on programming experience through coursework, internships, personal projects or employment. Prior full\-time engineering experience is not required.
* Working knowledge of Rust ownership, borrowing, basic types and error handling, plus Cargo build and test workflows.
* Understanding of basic data structures, functions and software testing. Ability to explain and debug your own code.
* Familiarity with Linux development tools and Git version control.
* Ability to work from defined requirements, ask focused questions and incorporate code\-review feedback.
* U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust coursework, internship work, open\-source contributions or a personal project with automated tests.
* Exposure to network programming, asynchronous code or concurrency.
* Experience with C/C\+\+, Python, embedded devices or hardware interfaces.
* Familiarity with continuous integration, distributed systems or positioning, navigation and timing (PNT).

**Why Join Parry Labs?**
At Parry Labs, we foster a culture of curiosity and collaboration. Employees are given the autonomy to leverage their skills in creating state\-of\-the\-art tech solutions that aid in the protection of the American Warfighter. We encourage new and bold ideas that push the status quo. It is this entrepreneurial spirit that drives us.  

Parry Labs will support you with workplace flexibility, a commitment to the health and well\-being of you and your family and provide opportunities to work with a purpose. We are committed to supporting your success in both your professional and personal lives with benefits such as education assistance and unlimited paid time off, just to name a few. **No One Has Time for Long Job Applications!**
We completely understand, that is why we have made the application process easy. We promise. This will be simple. **Accessibility/Accommodation:**
If because of a medical condition or disability you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an e\-mail to HR@parrylabs.com or call (256\) 682\-7145 to let us know the nature of your request and contact information.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R-EGI Program
jobs.description:
**Senior Embedded Software Engineer — R\-EGI Program**

  


**Position Overview**


IS4S is seeking a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to develop, integrate, and test software for the R\-EGI program. R\-EGI brings together GPS/GNSS, inertial sensors, and other navigation capabilities to support resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) for military aircraft.


This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable developing C/C\+\+ software on embedded Linux systems, bringing up software on hardware, and solving problems at the boundary between software, sensors, and avionics. The engineer will work closely with systems, navigation, hardware, and test teams through integration and qualification.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ software for navigation processing, device interfaces, middleware, and system control.
* Develop and debug software on embedded Linux platforms, including interactions with device drivers, operating system services, and hardware interfaces.
* Integrate GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, and other navigation inputs; work with navigation engineers to implement and evaluate sensor\-fusion and estimation functions.
* Diagnose system\-level issues involving software timing, sensor data, electrical interfaces, and hardware behavior.
* Support hardware bring\-up and software integration in laboratory and system integration lab environments.
* Develop automated tests, diagnostic tools, and scripts that improve software integration, regression testing, and troubleshooting.
* Support simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, including evaluation of performance when GPS is degraded or unavailable.
* Translate system and interface requirements into software designs, test procedures, and verification evidence.
* Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect resolution, and software releases.
* Support technical reviews and program milestones, including PDR, CDR, TRR, and qualification activities.
* Mentor less experienced engineers and help the team resolve complex embedded software issues.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* 8 or more years of embedded software engineering experience.
* Strong C and C\+\+ proficiency for embedded or real\-time applications.
* Hands\-on experience developing, integrating, and debugging software on embedded Linux systems.
* Experience working with hardware interfaces, device drivers, or low\-level software and diagnosing hardware/software integration issues.
* Experience using laboratory tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or debuggers to troubleshoot embedded systems.
* Experience with software requirements, interface definitions, verification, and configuration management.
* Experience with Git, cross\-compilation toolchains, and automated builds.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with military aviation PNT systems, GPS/GNSS receivers, IMUs, inertial navigation systems, or integrated GPS/INS solutions.
* Experience with navigation estimation, Kalman filtering, sensor fusion, or operation in GPS\-degraded and GPS\-denied environments.
* Experience with aircraft avionics interfaces such as MIL\-STD\-1553 or ARINC 429\.
* Experience developing and integrating systems that use modern embedded processing platforms, such as the AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale\+ MPSoC.
* Experience with real\-time Linux, VxWorks, INTEGRITY, or another real\-time operating system.
* Experience with software\-in\-the\-loop or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and system integration labs.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation, data analysis, or diagnostic tools.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, interface diagrams, and hardware documentation.
* Experience supporting formal software qualification or airworthiness activities.
* Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.


**Benefits**


Competitive salary with comprehensive health and wellness benefits


Dynamic and collaborative work environment


Employee ownership


Medical, dental, and vision care plans


Paid time\-off and parental leave programs


Group term life insurance


401(k) retirement plan


Tuition Assistance, Training, and education development offerings

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join BAE Systems' Infrastructure Management Center (IMC) and help shape National Security. We are seeking a motivated Systems Engineer to join our dynamic, cross\-functional team. In this role, you will support the planning, design, and integration of complex technical challenges that support critical national security missions, including nuclear missions, production facilities, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and ammunition plant infrastructure.
  

This is an ideal role for an early\-career engineer looking to grow within a matrix\-type organization. You will have the opportunity to collaborate across multiple departments, leveraging digital engineering tools and Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) practices to deliver cutting\-edge solutions for the warfighter.
  

  

The Role
  

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to the systems integration and analysis of hardware and software systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:
* Systems Integration: Assist in the integration and analysis of military hardware and software systems/processes (or commercial equivalents).
* Technical Analysis: Support the design and analytical efforts required to optimize the management of critical infrastructure programs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work within a multi\-disciplinary team of engineers and program managers to understand customer requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Digital Tool Utilization: Utilize project management software and digital engineering tools, (CAMEO, DOORS, Etc…).
* Documentation: Assist in the creation of technical documentation, system specifications, and reports to ensure program milestones are met.
* Process Improvement: Support the implementation of Agile methodologies and continuous process improvement initiatives within the IMC.
* Requirements Management: Manage the full requirements lifecycle, including the derivation, analysis, and development of comprehensive technical requirements documents to ensure alignment between stakeholder needs and system design.
  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, or related STEM field (e.g., Mathematics, Physics).
* 2 yrs technical experience 0yrs with MS) with an emphasis in Systems engineering
* Technical Aptitude: Fundamental understanding of systems design, integration, and analytical efforts.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with team members, stakeholders, and customers in a professional environment.
* Secret Security Clearance
  

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Familiarity with Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or other digital engineering tools
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and their application in a technical environment.
* Ability to obtain Top Secret.
* Any foundational certifications in Systems Engineering or Project Management.
  

  

  

**Pay Information**
  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $107359 \- $182510
  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  

  

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  

  

  

  

**About BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security**  

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
  

  

Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
  

  

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

jobs.description:
COLSA Corporation is seeking a **Lead Software Engineer / Product Owner** to support the U.S. Army's Threat Systems Management Office (TSMO). This position will design, develop, integrate, test, and troubleshoot software solutions involving the Team Awareness Kit (TAK), including the integration of clients, servers, data pipelines, and other systems to deliver capabilities that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.



Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential functions)



* Design and orchestrate systems of systems, including clients, servers, data pipelines, and other integrated components.
* Design, develop, test, and implement software programs using Java, C\+\+, Python, React, Go, or similar technologies.
* Support software development and delivery using Jira and Kanban\-based continuous flow processes.
* Set up and maintain development environments for Windows and Linux, including containerized environments.
* Perform merge request and pull request reviews to support software quality assurance.
* Develop and implement user\-friendly interface requirements for software clients.
* Collaborate with team members and end users to analyze requirements, troubleshoot software issues, and deliver solutions that meet end\-user and government customer requirements.
* Perform systems modeling, simulation, and analysis.
* Perform data analysis and provide input for reports and dashboards, as needed.
* Develop or oversee user training, troubleshooting materials, and step\-by\-step guides.
* Advise hardware design engineers on system characteristics that may affect software systems, as needed.
* Provide input for documentation of new and existing software programs, as needed.


*At COLSA, people are our most valuable resource and centered at our core value. We invite you to unite your talents with opportunity and be a part of our “Family of Professionals!” Learn about our employee\-centric culture and benefits here:* *https://www.colsa.com/culture\_benefits*

  

  

Required Experience  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Minimum of 8\-12 years of related experience.
* Hands\-on experience supporting systems integration efforts.
* Experience configuring and maintaining development environments, including Git\-based version control, Linux operating systems, and Docker containerization.
* Experience with version control software and the Driessen branching model (Gitflow).
* Practical experience with front\-end application development, including the implementation of responsive, user\-focused interfaces.
* Experience designing, developing, and integrating custom interfaces, extensions, or plugins within existing software frameworks.
* Active Secret security clearance; U.S. Citizenship required.


**Preferred Qualifications**



* Previous experience leading software development teams.
* Experience with web development technologies such as React, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP) experience using Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Computer vision experience with object detection or gait recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and YOLO models.


Applicant selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. COLSA Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

* Experience in the development and design of electronic circuit designs, and/or multi\-assembly system/unit design

* Experience in taking design concepts from block diagram or requirements level to development of complete hardware designs, with verification via test and integration
* Experience with PCB design process and expertise with design tools (schematic capture) to analyze and simulate designs prior to hardware execution

i3 is seeking Software Engineers to join tour team in Huntsville, Alabama. You will help design, develop, integrate, test, and sustain mission‑critical command and control (C2\) software used by our warfighters and customers around the world.  

In this role, you will support Agile Software Teams, working closely with systems and test engineers to build robust, secure, and scalable software solutions that address complex logical and mathematical challenges in support of Global C2 missions. This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands‑on development, solving complex technical problems, and collaborating in a highly integrated, Agile environment.
Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, document, test, and debug applications and software systems that implement logical and mathematical solutions that are aligned with program objectives.
* Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Scrum teams to develop and maintain software products across multiple software baselines for the IBCS program.
* Work in a fast\-paced environment with high expectations, diverse assignments, and collaborative team settings across all levels of the organization.
* Perform software development and upgrades in multiple programming languages/versions while minimizing changes to the operational behavior of tactical software.
* Support documentation creation and updates using Markdown and other collaboration tools.
* Support testing activities including unit and functional testing, code coverage analysis, and static code analysis; contribute to continuous improvement of test effectiveness and automation.
* Other duties as assigned.

Education, Experience and Required skills:* This role can be filled at mulitple levels
	+ Associate Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 1 year of relevant experience
	+ Software Engineer\- Bachelor's degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant experience, Master's degree in STEM field and 0 years of relevant experience
* Strong object\-oriented software development experience with Java and C\+\+
* Proficiency in Linux\-based development and runtime environments.
* Experience with scripting languages and tools including Bash and Python.
* Experience with modern configuration management and source control tools (Git / GitLab).
* Experience with Agile SAFe and Atlassian Agile tools including Jira and Confluence.
* Active Secret Clearance and the ability to maintain a clearance required.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.


Preferred Qualifications:* Experience with Model‑Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including Cameo or similar tools.

**Position Highlights**
Steward Observatory is both a century\-old observatory on the University of Arizona campus and one of the University’s oldest research units. Founded in 1918, the Observatory brings together students, staff, faculty, engineers, and technicians to explore the universe and share discoveries through world\-class research, education, and outreach. With more than 180 professionals supporting advanced facilities, laboratories, and observatories, Steward Observatory offers a collaborative environment where technical expertise plays a critical role in advancing ground\- and space\-based astronomy.


The University of Arizona's Steward Observatory invites you to apply for the role of R\&D Software Engineer II. In this role, you will develop, maintain, and integrate software systems that support the fabrication and metrology of large\-scale astronomical telescope mirrors. Working collaboratively with scientists, engineers, technicians, and other software developers, you will apply software engineering principles to develop multidisciplinary solutions for new and existing mirror fabrication and testing projects.


You will support the full software lifecycle, including requirements definition, software design and development, integration, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, implementation, and ongoing maintenance. Software systems may span real\-time equipment control, data acquisition, data processing and analysis, graphical user interfaces, and web\-based applications.


Occasional travel to vendor, customer, or remote observatory sites may be required.

* Develop, maintain, and enhance software supporting optical metrology systems involving interferometry, deflectometry, laser tracking, scanning pentaprism testing, and other specialized measurement systems used to evaluate and characterize telescope mirrors.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer - II
jobs.description:
**IT Systems Engineer (Level II)**

**Job Summary**

CISO Global is seeking a skilled **IT Systems Engineer (Level II)** to join our Secure Managed Services team. This role supports a diverse portfolio of customer environments and requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, excellent customer communication, and the ability to take ownership of issues through resolution.

As an IT Systems Engineer, you will support and maintain both cloud\-based and traditional on\-premises customer environments, including desktops, laptops, servers, network infrastructure, Microsoft 365 services, mobile devices, and business applications.

This position serves as an escalation point for our Level I Service Desk team and is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving more complex technical issues, supporting multiple customer environments, collaborating with other technical teams, and continuing to grow their technical skills.

Success in this role requires more than technical ability. Our engineers regularly interact directly with customers and are expected to communicate professionally, build trust, take ownership of issues, and consistently provide a strong customer experience.

Successful candidates are proactive problem solvers who can manage multiple priorities, adapt quickly between different customer environments, communicate clearly, and remain accountable for seeing issues through to resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Escalation Support**

* Serve as an escalation point for technical issues that require support beyond the Level I Service Desk.
* Troubleshoot and resolve more complex desktop, server, Microsoft 365, networking, identity, and application\-related issues.
* Provide technical guidance to Service Desk team members when appropriate.
* Recognize when an issue requires escalation to Level III engineering resources and ensure proper documentation and handoff.

**Remote Monitoring and Management**

* Utilize Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools to proactively monitor, maintain, and support customer systems.
* Identify and remediate technical issues before they impact end users when possible.
* Assist with patching, system maintenance, software deployment, and endpoint health.

**Ticket Management**

* Manage and resolve technical incidents and service requests through the ticketing system.
* Maintain accurate documentation, detailed troubleshooting notes, and strong ticket hygiene.
* Communicate clearly and consistently with customers regarding issue status, expectations, and resolution.
* Take ownership of assigned issues and ensure appropriate follow\-through.

**End\-User Technical Support**

* Provide advanced troubleshooting for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, and end\-user applications.
* Support Windows, macOS, and Android environments.
* Diagnose operating system, application, hardware, connectivity, and user profile issues.

**Microsoft 365 and Cloud Administration**

* Administer and support Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and related services.
* Support user lifecycle management, licensing, mailbox administration, permissions, identity, and access control.
* Assist with endpoint management, security configuration, and device administration.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 applications and cloud service issues.

**Server and On\-Premises Infrastructure**

* Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments and traditional Active Directory domains.
* Support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File and Print Services, and domain controllers.
* Assist with server maintenance, patching, system health monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Support customers operating hybrid environments that combine on\-premises infrastructure with Microsoft cloud services.

**Networking**

* Troubleshoot network connectivity issues across customer environments.
* Support and diagnose issues involving DNS, DHCP, VPN connectivity, switches, firewalls, VLANs, wireless networks, and general network communication.
* Work with internal engineering resources and third\-party vendors when additional network support is required.

**Identity and Access Management**

* Administer user accounts, permissions, security groups, authentication, and access controls across Microsoft 365 and Active Directory environments.
* Assist with identity\-related troubleshooting and security configuration.

**Email and Security Support**

* Support enhanced email security solutions designed to protect customer environments from phishing, malicious email, and other threats.
* Assist with security\-related investigations, endpoint remediation, vulnerability remediation, and account security issues.
* Follow established security standards and escalation procedures.

**Deployment and Systems Administration**

* Deploy and configure desktops, laptops, applications, and related technology for new and existing users.
* Assist with workstation imaging, provisioning, software deployment, and device configuration.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activities across customer environments.

**Multi\-Customer Environment Support**

* Support multiple customer environments with varying technologies, configurations, policies, and business requirements.
* Transition effectively between customers and technical issues throughout the workday.
* Maintain professionalism and attention to detail while balancing multiple priorities.

**Qualifications**

**Experience**

* **3 years of professional IT support experience preferred.**
* Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting small to mid\-size business environments.
* Previous experience functioning as a technical escalation resource is preferred.

**Technical Proficiency**

Candidates should have hands\-on experience with several of the following areas:

* Windows desktop operating systems
* Windows Server
* Active Directory and Group Policy
* Microsoft

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Northrop Grumman Launch Systems Division is hiring a **Systems Engineer Level 6 – Program Engineering Lead**, located in Chandler, Arizona.

 **Role Overview:**


You will be responsible for engineering execution including the technical, cost, and schedule performance of engineering scope. You will collaborate with the engineering groups to understand and implement the program goals to support overall program success. You will work with your team leads to understand risks, drive technical solutions and identify and execute risk mitigation activities. You will monitor engineering performance (milestones, staffing, earned value) and lead variance analysis and recovery planning with Program Management and Business Management.


The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience interacting with diverse teams, communicating effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and operating successfully within both classified and unclassified environments.

 **What You’ll Get To Do:**


As the Program Engineering Lead, you will:

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
Software Engineer I : **APPLY at**: **https://virnous.com/careers/**

Department: Engineering

Reports to: Director of Engineering / Chief Technology Officer

Employment type: Full\-time

Level: Entry level (1 to 3 years of experience)

Position Summary

Virnous builds software for the people who work criminal cases: detectives, crime analysts, and prosecutors. Our main product, CANDOR, takes the raw data that shows up in a modern investigation, such as phone carrier records, cell site location information (CSLI), device extractions, and social media returns, and turns it into maps, timelines, and reports that an investigator can use and defend in court. We also build a public tip line, a training platform, and CANDOR Edge, a self\-contained version of CANDOR for agencies whose data can’t leave their building.

As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be working on real features and bug fixes from your first few weeks. Most of our code is Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, with a good amount of JavaScript on the front end. You’ll get code review, pairing, and plenty of room to ask questions. In return, we need you to be careful. The files our customers upload are evidence, and what our software shows them can end up in front of a jury. Getting it right matters more to us than getting it done fast.

Key Duties \& Responsibilities

Build and maintain features across CANDOR and our other Rails applications, from the database migration through the view, along with the tests that cover them. Write and improve the importers that read what investigators bring us: carrier call detail records, tower lists, spreadsheets, PDFs, and phone extraction reports. These files are often messy, and carriers change their formats without telling anyone**.\* Track down bugs reported by customers and our support team. Reproduce the problem, find the real cause, fix it, and add a test that would have caught it. Work on the front end with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus) and plain JavaScript, including maps, timelines, and charts that sometimes have to draw hundreds of thousands of records. Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline passing. Help move code from development to test to production, and keep an eye on it after it goes live. Work with our support staff and investigators, many of whom come from law enforcement, to learn how the software is used on real cases. Use AI coding tools as part of your daily work, and review what they produce as closely as you would review a teammate’s pull request**.\* Update documentation and runbooks when you change how something works.

What You’ll Work With

* Ruby 3\.x and Rails 8, with Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), import maps, and Solid Queue for background jobs. PostgreSQL, S3\-compatible object storage, and Apache Arrow for large datasets. JavaScript with D3, deck.gl, Google Maps, and Sigma.js for maps, charts, and link\-analysis graphs. Minitest and Capybara for application tests, and Playwright with TypeScript for end\-to\-end tests. Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and Ansible for builds and deployments. Self\-hosted language models (vLLM, Ollama, and LiteLLM) that run features like our Ask Sarge assistant.

Required Qualifications

* 1 to 3 years of professional experience building web applications. A strong internship or co\-op can count toward this. Working knowledge of a server\-side web framework. Rails is ideal, but if you know Django, Laravel, Express, or something similar, you can pick up Rails here. Comfortable writing SQL and working with a relational database, preferably PostgreSQL. Solid fundamentals in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Everyday comfort with Git: commits, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. The habit of writing tests as part of the work, not after it. A methodical approach to debugging: read the logs, form a theory, check it, and say so plainly when you don’t know yet. Clear writing. You’ll write tickets, commit messages, and explanations for people who aren’t engineers. Good judgment and discretion with sensitive information. Our customers trust us with active criminal case data. Ability to pass a criminal background check.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Ruby on Rails, especially Rails 7 or 8 and Hotwire. Experience with Docker. Exposure to Kubernetes, Jenkins, or another CI/CD system is a plus. Experience parsing and cleaning messy real\-world data in CSV, Excel, XML, JSON, or PDF form. Familiarity with geospatial data (coordinates, bearings, distance math) or with charting and mapping libraries like D3 or deck.gl. Curiosity about how large language models and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) work in practice. We run our own models in\-house. Any exposure to digital forensics, cellular networks, or the criminal justice system. It isn’t required. We’ll teach you the domain. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

*This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties may be modified at any time based on business needs.*

Pay: $60,742\.41 \- $106,872\.57 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Phoenix, AZ 85016

jobs.description:
**Please review the job details below.**
----------------------------------------

  

Lanteris Space is currently seeking a Sr. Embedded Flight Software Engineer to join our team in Palo Alto, CA or Houston, TX.

  

  

**Responsibilities** :


* Design and implement software for embedded Real\-time Operating Systems (RTOS).
* Develop, document, and maintain architectures, requirements, algorithms, interfaces, and designs for flight software systems
* Develop software verification plans, unit level and open loop test suites, and procedures, executing the test procedures and documenting test results to ensure that software systems requirements are met.
* Perform software product life cycle management.
* Develop, select, tailor, and deploy software processes, tools, and metrics.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for software domains, processes, and system\-specific issues.
  

  

**Basic Requirements:**


* Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
* Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or related field. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree.
* Minimum of 8 years of software development experience
* Embedded C\+\+ programming skills
* Basic understanding of Agile methodologies and the software development life cycle
* Software version control
  

  

**Preferred Requirements:**


* RTOS experience (ex. FreeRTOS)
* Familiar with NASA’s cFS/cFE
* Experience with SPI
* Development experience with Python
* Basic understanding of spacecraft subsystems: power, ADCS, thermal, propulsion, communications
* Familiar with Jira, Jama, Git, and Unit test tools

  

In support of pay transparency at Lanteris Space Systems, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings. The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job\-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.


 The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $124,000\.00 \- $206,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $124,000\.00 \- $206,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $124,000\.00 \- $206,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $137,000\.00 \- $228,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within California is: $143,000\.00 \- $238,000\.00 annually.
For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market\-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.  



  

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process.


Additionally, this position is incentive eligible with a target based on contribution, company performance, and/or individual results achieved; the specific incentive plan and target amount will be determined based on the role and breadth of contributions.
The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.

  

  

The date of posting can be found on the Lanteris Space Systems Career page at the top of each job posting.

  

  

To apply, submit your application via the Lanteris Space Systems Career page.

  

**Lanteris Space Systems values diversity in the workplace and is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Veridos provides secure and innovative identity solutions to governments worldwide. We help ensure every citizen has access to a trusted legal identity – enabling participation in society and access to essential services. From passports and ID cards to mobile IDs and border control systems, we deliver end\-to\-end identity solutions tailored to national needs. Join our multicultural workforce to create innovative solutions that make a worldwide impact.


As a joint venture of Giesecke\+Devrient, a global SecurityTech company and Bundesdruckerei, the German state printing service, we are always looking for talented and motivated colleagues who share our vision and want to shape the future of identities with us.



**Position Overview**We are looking for a Software Engineer to design, develop, and expand our SDK \& Demo App ecosystem across multi\-device and network environments. Our software layer supports our core identity document scanning hardware. This is an onsite position located in San Diego, CA. In this role, you will architect the core SDK \& Demo App, directly embedding image processing, advanced calibration algorithms, and data capture libraries (OCR \& Barcode) to maximize hardware performance and production. You will be responsible for delivering both the core APIs and Apps for B2B client integration interactive Demo, alongside internal Engineering Apps required for device optimization, hardware testing, and factory calibration. **Role Summary**


* Job Title: Software Engineer (PC/Embedded SDK \& Demo App Development)
* Department: R\&D Dept.
* Core Tech Stack: C\+\+, C\# / .NET, Windows/Linux Systems Programming, Embedded Systems, Image Processing (OpenCV), Network Programming (RESTful APIs, WebSockets)

**Key Responsibilities**Core SDK and Apps (Image \& Data Recognition Engine)


* Design, build, and maintain the core SDK framework and associated apps, supporting both external B2B client demo applications and internal engineering tools for hardware verification, calibration, and factory production.
* Develop and optimize low\-latency image pre\-processing pipelines (including image enhancement, auto\-cropping, and ROI extraction).
* Integrate and optimize third\-party libraries (e.g., OCR, barcode decoders) into the core SDK framework.
* Work closely with firmware engineers to define device\-level communication protocols and debug hardware interface issues (USB, Serial, PC/SC).

Multi\-Device \& Network Expansion


* Port and expand existing SDK, Demo App, and recognition libraries into cross\-platform, networked environments (Linux, Embedded Systems, Tablets, and Edge devices).
* Consider future network scalability when defining core communication architectures. (e.g., RESTful APIs, WebSockets)

Technical Documentation \& Support


* Write clean English technical documentation and API references for global B2B clients.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**Education:


* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Image Processing, or a related technical discipline.

Experience \& Mindset


* 3–5\+ years of professional experience in software development with a strong focus on C\+\+ , C\#/ .NET.
* A proven self\-starter who demonstrates high autonomy and takes clear ownership of assigned tasks.

Image Processing:


* Solid hands\-on experience utilizing computer vision libraries (e.g., OpenCV) for raw sensor data, camera calibration, or frame\-level manipulation.

Communication Skills:


* Proven ability to write clean English technical documentation and communicate effectively with global technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience integrating and optimizing OCR technologies or 1D/2D Barcode decoding libraries (e.g., processing PDF417, QR codes) within an SDK environment.
* Embedded, Mobile \& Network OS Expertise: Experience with Linux systems programming, Android/Tablet integration, or building SDK \& Demo Apps for resource\-constrained embedded industrial devices.
* Experience with cross\-platform tools such as CMake, Qt, or multi\-OS packaging tools for SDK \& Demo App distribution.
* Experience interfacing software with hardware devices via USB, serial or PC/SC protocols, with a history of collaborating with firmware.

The pay range for this position is $ 135,815\-$141,130 per year. Benefits offered to eligible employees include, medical (PPO and HDHP with HSA), dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K w/ employer match, short/long term disability, life insurance, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending, EAP, commuter benefits, education assistance, pet insurance, legal, and more.

jobs.title: Staff Digital Key Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.


* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: Hybrid

  
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

  

  

Ford’s Electric Vehicles, Digital and Design (EVDD) team is charged with delivering the company’s vision of a fully electric transportation future. EVDD is customer\-obsessed, entrepreneurial, and data\-driven and is dedicated to delivering industry\-leading customer experience for electric vehicle buyers and owners. You’ll join an agile team of doers pioneering our EV future by working collaboratively, staying focused on only what matters, and delivering excellence day in and day out. Join us to make positive change by helping build a better world where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.


In this position...


Ford's Advanced EV and Software organization is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to take full functional ownership of the vehicle access authentication path and the customer\-facing vehicle functions built on top of it. This is the software that every single customer access event passes through — transaction authorization, lock/unlock, start authorization, and remote functions — spanning Digital Key and Key Card credentials. You will help drive this stack from architecture through vehicle bring\-up and post\-launch support, working with wireless and embedded technologies including Bluetooth, UWB, NFC, and RF connectivity.


What you'll do...


* Own implementation of one or more components of the vehicle access authentication path, including transaction authorization, lock/unlock, start authorization, and/or remote functions across Digital Key and Key Card.

• Architect and develop embedded software for Vehicle Access systems running on ECUs and real\-time embedded platforms.
  

• Design, implement, and maintain Digital Key functionality based on Car Connectivity Consortium (CCC) standards, alongside Key Card authentication flows.
  

• Develop software supporting vehicle access features utilizing Bluetooth, Ultra\-Wideband (UWB), NFC, and RF communication technologies.
  

• Lead collaboration with systems, hardware, validation, cybersecurity, and mobile application teams to deliver end\-to\-end vehicle access and vehicle function solutions.
  

• Write and enhance embedded software in C, leveraging Python for automation, testing, and validation activities.
  

• Define software architecture, interfaces, and communication frameworks between vehicle systems, key credentials (Digital Key and Key Card), and external devices.
  

• Support vehicle integration, debugging, and bring\-up activities on prototype and production vehicles.
  

• Diagnose complex software, connectivity, and RF\-related issues across vehicle and mobile ecosystems.
  

• Use AI\-assisted development tools (such as VS Code with GitHub Copilot or other Ford\-approved AI coding assistants) to accelerate coding, code review, debugging, documentation, and test\-case generation, while critically validating all AI\-suggested code against automotive safety, security, and coding standards (e.g., MISRA).
You'll have...


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

• 8\+ years of professional experience developing embedded software.
  

• Strong proficiency in Embedded C programming.
  

• Strong Python scripting and automation experience.
  

• Hands\-on experience with complex embedded software projects, such as Vehicle Access systems, Digital Key, or Key Card technologies.
  

• Experience working with complex industry standards, e.g., Car Connectivity Consortium (CCC) standards.
  

• Understanding of Bluetooth, UWB, NFC, RF communication, and wireless connectivity architectures.
  

• Experience developing software for automotive ECUs and embedded real\-time systems.
  

• Demonstrated ability to own a system end\-to\-end, from architecture through post\-launch support, with minimal supervision.
  

• Practical experience using modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., VS Code Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to improve coding efficiency, accelerate debugging, and support test/documentation generation, paired with sound judgment on responsible use of AI\-generated output.
Even better, you may have...


* Automotive experience implementing CCC Digital Key vehicle access technology, and/or Key Card authentication systems.

• Experience developing software for Body Control Modules (BCM) or Vehicle Access ECUs.
  

• Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts related to vehicle access, transaction authorization, and secure authentication.
  

• Familiarity with CAN, Automotive Ethernet, diagnostics, and vehicle communication protocols.
  

• Experience with vehicle integration, validation, and launch activities.
  

• Understanding of embedded Linux and RTOS\-based systems.
  

• Familiarity with ISO 26262, ASPICE, MISRA, or automotive software development processes.
  

• Experience establishing or contributing to team guidelines for the safe and efficient use of AI coding assistants in safety\-critical or regulated software environments.
You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: R&D Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Mechatronics Engineer (R\&D)**


**Compensation:** $90,000–$154,000 annually  

**Equity:** Included  

**Location:** El Segundo, CA  

**Work Policy:** Onsite  

**Level:** L1–L2 and L3  

**Hiring Count:** 2 — one L1–L2 and one L3  

**Core KPIs:** Equipment reliability, process observability, consistency, scalability, throughput, and successful validation and handoff of assigned development workstreams.


**Who we are**
--------------



Rangeview is on a mission to build the foundry system that reindustrializes America. We exist to break the legacy manufacturing trap by reinventing critical production for the twenty\-first century. Through advanced software, deep automation, breakthroughs in materials science, and modern financing strategies, Rangeview rewrites both the cost curve and the power structure of making metal parts.



As a Mechatronics Engineer, you will develop the equipment, software, controls, and workflows that enable Rangeview's R\&D group to develop novel manufacturing technologies.



Your scope is the full manufacturing chain: printing, thermal processing, handling and post\-processing, together with the instrumentation and data infrastructure that makes equipment and process state observable.



This is a highly hands\-on R\&D role. You will be expected to move fluidly between software, mechanical systems, electrical systems, optics, equipment integration, and experimental process development. You will work closely with materials scientists, process engineers, R\&D specialists, and technical leadership to rapidly prototype, test, modify, and mature new manufacturing capabilities.


**What's in it for you**
------------------------



You will help Rangeview's R\&D group develop novel manufacturing technologies across the full manufacturing chain: printing, thermal processing, handling, and post\-processing. This is a highly hands\-on role where you will work across software, mechanical systems, electrical systems, optics, equipment integration, and experimental process development.


**What you'll do**
------------------



As a Mechatronics Engineer, you will develop the equipment, software, controls, and workflows that enable Rangeview's R\&D group to develop novel manufacturing technologies.



Your scope includes the instrumentation and data infrastructure that makes equipment and process state observable. You will work closely with materials scientists, process engineers, R\&D specialists, and technical leadership to rapidly prototype, test, modify, and mature new manufacturing capabilities.


* Modify equipment hardware, software, motion systems, and controls to support experimental materials, new process capabilities, improved reliability, and higher throughput within scalability and production sustainment constraints.
* Develop and automate manufacturing, handling, post processing equipment, and monitoring equipment, translating material and process requirements into practical engineering systems.
* Design, select, integrate, commission, and improve commercial and custom equipment to increase process observability, consistency, reliability, scalability, and operator effectiveness.
* Develop and integrate the measurement systems the factory runs on, to support data acquisition and analysis.
* Troubleshoot equipment and software issues, identify root causes, and implement verified corrective actions.
* Work closely with process engineers and technical specialists to understand equipment\-process interactions and translate findings into improved methods.
* Support rapid expansion of Rangeview's equipment base, printers, furnaces, and post\-processing systems, including coordination and planning with Facilities and equipment manufacturers on infrastructure needed to support reliable equipment operation.
* Serve as the responsible engineer for assigned equipment and development workstreams, driving work from concept through implementation, validation, and handoff.

**What you'll need**
--------------------


* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, controls engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience developing, integrating, or modifying complex electromechanical systems.
* Demonstrated ability to work across mechanical, electrical, controls, and software interfaces.
* Experience with hands\-on prototyping, troubleshooting, equipment integration, or experimental development.
* Experience using CAD to design mechanical components, assemblies, fixtures, or equipment modifications.
* Experience programming or scripting for engineering applications, automation, data acquisition, or computational workflows.
* Strong ability to diagnose ambiguous technical problems, develop hypotheses, run structured tests, and implement practical solutions.
* Working knowledge of experimental design and applied statistics, sufficient to size a test, quantify uncertainty in a measured result, and draw well supported conclusions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience with additive manufacturing systems, particularly SLA, MSLA, or other photopolymer\-based printing technologies.
* Experience developing or modifying motion control systems, machine controls, PLCs, embedded systems, or industrial automation.
* Experience with computational geometry, slicing algorithms, toolpath generation, or platforms such as nTop.
* Experience with Python, MATLAB, C\+\+, or similar engineering and automation tools.
* Experience designing and commissioning custom manufacturing or laboratory equipment.
* Familiarity with machine vision, sensors, instrumentation, data acquisition, and closed\-loop control.
* Experience with ceramics, photopolymer resins, materials processing, investment casting, or other advanced ma

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Why RoboForce**



RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo\-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company's robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real\-world deployment and scalability.



We are seeking a Robotics Software Engineer to build the software that powers robot behavior in the real world. In this role, you will develop, integrate, and improve production\-grade robotics capabilities across autonomy, systems, and developer infrastructure. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to turn promising prototypes into reliable software that runs on deployed robots operating in complex outdoor environments.



This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing production code, debugging challenging real\-world problems, and seeing their work directly improve robot performance in the field.


**Responsibilities**


* **Robotics Software Development**: Design, implement, and maintain production software for real\-world robotic systems using C\+\+ and Python, with a focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* **System Integration**: Integrate and refine robotics capabilities across perception, planning, controls, teleoperation, and platform software to ensure robust behavior on physical robots.
* **Robustness \& Reliability Engineering**: Improve software quality through testing, validation, fault handling, performance tuning, and edge\-case analysis to make systems dependable in unstructured outdoor environments.
* **Debugging \& Root Cause Analysis**: Investigate complex failures across software, sensors, networking, timing, and hardware interfaces, and drive issues to resolution through disciplined technical analysis.
* **Tooling \& Infrastructure**: Build internal tools, scripts, and workflows that improve developer velocity, testing efficiency, observability, and release quality across the robotics software stack.
* **On\-Robot Validation**: Work directly with hardware to validate new features, evaluate system behavior, and iterate quickly between development and real\-world testing.


**Requirements**


* **Education:** B.S. or M.S. in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, or complex embedded systems, with a demonstrated track record of deploying **physical hardware products** into the field.
* **Programming Proficiency:** Strong command of both C\+\+ and Python, with the ability to read, debug, and write production\-level C\+\+ for core robot systems, alongside robust Python tooling.
* **Robotics Software Fundamentals**: Experience working with one or more core robotics domains such as perception, motion planning, controls, localization, state estimation, system integration, or robot behavior.
* **Linux Systems Expertise**: Strong comfort working in Linux development environments, including command\-line tools, debugging workflows, scripting, and system\-level troubleshooting.
* **Debugging Mindset**: Proven ability to diagnose and resolve problems that span software, hardware, sensors, and distributed system interactions.
* **Collaboration**: Requires 5 days/week in\-office collaboration with the team.


**Bonus Qualifications**


* **Outdoor Robotics Experience**: Background in autonomous driving, drones, mobile robotics, or other systems deployed in outdoor or unstructured environments.
* **Infrastructure Familiarity**: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD systems, or software release workflows for robotics platforms.
* **Developer Tooling**: Experience building tools for testing, simulation, telemetry, debugging, or log analysis.
* **Visualization \& Diagnostics**: Experience with robotics visualization and diagnostics tools such as Foxglove, Grafana, RViz, or custom internal interfaces.
* **Production Deployment Experience**: Experience taking robotics software from prototype to production and supporting reliability at fleet scale.


**Benefits**


* Competitive stock options/equity programs.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan.
* Visa sponsorship and green card support for qualified candidates.
* Lunches and dinners, a fully stocked kitchen, and regular team\-building events.

  



Compensation: Salary $165,000–$235,000 USD \+ Bonus \+ Equity

The base salary range above represents the expected compensation for this full\-time U.S. position. Final compensation will be determined based on role scope, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training, and may fall outside the listed range in exceptional cases.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
***Please Note:*** *To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.*

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out\-of\-the\-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross\-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands\-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward\-thinking individuals to join our team.  

CesiumAstro is seeking an experienced **Embedded Software Engineer II** with a strong background in embedded Linux development and the Yocto build system. This role is ideal for engineers with hands\-on experience in embedded systems, including device drivers, kernel customization, bootloaders, and board bring\-up, with a preference for experience with the Xilinx platform (experience with other platforms is also valued).

As a member of our software team, you will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, from product concept through production, participating in architecture design, implementation, testing, qualification, and in\-orbit support. This role involves working closely with hardware, systems, and FPGA engineers, and provides opportunities for technical leadership and cross\-disciplinary collaboration.
### **JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and port embedded Linux applications, device drivers, and libraries.
* Configure, customize, and integrate the Linux kernel and embedded bootloaders (e.g., U\-Boot).
* Maintain and evolve the Yocto\-based Linux build system within a CI/CD pipeline.
* Package and deploy software images for diverse embedded hardware platforms.
* Create tailored Linux distributions for specific embedded applications.
* Collaborate across disciplines (firmware, hardware, systems) to ensure seamless system integration and performance.
* Participate in design reviews and contribute to customer\-facing technical documentation and proposals.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 2\+ years of professional experience in embedded software development.
* Proficiency in C or C\+\+ for embedded systems.
* Experience developing and debugging software on embedded hardware (e.g., power systems, motors, sensors).
* Understanding of multi\-threaded programming and resource\-constrained environments.
* Familiarity with version control, issue tracking, and peer review workflows.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

### **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Practical experience with Embedded Linux and the Yocto Project.
* Experience with Xilinx SoCs or other microcontroller\-based systems.
* Proficiency with bootloaders, kernel development, and system bring\-up.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices in embedded environments.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full\-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.

CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

*Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Senior Thermal Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Thermal Systems Engineer**



Advantest Test Solutions, Inc. (ATS) is seeking a Senior Thermal Systems Engineer to serve as a thermal technical lead on our team in Lake Forest, CA. ATS is a leading provider of massively parallel electronic test systems, including System Level Test (SLT), burn\-in, and semiconductor/module testing. We offer an exciting portfolio of high\-performance test systems that support the semiconductor industry worldwide.



This individual will act as the thermal lead on assigned programs, taking ownership of technical decisions and drafting thermal requirements with minimal supervision. The role covers the full range of thermal and mechanical engineering functions related to the design, testing, and evaluation of thermal systems for electronic systems, including semiconductors, photonics, and embedded devices, from early concept through mass production. Responsibilities include directing thermal system design and validation, mentoring junior engineers, and serving as the primary technical point of contact for thermal scope on their programs.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the thermal lead on assigned programs, making independent technical decisions and drafting thermal system requirements.
* Own thermal system design and validation for liquid\-cooled and refrigerant\-based systems, from architecture through release.
* Lead thermal system design and validation across the full product lifecycle, including prototyping, design validation, and transition to mass production.
* Design and develop thermal components such as cold plates (liquid\-cooling and two\-phase), ceramic heaters, heat sinks, chillers, and condensing units.
* Design and support high power, high temperature active thermal control systems.
* Perform hands\-on thermal system testing and design validation to confirm designs meet specifications and performance requirements.
* Conduct thermal analyses to evaluate component and system\-level performance.
* Collaborate with and provide technical direction to design and development teams to integrate thermal solutions into product designs.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced engineers on the team.
* Optimize thermal designs to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance.
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation of designs, analyses, and testing results.
* Stay current with advancements in thermal management technologies and methodologies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to thermal design and performance.
* Work with procurement, manufacturing, quality assurance, and technical support teams to establish specifications, and assist in vendor/supplier selection for parts, materials, and assemblies.
* Provide hands\-on support during product installation and commissioning at customer sites, and guidance to the field service team.
* Identify risk areas and opportunities for optimization, and drive resolution of field issues in collaboration with the field team.
* Act as a technical point of contact for customers on thermal\-related issues for their programs.
* Conduct hands\-on evaluation of prototype and sub\-assembly builds, including thorough performance assessments.
* Perform additional duties as required.

Requirements:
**Requirements, Education \& Skills**


* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or Physics required; Master's degree preferred.
* 8\+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a demonstrated track record of leading thermal scope on programs independently, including drafting technical requirements and making design decisions with minimal oversight.
* Active thermal control experience in the semiconductor industry required.
* Expertise in thermal system design and validation for liquid\-cooled and refrigerant\-based systems.
* Proven experience across the end\-to\-end product lifecycle: prototyping, design validation, and mass production.
* Hands\-on capability performing thermal system testing and design validation.
* Deep knowledge of cold plates (liquid\-cooling, two\-phase), ceramic heaters, heat sinks, chillers, and condensing units.
* Experience with high power, high temperature active thermal control systems.
* Experience with PID control and tuning for closed\-loop thermal systems.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to lead technical decisions on ambiguous problems.
* Background in electronic packaging, testing, and integration of thermal systems into automated handling preferred.
* Experience working on cross\-functional teams building complex test systems involving motion control hardware, electrical, and software components is a plus.
* Familiarity with burn\-in ovens and active thermal control solutions for automotive\- or military\-grade devices is a plus.
* Experience with heaters, Peltiers, heatsinks, sockets, condensation abatement, and airflow uniformity is desirable.
* 3D design experience with SolidWorks preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 20% to customer sites.
* Strong analytical and synthesis capabilities.
* On\-site role in Lake Forest, CA.


**Additional Preferred Skills (not required)**


* Experience with thermal modeling and analysis tools (e.g., SolidWorks Flow, Ansys Icepak).
* Experience in the design, certification, and deployment of semiconductor capital equipment.
* Prior experience formally leading or technically directing a program team.

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer (Lead)
jobs.description:
**Overview**


Octavian Robotics is solving the \#1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives.


This company is a spin\-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know\-how. We are hiring the Cognizant Engineer (CogE) to own our flagship: a VLA\-powered (Vision\-Language\-Action) gripping and manipulation system for surgical instruments. You will lead this product from the rig on the bench to machines running inside hospital Sterile Processing Departments, and you will own its technical success end to end.


This is a hands\-on technical leadership seat. You will design the end\-effector and mechatronics, integrate vision and force and tactile sensing into a 6DOF arm, and operationalize learned manipulation policies (VLA models) so the system reliably grips, sorts, and handles surgical instruments in the real world. You work directly with the founders. Expect to learn a lot fast, hit days where nothing works, and ship a product that saves lives in a room full of people who appreciate you.

**What you will own**

* Own the VLA gripping and manipulation system cradle to grave: concept, design, build, bring\-up, deployment, and field reliability. You are accountable for its technical success.
* Design the gripper and mechatronics: end\-effector design, actuation, GD\&T drawings, mass, cost and manufacturability tradeoffs, rapid prototyping (3D print, laser, CNC, PCB), and production\-ready designs.
* Integrate perception and sensing into the manipulation loop: cameras and vision, force, torque and tactile feedback, and the 6DOF arm.
* Operationalize VLA and learned manipulation policies: stand up the data pipeline (teleop and demonstration collection), wire policy inference into real\-time control, evaluate grasp and handling success, and close the sim\-to\-real and on\-robot iteration loop.
* Optimize with modeling and test: analytical and physical simulation, then validate on hardware.
* Interface with suppliers to build supply chain and vendor qualification for manufacturing feasibility, validation, and assigned commodities; deliver world\-class fit, finish, and craftsmanship for launch.
* Support deployment: help assemble and install systems at hospital sites as needed. Travel is approximately 1 to 5 percent.

**Ideal candidate skills**

* B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Robotics (M.S. a plus).
* Real experience taking a robotic system from concept to delivery on an R\&D team.
* Manipulation and gripping experience: end\-effector or gripper design, grasping, pick\-and\-place, or assembly automation.
* 6DOF and cobot arm integration, including low\-level programming and motion control.
* Comfortable at the hardware and ML boundary: you do not have to train VLA models from scratch, but you can integrate learned policies, run inference on a robot, collect and curate demonstration data, and debug why a policy fails on real hardware. Familiarity with modern manipulation stacks (ROS or ROS 2, OpenVLA or pi\-0 style policies, RT\-style models, imitation learning, sim\-to\-real) is a strong plus.
* Strong Python; working knowledge of real\-time or embedded control.
* Fluent with prototyping tools: CAD, 3D printing, laser cutter, CNC, PCB.
* Takes initiative across whatever the company needs to win. Able to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

  

**Requirements**  

* B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or similar.
* Strong understanding of AI tools. We're looking for an "AI native" engineer.
* Technical depth in robotics, automation, or a related field; has shipped from concept to delivery.
* Demonstrated work on 6DOF or similar cobot arms.
* Working knowledge of Python or a similar language.
* Minimum 10 years of full\-time on the job experience.
* Bonus: hands\-on with manipulation or grasping, or with learned policies (VLA, imitation learning, ROS).
* Not currently enrolled in a college or graduate program.
* Free to work without visa sponsorship.
* On\-site in Van Nuys or Los Angeles (reliable commute or willing to relocate). Some travel to hospital sites will be required.

  

**Benefits**  

* $170,000 \- $190,000 per year full\-time salary.
* 401(k), health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave.
* Schedule: 12\-hour shift, Monday \- Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart.
* In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.
