jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
**Payabli** is the Intelligent Fintech Operating System for software platforms. If you are a software company, you are a fintech company, and Payabli is your operating system. Built by payments industry and SaaS veterans and powered by its own models, Payabli gives platforms everything they need to embed, manage, and monetize financial services through a single developer\-friendly API spanning Pay In, Pay Out, and Pay Ops. Intelligence is not a layer on top, it is the foundation, expressed through Amigo, Payabli's native AI Agent Suite, and a growing set of capabilities that make payment operations smarter and more autonomous.




**Payabli** gives software companies PayFac capabilities without the heavy lift, administrative burden, or cost of becoming a payment facilitator themselves. With PayFac\-as\-a\-Service, embedded payment acceptance and issuance, and intelligent payment operations, platforms turn payments into a meaningful revenue stream while staying focused on their core product.

**Payabli** is backed by world\-class fintech investors including QED Investors, Fika Ventures, TTV Capital, and Bling Capital, and was recently named to the Forbes Fintech 50\.


For more information, visit payabli.com.


**About the Role**


As a Senior Software Engineer, Platform at Payabli, you'll own the infrastructure and developer experience that every engineer at the company builds on top of. You won't be handed a task list—you'll define the vision for how we build, test, deploy, and operate our platform on AWS, then execute against it. From CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code to local development and Cloud/Agent development environments, you'll be the person who makes every other engineer faster, safer, and more productive.


This is a high\-ownership role. We're looking for someone who sees a gap, builds a plan, and drives it forward—not someone who waits to be told what's next.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own the infrastructure.** Design, build, and operate Payabli's cloud infrastructure. You'll make the architectural decisions around networking, compute, storage, and security that determine how our platform scales, performs, and stays resilient as transaction volume grows.

**Build the deployment backbone.** Own and evolve our CI/CD pipelines end\-to\-end. Every push to production should be fast, safe, and repeatable. You'll design the release process that lets engineers ship with confidence—automated testing, staged rollouts, rollback strategies, and deployment observability baked in.

**Make local development exceptional.** Engineers should be able to clone a repo and be productive in minutes, not days. You'll own the local development experience and make sure it mirrors production closely enough to catch real problems early.

**Enable AI\-assisted development.** As the team adopts AI coding agents and assistants, you'll build the environments that let engineers leverage these tools safely and effectively within a PCI\-compliant infrastructure.

**Define and drive the platform roadmap.** Assess where we are, define where we need to be, and build the plan to get there. You'll partner with engineering leadership to prioritize infrastructure investments and communicate the "why" behind them.

**Harden everything.** Infrastructure in payments means PCI\-DSS scoping, network segmentation, secrets management, access controls, and audit trails are your daily work. You'll ensure our infrastructure posture keeps pace with compliance requirements as we scale.

**Instrument and observe.** Build the monitoring, alerting, and observability stack that gives the team real\-time visibility into system health. When something goes wrong at 2 AM, the infrastructure should tell us what happened before we have to ask.

**Multiply the team.** Document patterns, write runbooks, and establish infrastructure standards that make the entire engineering organization more self\-sufficient. The best platform engineering is invisible—things just work.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Your skills and trajectory matter more than checking every box.

**5\+ years of professional infrastructure or platform engineering experience.** You've built and operated production AWS environments that serve real traffic at scale—not just spun up sandbox accounts.

**Deep AWS expertise.** You think natively in AWS services (ECS/EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform) and understand the trade\-offs between them. You've made architectural bets and lived with the consequences.

**Strong CI/CD experience.** You've designed and maintained deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) that teams actually trust and rely on. You understand the difference between a pipeline that exists and one that accelerates the business.

**Infrastructure\-as\-code fluency.** You define infrastructure declaratively, version it, review it, and deploy it the same way you would application code.

**Security\-minded by default.** You understand network segmentation, least\-privilege access, secrets management, and encryption at rest and in transit—especially in environments handling financial data.

**Proactive and opinionated.** You don't wait for someone to file a ticket. You see what's broken or missing, propose a path forward, and drive it. You bring a point of view about how infrastructure should work and can back it up.

**Strong communicator.** You can translate infrastructure decisions into business impact for engineering leadership, and explain complex systems clearly to engineers who aren't infrastructure specialists.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Prior experience in fintech, payments, or a PCI\-DSS\-regulated environment. You know how compliance requirements shape infrastructure decisions.
* Experience supporting or enabling AI/ML development

Chromalloy is a global engineering \& solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely \& reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
  
**Video:** What We Do
  
Why work at Chromalloy?
  
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem\-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem\-solvers delivering world\-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
  
Our Total Rewards Program is designed to support you today and in the future.
  
* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development \& progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

Job Summary
  
We’re looking for a Production Automation Engineer to support the reliability, performance, and availability of automated manufacturing systems across our facility. jobs.title: Junior Electrical Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
About Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions
  
Marcurius Multi\-Mission Solutions is a fast\-growing defense technology company headquartered in the Tampa Bay area, Florida. Founded by U.S. and U.K. veterans, Marcurius brings decades of frontline experience across Special Operations and Intelligence missions, with deep expertise in asymmetric warfare and the real\-world employment of unmanned systems.
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking a detail\-oriented Junior Electrical Engineering Technician to join our electrical integration team. In this role, you will build, integrate, and test wire harnesses, low\-voltage electrical systems, and autonomy components for marine applications. You will work directly with the lead electrical engineer on marine power distribution, wire sizing, network topologies, and sensitive electronics, ensuring high\-quality standards for marine durability and operational reliability.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
**Harness \& Cable Fabrication:** Build, break out, route, and terminate low\-voltage wire harnesses and custom cable assemblies.
  
**Hardware \& Systems Integration:** Mount and wire autonomy hardware, sensors, marine communications equipment, Ethernet switches, and CAN bus networks.
  
**Physical Installation:** Route cabling neatly through tight marine spaces, bulkheads, and conduits, ensuring proper strain relief, bend radius, and chafe protection.
  
**Testing \& Verification:** Conduct continuity, pinout, voltage, and ground checks; assist engineering with troubleshooting electrical and wiring faults.
  
**Component Assembly:** Perform precision hand soldering, weather\-sealing, heat shrinking, and lug crimping.
  
Required Qualifications
  
**Hands\-on Experience:** 2\+ years of electrical assembly, wire harness building, or technician experience (marine, automotive, robotics, or industrial context preferred).
  
**Electrical Diagnostics:** Experience using Digital Multimeters (DMM), bench power supplies, and signal test equipment for troubleshooting and pinout validation.
  
**Tools \& Assembly Techniques:** Proficiency in precision hand soldering, heat shrinking, weather\-sealing, and operating manual/hydraulic crimpers for heavy\-gauge lugs.
  
**Power Systems:** Practical familiarity working with 12–48VDC and 120VAC electrical systems.
  
**Schematics \& Diagrams:** Ability to accurately read and interpret electrical schematics, pinout tables, and wiring diagrams
  
Preferred Experience
  
2–3 years of experience in marine electrical systems, unmanned surface vessels (USVs), or vehicle prototyping.
  
Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Automotive, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
Familiarity with CAN diagnostic tools (Vector CANalyzer, Kvaser, Peak PCAN, Vehicle Spy).
  
ABYC (American Boat and Yacht Council) Electrical Certification.
  
Work Environment
  
Primarily onsite at Marcurius facilities in Clearwater, Florida, with direct work in workshops, vessels, docks, and field\-testing environments. The role supports prototype development, electrical integration, and sea\-trial preparation in a fast\-paced setting with changing priorities and close cooperation across engineering, software, operations, and test teams.
  
Why Marcurius
  
Marcurius is a people\-first, execution\-focused organization assembling a small, high\-impact team of engineers and operators. This role offers the opportunity to design and field electrical systems that directly enable real\-world maritime missions and help build the technical foundation of a next\-generation unmanned systems company.

jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: Electrical Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:
**Seven Seas Water Group**


Seven Seas Water Group (www.sevenseaswater.com) is a portfolio company owned by investment funds managed by EQT. Headquartered in Tampa, with operations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America, Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) delivers annually over 20 billion gallons of water to industrial, commercial, governmental, municipal, and hospitality customers. SSWG designs, builds, owns, and operates, delivers new facilities, or acquires and upgrades existing facilities, with the goal of optimizing project risk transfer between the public and private sectors.


We have more than 200 water and wastewater treatment plants in operations throughout the United States, Caribbean, and Latin America. With an outstanding reputation for decentralized water and wastewater treatment solutions, the SSWG “Water\-as\-a\-Service®” approach seeks to help solve global water and wastewater infrastructure challenges.


SSWG operates two businesses within the water infrastructure space. Seven Seas Water, which provides water treatment and desalination for governmental, hospitality and industrial customers in United States, Latin America and the Caribbean, and the AUC Group (www.aucgroup.net), which provides decentralized water and wastewater treatment plants for industrial and municipal customers in the United States.


EQT is a purpose\-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of more than three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors, and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start\-up to maturity. EQT has EUR 273 billion in total assets under management (EUR 141 billion in fee\-generating assets under management) as of 30 June 2025, within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.


With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long\-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future\-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does.


The EQT AB Group comprises EQT AB (publ) and its direct and indirect subsidiaries, which include general partners and fund managers of EQT funds as well as entities advising EQT funds. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.


More info: www.eqtgroup.com


Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram

**The Role:**


This is a hybrid role. Candidates must be living in the Greater Tampa Bay area, and be comfortable commuting to the office 3 days/week. Open to remote candidates outside the local area who are willing to travel on\-site.


Candidates will also need to be comfortable with travel throughout our locations in the Caribbean as needed for local project support. The Electrical / Controls Engineer position requires experience in designing electrical power and control systems for process systems. Experience in seawater reverse osmosis (SWRO) desalination industry is a plus, but not required.


This role is responsible for Instrumentation \& Controls Engineering, Power Distribution/Electrical Engineering, and plant PLC/SCADA programming for large SWRO systems. And for supporting existing facilities with network architecture, enterprise\-wide data collection, upgrades, and firewall/security issues. Must be experienced with PLC architecture and programming, SCADA development with FactoryTalk, and general SCADA client/server architecture and implementation. Capable of programming as well as overseeing PLC design and programs of other programmers and engineers.


Design, develop, and lead procurement of power system equipment including MCC, Switchgear, distribution, and VFD’s. Capable of developing electrical single\-line diagrams. Capable of specifying all power distribution equipment including transformers, switchboards, MCCs, drives, panelboards, etc.


Requirements:
* Conceptualize and document the overall system control architecture including hardware selection, remote I/O considerations, major sub\-system integration, and integration with Seven Seas remote monitoring and potentially the owner’s SCADA.
* Review project specifications and incorporate requirements into Seven Seas design and equipment / procurement specifications.
* Prepare engineering documents within specified dates, such as Network Architecture Diagram, Electrical Load List, Instrument list, Instrument Data Sheets, Automated Valve List, Automated Valve Data Sheets, Electrical Equipment List, I/O List, Panel Layouts, Schematic Wiring Diagrams, Single Line Diagrams, Loop Diagrams, and other project deliverables in accordance with established procedures, schedule, and budget.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF SYSTEMS ENGINEERING
jobs.description:
Description: **THE COMPANY**


For over 40 years, Aero Simulation, Inc. (ASI) has provided quality flight training devices to the US Military. ASI has successfully built numerous training systems with a primary focus on aircrew and maintenance training systems. Our current programs include, but are not limited to, the B\-1 Training Systems (Air Force), E\-2D Training Systems (Navy), CH\-53E Training Devices (USMC), IMOMS (Coast Guard), Navigation, Seamanship, Shiphandling Trainer – NSST (Navy). To learn more about ASI visit Programs\- Aero Simulation, Inc.


ASI is a 100% employee\-owned engineering and manufacturing company committed to supporting the nation’s warfighters. Being 100% employee\-owned directly impacts our culture: it drives our decision\-making, motivates our teams, increases our productivity, improves retention and contributes to the future success of our company. Our culture is one where we work hard for our clients and for each other – and we have fun collaborating, sharing experience and expertise, and learning along the way. We strive to deliver exceptional quality, elevate client relationships, and enrich the careers and lives of our employee\-owners. As Employee\-Owners, we are invested in the success and continued development of each other and the company.


In addition to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), we offer a flexible work environment, generous paid time off, professional development opportunities, industry competitive compensation, and superior benefits to include medical, dental, 401k and more!


ASI is a great place to build a career and grow with a company that is dedicated to quality, service and to fostering a community of support for each and every member of the team. To learn more about this opportunity, keep reading!

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Director of Systems Engineering provides leadership and oversight of the company’s Systems and Software Engineering organizations and is responsible for ensuring the engineering organization has the technical capabilities, processes, tools, and resources necessary to successfully execute current and future programs.


The Director establishes engineering priorities and standards, develops engineering leadership and technical talent, resolves cross\-program resource and technical challenges, and promotes effective systems engineering and integration across ASI programs.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Oversees Software and Systems Engineering personnel, capabilities, processes, and resources to effectively support program requirements.
* Manages engineering staffing, workload, utilization, and resource allocation across programs; resolves resource conflicts and elevates significant capacity concerns to the COO as appropriate.
* Provides guidance and support to Project Engineers in addressing technical challenges, engineering coordination, resource needs, and execution concerns.
* Establishes and maintains engineering standards, processes, tools, and best practices and drives improvements in engineering efficiency, consistency, quality, and technical capability.
* Partners with Human Resources and Group Leaders on workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, performance management, employee development, succession planning, and retention of engineering personnel.
* Develops Group Leaders, Project Engineers, and engineering personnel through coaching, mentoring, cross\-training, knowledge transfer, and professional development.
* Supports proposal activities by providing engineering staffing, labor estimates, technical input, resource requirements, and identification of execution risks.
* Ensures engineering activities comply with applicable company processes, quality requirements, configuration management practices, and technical standards.
* Keeps the COO informed of significant engineering performance, staffing, resource, technical, or capability concerns.

**LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS**

* Provides leadership and direct supervision of Systems Engineering Group Leaders establishing priorities, expectations, and accountability for engineering performance.
* The Director maintains oversight of engineering performance without replacing the technical authority of Project Engineers and ensures engineering teams have the resources, processes, capabilities, and organizational support necessary for successful program execution.


Requirements:
**EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible engineering experience in a complex technical environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of engineering leadership or management experience, including responsibility for engineering personnel, resources, and technical execution.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and complex systems and software development, integration, and test activities.
* Experience within the flight simulation, aerospace, defense, aviation, training systems, or similar complex technical industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with systems engineering principles and practices, including requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration, verification, and validation.

jobs.title: Senior Main Application Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Main Application Software Engineer to support development of the next\-generation GENOSYL inhaled nitric oxide delivery platform. This hands\-on role will develop and maintain the Gen 4 Main Application using C\#/.NET, improve software quality and test coverage, support architecture and system integration, and provide technical guidance to distributed development resources.


The ideal candidate combines strong C\# software engineering skills with experience in architecture, testing, code review, requirements clarification, database\-backed applications, and hardware\-adjacent integration. The role requires clear communication, sound judgment with ambiguous requirements, and experience contributing to regulated or safety\-critical products. This is an onsite position in Atlanta, Georgia.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain the Gen 4 Main Application using C\#/.NET.
* Perform high\-impact Main App code reviews and identify defects, coding\-standard violations, maintainability concerns, and technical debt.
* Develop and improve unit, functional, and integration tests, including mock\-based tests; support code\-coverage analysis for the Main App and shared libraries.
* Help define, implement, document, and maintain Main App architecture, interfaces, dependencies, design decisions, and dependency diagrams.
* Clarify requirements, refine and estimate stories, develop acceptance criteria, and translate ambiguous or evolving requirements into implementable work.
* Support integration among the Main App, GUI, firmware, Vita, OS, and other Gen 4 components; troubleshoot issues across component boundaries.
* Serve as a technical point of contact for Main App questions and mentor less\-experienced developers, including distributed external resources.
* Establish and enforce Main App/C\# coding standards, software processes, development practices, onboarding materials, and quality improvements.
* Participate in Agile planning, huddles, refinements, retrospectives, sprint reviews, story organization, prioritization, and assignment tracking.
* Coordinate with software, systems, firmware, GUI, medical affairs, human factors, quality, verification, and external vendor teams.
* Contribute to software requirements, architecture and design documentation, test protocols, reports, and bidirectional traceability consistent with Vero Biotech quality processes and design controls.
* Support technical interviews, evaluate development tools, analyze software metrics, and apply sound judgment to improve delivery.




* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 6\+ years of professional software\-development experience, including substantial hands\-on C\#/.NET development; regulated medical\-device, safety\-critical, or IoT experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience with object\-oriented design, application architecture, design patterns, dependency management, and maintainable software practices.
* Experience developing and executing unit, functional, and integration tests, including mocks/test doubles, code coverage, static analysis, CI/CD, and configuration management.
* Experience with database\-backed applications and database design or implementation decisions.
* Experience designing, implementing, and consuming APIs or interprocess communication interfaces; RESTful API experience is preferred.
* Experience integrating software with firmware, sensors, electromechanical systems, embedded Linux, or hardware\-controlled products is preferred; Yocto familiarity is a plus.
* Python proficiency for automation, testing, data processing, or development\-support scripts is preferred.
* Experience with Jira, Git, distributed development teams, and external development partners.
* Ability to work with ambiguous requirements, ask precise clarification questions, identify downstream impacts, and communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-software stakeholders.
* Knowledge of software\-development documentation and design\-control expectations for medical devices or other regulated products is preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership, problem\-solving ability, individual leadership, and interest in mentoring other developers.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**




* No formal direct report responsibilities initially. The position is expected to provide increasing technical leadership, mentoring, design oversight, and work coordination for firmware and algorithm development as the role matures.

**Competencies**

* **Analytical \-** Synthesizes requirements, code, test, and system information and applies sound engineering judgment.
* **Problem Solving \-** Resolves complex software and integration problems using evidence\-based, disciplined root\-cause investigation.
* **Technical Leadership \-** Provides clear technical direction through hands\-on contribution, sound decisions, code review, and mentoring.
* **Systems Integration \-** Understands interactions across Main App, GUI, firmware, OS, hardware, and system behavior; drives effective integration.
* **Quality Management \-** Promotes testable, maintainable, reviewable software and follows design\-control and traceability expectations.
* **Project Execution \-** Plans and tracks technical work, accepts responsibility for quality and timeliness, and avoids unnecessary technical debt
* **Collaboration \-** Builds constructive relationships across disciplines, locations, and vendors and communicates clearly through change. Able to work with onshore and offshore partners and collaborate across time zones.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**




* Ability to lift/move up to 50 pounds. Occasionally required to bend, stoop, or reach
* Ability to sit for two hours at a time
* Ability to reach above head and bel

Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.

* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience programming in C\+\+.
* 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
* 5 years of experience building and developing large\-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture.
* 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience with designing and building distributed systems and backend services.
* Experience with data modeling, data pipelines and best practices in data management.
* Leadership experience through leading complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience in people management or equivalent leadership experience.
* Familiarity with network infrastructure concepts.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



In this role, you will lead our Data Initiative team. You have the opportunity to have the influence across the entire Google Global Infrastructure (GGI) organization. You will work closely with the senior leadership of GGI, drive the strategic direction across various systems in GGI, accelerate AI adoption in the team to improve productivity and foster innovation. You will collaborate with various sub\-organizations in GGI, understand their data model, and provide recommendations to them to operate safety on their data, and solve difficult problems involving data architecture, conformance and quality.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with senior leadership in GGI, cross\-functional teams to collect requirements, and define product and key user journeys.
* Lead the technical design and execution of complex projects, ensuring alignment with the long\-term data architecture strategy.
* Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to production support.

**About us**

We're looking for a mid\-career Electrical Engineer to support the design, integration, and sustaining engineering of antenna systems spanning all frequency bands. This role works under the direction of senior/technical lead engineers. In this role you will contribute independently on core design, documentation, BOM development, and test support tasks. Solid RF fundamentals and a strong electrical design/documentation toolset are what matter most!  

  

**The day\-to\-day**  

  

  

**Electrical Design \& Documentation**
* Develop and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, and harness/interconnect documentation using EPLAN, DraftSight, and/or Visio.
* Apply Design for Excellence (DFX) principles, including DFM and DFT
* Apply established design standards, review checklists, and documentation practices to new and sustaining designs.
* Participate in design reviews and support resolution of design issues identified during review or test.

**Systems \& Project Engineer Fundamentals**
* Apply working knowledge of RF/antenna fundamentals (EIRP, G/T, sidelobes, linearity, noise figure, gain, VSWR) to support design architecture and drive program commonality.
* Identify and support requirement flow\-downs from system to subsystem/LRU level and help maintain traceability records.
* Help select appropriate test approaches and equipment for characterizing RF performance.
* Support cost/schedule estimate development for proposals and sustaining engineering tasks.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work with manufacturing and supply chain to support BOM structure, part data integrity, quality control, and configuration control.
* Identify and mitigate risks and opportunities alongside program leadership.
* Actively participate in vGate meetings to ensure program success and handoff to other engineering disciplines as required, e.g. Test Engineering.
* Attend and actively participate in customer meetings as a part of program leadership, when required.
* Identify quality concerns and escalate appropriately to ensure suppliers and internal groups are held in compliance.
* Assist in evaluating and adopting engineering automation and toolchain improvements (e.g., EPLAN workflows, traceability tools, QA checks) introduced by technical leads.

  

**What you'll need**  

  

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in electrical engineering, RF/antenna systems, or related product design.
* BS in Electrical Engineering, Antenna Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Working knowledge of RF and satellite communications principles and how they translate to product requirements.
* Hands\-on proficiency with Siemens NX, EPLAN, DraftSight, and/or Visio (please indicate which tools you've used and at what depth).
* Familiarity with RF hardware and integration elements: SSPA, TWTA, TLT, LNA, LNB, ACU, waveguide, cabling, filters, power dividers, terminations, etc.
* Exposure to antenna test S parameters, and test equipment (VNA, signal generators, Spectrum analyzers).
* Basic understanding of regulatory/compliance frameworks (UL, NEC, IEC, FCC, ETSI, ITU) is a plus, not required.
* Strong documentation habits, attention to detail, and clear technical communication.
* Comfortable working across hardware/test/manufacturing boundaries to troubleshoot issues.
* Must be able to work out of the Duluth, GA office

* US Citizenship required.
* Must be able to obtain a United States Secret Clearance

  

**What will help you on the job**  

  

  

* Prior exposure to phased array or multi\-band antenna systems.
* Experience supporting design\-for\-manufacture reviews or supplier technical evaluations.
* Interest in engineering automation/toolchain modernization (schematic linting, traceability tools, BOM normalization).

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.  

  

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
* Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
* Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well\-thought\-out products.
* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

  

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.  

  

About the team  

Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.

* 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation o

* Respond to and assist in production operations in a 24/7 environment

* Working knowledge of horizontal and vertical scaling for performance and high availability

* Excellent project management, organization, and time management skills

jobs.description:
Overview:
**Job Purpose**


The Kubernetes Platform Engineering (KPE) team builds and operates ICE's internal container orchestration platform powered by Red Hat OpenShift. KPE Features, the Solutions Engineering sub\-team, serves as the primary interface between the platform and its consumers across ICE's various business units.

  

We are looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to join KPE Features. In this role, you will own and drive platform capabilities that enable development teams to deploy and operate workloads at enterprise scale. You’ll work across the full platform stack from GitOps pipelines and policy enforcement to observability infrastructure, while providing technical leadership and mentorship to others on the team.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own and deliver platform features and enhancements, driving work from design through deployment and documentation
* Lead onboarding of new teams and workloads onto the platform via self\-service and GitOps\-based provisioning workflows
* Maintain and evolve ArgoCD\-based GitOps pipelines and Kustomize overlay configurations across multiple clusters
* Implement and tune Kyverno admission control policies to enforce security and operational standards across the platform
* Build and maintain observability tooling, including Grafana dashboards, Tempo distributed tracing, and alerting
* Collaborate with KPE\-Infrastructure and KPE\-Enablement sub\-teams on cluster lifecycle events, upgrades, and cross\-cutting platform concerns
* Engage with platform consumers and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
* Own and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and internal knowledge bases on Confluence
* Participate in 2nd or 3rd level support for on\-call rotation

 **Knowledge and Experience**

* 6\+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or a related discipline
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes in a production environment; OpenShift experience strongly preferred
* Experience with Kubernetes configuration and templating tools such as Kustomize or Helm
* Comfort operating in Linux environments and working with YAML\-heavy configuration management
* Strong communication skills. This team writes documentation and communicates changes to a broad consumer base
* Deep proficiency in multiple platform disciplines:
* + K8s Observability — Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alerting pipelines, distributed tracing (Tempo, Jaeger), log aggregation (Loki, Vector, Cortex), and related logging/monitoring practices
	+ K8s GitOps \& Release Engineering — GitHub, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Kustomize, Helm, and Git\-based delivery workflows
	+ K8s Infrastructure Engineering — Kubernetes on bare metal, cluster networking (CNI, OVN\-Kubernetes, network policy), storage and CSI drivers, and hardware\-layer operations
	+ K8s Security \& Policy Enforcement — Policy\-as\-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper), admission webhooks, and container security practices

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Red Hat OpenShift Certified Administrator (EX280\) or equivalent certification
* Experience supporting internal platform consumers or operating in a shared\-services model
* Ansible and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform (AAP)
* Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management (ACM)
* Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (ACS)
* Experience with HyperShift or OpenShift Hosted Control Planes strongly preferred
* Podman and container image build/management workflows
* Experience developing custom Kubernetes operators

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $165,000 \- 190,000 USD. The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation. While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. jobs.description:
**Job Title****Electrical Engineer I****Job Classification** Exempt Level Position
**Job Summary**
Research, develops, tests, and evaluates electrical components, equipment, and systems, applying principles and techniques of electrical engineering. Perform intensive technological research and evaluation of a broad array of alternative solutions to improve existing implementations. Perform analysis of existing technology applications, processes, and products, taking into consideration costs, life cycle considerations, availability, reliability, maintainability, producibility, and long\-term support.

* Work with a team to help resolve challenging discrepancies and issues related to rotary and fixed wing aircraft.
* Develop design for component parts and assemblies for application on aerospace products in accordance with Military Standards using CAD programs.
* Verify modifications or repairs safely integrate with military aircraft systems.
* Assure conformance to pre\-established design parameters.
* Participate in detailed cross functional engineering communication, design, evaluation, and implementations.
* Perform routine analyses to develop options or recommendations for customer products and components.
* Participate in the development of product drawings, schematics, bills of materials, technical data packages (TDP), test procedures, technical instructions, and design documentation.
* Review and evaluation of regulatory compliance of aircraft certification projects and initiation of safety determinations for continuing airworthiness.
* Evaluate existing drawings for manufacturability and supportability.
* Prepares, edits, and/or submits research, travel, technical, and other reports.
* Conduct research on aircraft components and systems using a variety of resources (FEDLog, A\-Team, REMIS, EDIS, technical manuals, etc.).
* May work for design approvals related to 14 CFR parts 23, 25, 27, 29 or 33 and other 14 CFR parts of the Federal Aviation Regulations (FAR) as assigned.
* Identify barriers and design issues, brief leadership on deviations / options / workarounds / solutions.
* Perform all duties on time, on budget and in a safe manner while adhering to safety standards.
* Perform various supporting tasks as assigned.

  


**Qualifications**
* An undergraduate degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution or applicable experience plus a scientific degree from an accredited institution is required.
* Five years’ experience with greater than one year of experience with specialized software training in:
	+ SolidWorks, AutoCAD, CATIA Design software
	+ Electrical system modeling software (LabView, PSPICE, ORCAD)
* Aircraft modification background is a plus
* Familiar with MS Office Suite
* Effective written and oral communication skills

Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance at the contract required level. US Citizenship is required for clearance.
**Travel**
Travel may be required.

Employees must possess the ability to work in a standard office or conference room setting and use standard office equipment, including a computer.

**This is a hybrid role base out of our Atlanta or Miami office.**

* Build, test, and ship features for production AI systems, including retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, agentic workflows, and model orchestration components.
* Write and maintain evaluation cases and test suites that catch regressions in AI system quality before they reach users.
* Implement and iterate on prompts, tool/function definitions, and guardrails, using eval results to guide changes rather than intuition alone.
* Contribute to the services, APIs, and data pipelines that AI features depend on, including instrumentation, logging, and dashboards.
* Investigate production issues — latency spikes, cost anomalies, quality regressions, failed tool calls — and implement fixes.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

We are seeking a talented CAD senior engineer specialized in analog and digital simulations to join our high\-achieving engineering team. As a CAD senior engineer, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and simulating complex analog and digital circuits, contributing to the development of state\-of\-the\-art products that shape our industry. You will get a chance to develop the industry's first and unique flows to enhance productivity and reduce pre\-silicon failures.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with memory design teams and solve their daily challenges and provide complete solutions for the future.
* Proactively identify problem areas for improvement, propose, and develop innovative solutions.
* Develop highly scalable, and clean software systems.
* Continuously evaluate and implement new tools and technologies to improve the current software flows.
* Work with EDA vendors to evaluate and integrate EDA tools in CAD flows.
* Lead agentic flow implementation using AI‑assisted and automated workflows, applying copilot‑based assistants, agentic AI flows, and rule‑aware automation to circuit simulation \& verification.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior engineers, fostering their professional growth and development.

 **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with 5\+ years industry experience.
* Experience in analog circuit simulation flows.
* Expert in circuit simulation debugging with required knowledge of leading\-edge circuit design and simulation methodologies.
* Hands on experience with one of the circuit simulators (Finesim/Primesim/XA/Spectre/VCS/Xcelium etc.)
* Hands\-on experience with Cadence custom IC Virtuoso platform, Virtuoso\-L, and Virtuoso\-XL, schematic capture, or Synopsys custom compiler or equivalent.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Develop and deploy AI‑enabled methodologies for circuit simulation flows
* Hands on with Python/Perl Object Oriented Programming.
* Good understanding of CMOS concepts and electronic fundamentals.
* Knowledge of Linux, LSF, shell scripting, TCL scripting, SKILL(Cadence) language.
* Knowledge of parasitic extraction tools like StarRC/Quantus will be an added advantage.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex circuit issues effectively.
* Proficiency in working effectively with global teams and stakeholders.

* Collaborate with firmware, hardware, and software teams to integrate algorithms and HFSS\-derived designs into prototype hardware and software systems.
* Prepare and deliver clear technical presentations and documentation for internal and external stakeholders.

* Demonstrated experience in digital signal processing
* Hands\-on experience with MATLAB for modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
* Demonstrated experience creating and delivering technical presentations.

* **Clearance:** Ability to obtain and maintain at least a Secret clearance with additional customer\-specified access prior to start date as required.

* Demonstrated experience in digital signal processing
* Hands\-on experience with MATLAB for modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
* Demonstrated experience creating and delivering technical presentations.
* Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen
* **Clearance:** Ability to obtain and maintain at least a Secret clearance with additional customer\-specified access prior to start date as required.

* BS with 5\+ years, MS with 3\+ years, or PhD with 1\+ years; degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM field.
* Strong background in physics and mathematics (e.g., electromagnetics, signals and systems, probability/statistics).
* Academic or industry experience in one or more of the following areas:
	+ Computational electromagnetics or wave theory
	+ RF propagation modeling
	+ Antenna design and characterization
	+ RF chain analysis and modeling
	+ Embedded software design and test
	+ Anechoic chamber measurement experience
* Experience with HFSS (or similar full\-wave EM simulation tools) for RF/antenna modeling and analysis.
* Familiarity with C/C\+\+ for algorithm implementation or integration.
* Experience applying RF/DSP algorithms and EM simulations in laboratory or field\-test environments.

NGMS is seeking a manager for its Systems Engineering Integration and Test (SEIT) organization at our Rolling Meadows, IL location. The selected candidate will manage a team of SEIT engineers within the SEIT Targeting Department.

The candidate will spend \~20% of their time on support of the organization (functional duties) and \~80% of their time on technical program work. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer-Mobile Equipment & Wire Harness Design
jobs.description:
Forklift Exchange, Inc. is seeking an **Electrical Engineer specializing in mobile equipment electrical systems and wire harness design**. This position will be responsible for designing, documenting, testing, and continuously improving the electrical systems used across Royal Rig’s heavy\-duty forklift product line.

This is a hands\-on engineering position. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at a computer designing electrical systems and harnesses, but equally comfortable working directly on a prototype machine with technicians and production personnel to troubleshoot, test, and improve the design.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design complete **12V/24V electrical systems and wire harnesses** for heavy mobile equipment.
* Develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, connector pinouts, and bills of material.
* Design harnesses for engines, transmissions/hydrostatic systems, hydraulic controls, operator controls, lighting, safety systems, sensors, and accessories.
* Select appropriate wire sizes, connectors, terminals, relays, fuses, circuit protection, switches, sensors, and electrical components.
* Develop and maintain electrical interfaces with **PLCs/controllers, CAN bus/J1939 networks, engines, Danfoss hydrostatic components, displays, sensors, and other electronic controls**.
* Design harnesses for manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, and straightforward installation.
* Establish proper harness routing, mounting, protection, labeling, connector locations, and service access.
* Work directly with Royal's in\-house harness department to ensure harnesses can be built consistently and efficiently.
* Develop and maintain **harness test procedures and test fixtures** so completed harnesses can be verified before installation on the machine.
* Troubleshoot prototype and production machines and determine the **root cause** of electrical problems rather than relying on temporary fixes.
* Support prototype builds and convert lessons learned during prototyping into permanent engineering changes.
* Work closely with mechanical, hydraulic, manufacturing, assembly, and service teams.
* Maintain accurate engineering documentation, revisions, BOMs, and electrical standards across the Royal product line.
* Help standardize components and electrical architecture across multiple Royal models to reduce part count, inventory, assembly time, and service complexity.
* Support production and field service when electrical troubleshooting expertise is required.

**Primary Objective**

Royal's goal is to develop electrical systems that are **simple, reliable, repeatable, easy to manufacture, and easy to troubleshoot in the field**.

A successful design should allow Royal to:

* Build and test harnesses before they reach final assembly.
* Install harnesses without cutting, modifying, extending, or reworking wiring during production.
* Use common electrical components and design standards across multiple models wherever practical.
* Provide technicians with clear schematics and diagnostic information.
* Reduce assembly time and eliminate recurring electrical problems through permanent engineering solutions.
* Take a prototype electrical system and turn it into a documented, production\-ready system that can be duplicated machine after machine.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience designing electrical systems or wire harnesses for **off\-highway equipment, forklifts, construction equipment, agricultural equipment, trucks, automotive systems, or other mobile machinery** strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of 12V/24V DC electrical systems.
* Experience with CAN bus and J1939 communications preferred.
* Experience with mobile hydraulic or hydrostatic equipment is highly desirable.
* Ability to read and create professional electrical schematics and harness documentation.
* Understanding of electrical troubleshooting, voltage drop, grounding, circuit protection, electrical loads, and component selection.
* Experience working directly with manufacturing and technicians during prototype development.
* Strong practical problem\-solving skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for more than someone who can create drawings. We want an engineer who can **own the electrical system from concept through production**.

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, making technical decisions, collaborating directly with stakeholders, and owning solutions from initial requirements through deployment and production support.

Working across the globe, V2X builds smart solutions designed to integrate physical and digital infrastructure from base to battlefield. Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

  

SEL manufactures intelligent electronic devices (IED), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), and logic controllers that provide state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, communication, and protection of power systems in multiple industries.

  

SEL Engineering Services (SEL ES) is the sector of SEL that creates solutions to target applications of SEL equipment for worldwide customers. * Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution
* Industrial Plants and Universities– Substation and Switchgear

Utilizing real\-time logic controllers and communication equipment, the SEL ES Automation engineer owns the planning, design, development, testing and commissioning of the project. Projects often include, but are not limited to:

Precise Systems delivers integrated, mission\-ready solutions that advance warfighter readiness and strengthen our nation’s most critical defense programs. Through the power of our combined capabilities, we provide deep expertise in Advanced Engineering; Digital Transformation; Electromagnetic Warfare; Interactive Training \& Simulation; Physical Sciences Research; Platform Lifecycle Support; and Foreign Military Sales. Precise Systems is seeking a **Cellular Protocol \& Software Engineer** to support NSWC Crane's Expeditionary Electromagnetic Warfare mission. This position focuses on the analysis, development, implementation, and testing of 3G, LTE, and 5G cellular protocols in laboratory, simulated, over\-the\-air, and field environments. The engineer must be able to analyze cellular communications beyond RF spectrum observations by breaking down protocol signaling, message exchanges, information elements, state transitions, and interactions between protocol layers. This is not a traditional cellular network optimization or RF performance\-monitoring role. This position requires in\-person support.


**Duties:**


* Analyze 3G, LTE, and 5G protocol stacks, signaling flows, message exchanges, state transitions, and protocol behavior at the packet and message level.
* Decode and evaluate cellular control\-plane and user\-plane signaling, including interactions among RRC, NAS, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers.
* Analyze 3GPP procedures such as registration/attach, authentication, security establishment, session setup, mobility, handover, and connection management.
* Identify protocol fields, information eements, timing relationships, implementation differences, abnormal behavior, edge cases, and potential vulnerabilities.
* Develop, modify, debug, and maintain software in C, C\+\+, and Python to generate, emulate, manipulate, analyze, or test cellular protocol behavior.
* Capture, decode, inspect, and troubleshoot cellular signaling and packet traffic using protocol\-analysis, packet\-analysis, cellular diagnostic, or comparable engineering tools.
* Develop and execute structured test cases that exercise specific protocol states, message sequences, malformed conditions, implementation behavior, and performance characteristics.
* Support software\-defined, simulated, laboratory, over\-the\-air, and field test environments used to reproduce, stimulate, or assess cellular protocol behavior.
* Correlate RF observations and waveform characteristics with protocol\-layer activity to support technically defensible analysis and test conclusions.
* Prepare test procedures, technical reports, protocol analyses, vulnerability findings, briefings, and engineering recommendations for Government review and decision\-making.


**Required Education:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Mathematics with a concentration in computer science

  


**Required Experience:**


* Minimum of three (3\) years of professional experience in computer design, software development, or computer networks
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience analyzing or developing cellular protocols at the protocol\-stack, signaling\-message, or packet level.
* Working knowledge of 3GPP cellular architecture and LTE/5G protocol behavior, including RRC, NAS, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY interactions.
* Ability to analyze signaling procedures, message sequences, information elements, state transitions, and interactions between protocol layers.
* Strong programming skills in C, C\+\+, and Python for protocol analysis, test development, automation, or software integration.
* Experience capturing, decoding, and analyzing cellular signaling or packet traffic using protocol\-analysis, packet\-analysis, diagnostic, or comparable tools.
* Experience developing or executing structured laboratory, simulated, over\-the\-air, or field test activities.
* Strong technical\-writing and communication skills with the ability to document findings, conclusions, vulnerabilities, and engineering recommendations.


**Desired Experience:**


* Experience with cellular protocol development, modem or baseband software, UE/eNB/gNB protocol implementation, protocol conformance testing, or telecom research and development.
* Experience with cellular vulnerability analysis, protocol exploitation, malformed\-message testing, or wireless cyber test environments.
* Familiarity with software\-defined radio and open cellular test platforms or frameworks such as srsRAN, OpenAirInterface, or comparable environments.
* Experience with Wireshark or other cellular protocol decoders, packet\-capture tools, diagnostic logging tools, or signaling\-analysis platforms.
* Experience with Digital Signal Processing, FPGA\-based systems, waveform analysis, RF signal generation, or RF test infrastructure.
* Experience supporting Department of Defense, Navy, Electronic Warfare, cyber, spectrum, or secure laboratory programs.
* Experience with verification and validation, requirements traceability, regression testing, test automation, or Git\-based development workflows.
* Active Secret clearance and ability to support higher\-classification tasking when required.


**Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance. Due to the sensitivity of customer\-related requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required.**

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Automation Engineer to lead the design, development, and maintenance of advanced automation systems within our manufacturing environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge robotics, industrial controls, and programmable logic controllers (PLCs) to optimize production processes. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for innovation, a strong technical background, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Join us to drive efficiency, enhance safety, and contribute to the future of industrial automation!

**Responsibilities**

* Design, program, and troubleshoot PLC systems using ladder logic (LD) and other engineering programming languages to ensure seamless automation operations.
* Develop and implement robot programming solutions for industrial robotic systems, including Fanuc and other robotics platforms.
* Configure human\-machine interface (HMI) systems for efficient operator interaction and control.
* Maintain and repair industrial electrical systems, including schematics reading and interpretation, ensuring system reliability.
* Integrate industrial networks and distributed control systems (DCS) for real\-time data exchange and process control.
* Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures, utilizing troubleshooting skills across PLCs, robotics, vision inspection systems, and other industrial controls.
* Collaborate with mechanical engineers on tooling design, machining processes, and blueprint reading to support automation projects.
* Utilize AutoCAD and SolidWorks for system layout design, schematic creation, and modifications as needed.
* Perform preventive maintenance on automated equipment while adhering to CGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) standards in regulated environments.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using lean manufacturing principles to optimize workflows and reduce waste.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience practicing in an industrial or manufacturing engineering role with a focus on automation solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Fanuc robotics, industrial robotic systems, and robot programming techniques.
* Proficiency in PLC programming languages such as ladder logic (LD), function block diagram (FBD), or structured text (ST).
* Hands\-on experience with PLC troubleshooting, installation, repair, and system integration within complex manufacturing environments.
* Familiarity with industrial electrical systems, schematics reading/interpretation, and electrical schematic diagrams.
* Ability to configure human\-machine interface (HMI) systems for operational efficiency.
* Knowledge of industrial networks such as Ethernet/IP, Profibus, or Modbus protocols for system communication.
* Mechanical knowledge including tooling setup, machining processes, blueprint reading, and schematic interpretation.
* Experience with AutoCAD or SolidWorks for designing layouts or schematics related to automation projects.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis under pressure.
* Excellent communication skills to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams in a fast\-paced environment.

Join us as an Automation Engineer if you’re eager to innovate within a vibrant manufacturing setting! Bring your technical expertise in robotics engineering, industrial controls, and troubleshooting to help us achieve operational excellence while advancing your career in a forward\-thinking organization committed to safety and quality!

Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Global multi\-billion dollar company about 30 minutes north of downtown Lexington, KY area has a need for a Robotics Engineer. This is a direct hire role with a full benefits package.


The primary responsibility of this role is to develop and implement innovative activities, improving manufacturing competitiveness and reducing fixed costs in North America


Reporting to the Engineering Manager the person in this role will support the Advanced Technology department's objective to learn and confirm innovative technologies for vehicle manufacturing.

 **What you'll be doing**

* Integrate and deploy AI\-enabled robotic solutions to improve manufacturing capability, flexibility, and performance.
* Develop and implement computer vision, machine learning, and sensor fusion solutions for real\-world manufacturing applications (e.g., bin picking, part handling, inspection).
* Build and optimize AI models for robust performance on industrial hardware, balancing latency, reliability, and compute constraints.
* Bridge the gap between modern AI Python scripts and standard industrial automation.
* Utilize simulation tools (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or equivalent) to support concept validation, synthetic data generation, and Sim2Real deployment.
* Lead and support equipment trials, debugging, and performance validation from proof\-of\-concept through production deployment (yokoten).

* Identify, evaluate, and implement emerging Physical AI technologies through benchmarking, supplier engagement, and industry events.
* Ensure solutions meet safety, reliability, and manufacturability requirements, including alignment with applicable standards and internal risk assessments.
* Present technical concepts, results, and recommendations to stakeholders, management, and executive leadership.
* Manage contractors to design and construct testing cells.
* Produce clear, detailed documentation to support future scaling and customer enablement.

 **Requirements**  

Qualifications

**What you bring**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation deployments.
* Experience in robotics, AI/ML, or advanced automation development.
* Having a full\-stack mindset while working in team environments building complete solutions, not just independent AI algorithms, demonstrations, and experiments.
* Strong hands\-on experience in at least two of the following:

  

* Computer vision (e.g., detection, segmentation, 3D perception)
* Machine learning / deep learning
* Robotics
* Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, ROS\-based systems; strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Deep understanding of different sensor types (RGBD cameras, LiDAR, Time\-of\-Flight sensors, etc.) and the ability to tune for image quality accuracy and performance.

* Training \& Development
