jobs.title: Embedded Software Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
As an **Embedded Software Test Automation Engineer**, you will join our Instrument Development team and help build the test automation frameworks, infrastructure, and tools that ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of IDEXX diagnostic instrumentation. You will play a key role in advancing reusable test automation capabilities across multiple product lines, designing solutions that can be leveraged across instruments rather than rebuilt for each individual platform. Experience with AI\-assisted, spec\-driven development workflows is required.  



  

At IDEXX, our diagnostic instruments directly support veterinary professionals in delivering real\-time clinical care to companion animals around the world. As part of a highly collaborative engineering organization, you'll work alongside software, electrical, mechanical, systems, and biological engineering teams to develop and maintain premium point\-of\-care analyzers. Your contributions will help ensure our instruments meet the highest standards of quality throughout their lifecycle while enabling teams to develop and deliver innovative products more efficiently.

  

Why does this role matter? Test automation is critical to scaling the development of complex embedded systems while maintaining quality and reliability. In this role, you'll help establish reusable automation frameworks, data pipelines, and CI/CD integrations that improve engineering efficiency across multiple instrument platforms. You'll have the opportunity to contribute both strategically and hands\-on, influencing technical direction while continuing to solve challenging engineering problems that ultimately support veterinary professionals and the animals they serve.

**In this role:**
-----------------

* You will design and build reusable automated test frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure that can be leveraged across multiple embedded instrument platforms.
* You will develop, maintain, and continuously improve automated test code used to validate embedded software systems.
* You will define and maintain automated test strategies across the software development lifecycle, ensuring appropriate test coverage and scalability.
* You will integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and support the operation of automated test environments, including hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) systems.
* You will collaborate with engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and improve testing efficiency, quality, and reliability across products.
* You will contribute to technical direction, standards, and best practices for test automation while supporting and mentoring other engineers as needed.
* You will participate in reviews of test architectures, automation designs, and engineering solutions to promote maintainability, scalability, and long\-term success.
* You will design data pipelines and tooling to parse, validate, transform, and manage test telemetry and configuration data.
* You will help establish scalable approaches to test data management that support the introduction of new instruments and data sources.
* You will contribute directly to embedded software and product development efforts as project priorities require, applying strong engineering judgment and software development fundamentals.
* You will work as a self\-directed team member who values collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering high\-quality engineering solutions.

**What you need to succeed:**
**Required**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in embedded software test automation, including designing test infrastructure or frameworks that support multiple product platforms.
* Experience designing, building, and maintaining automated test frameworks and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing environments.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes.
* Strong programming skills in at least two of the following languages: C, C\+\+, Python, Lua, Go, or Rust.
* Experience working with Linux operating systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Experience using Generative AI development tools to support software engineering activities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts across cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and in collaborative team environments.
* Ability to balance responsibilities across test automation, software quality, and hands\-on embedded software development as business needs evolve.

 **Strongly Preferred**

* Experience with AI\-assisted and spec\-driven development workflows, including tools and approaches such as OpenSpec.
* Familiarity with microcontroller\-based embedded systems.

 **Preferred**

* Familiarity with VHDL.

**Our tech stack:**
-------------------

This role supports embedded software platforms developed using a variety of technologies, including C, C\+\+, Python, Lua, Go, and Rust running on Linux\-based systems. The environment includes automated test frameworks, hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) systems, CI/CD pipelines, telemetry and test data processing workflows, and modern AI\-assisted development tools. * Opportunity for annual cash bonus

* Additional benefits including but not limited to fina

**Description**  

Are you passionate about applying signal processing, communications, detection, and estimation theory to solve challenging RF problems?

  

Do you enjoy developing novel approaches to characterize and build communication systems for unique and challenging problems?

 **If so, we're looking** **for someone like you to join our team at APL.**  

We develop end\-to\-end RF communications and sensing systems from idea to fielded capability for challenging national security problems. We seek an engineer to analyze communication links and propagation environments, guide design choices, and develop hardware and software solutions that realize sophisticated RF sensing and communication systems. In collaboration with a team of embedded and FPGA developers and hardware designers, you’ll turn novel concepts into deployable capabilities.

 **As an RF Communications Systems Engineer, you will...*** Analyze wireless communication systems by developing link budgets and modeling RF propagation and channel effects.
* Evaluate system performance across realistic operational environments to develop transmitter, receiver, and system design requirements.
* Analyze documented and undocumented systems, waveforms, and protocols to characterize their operation and develop new communication and sensing approaches.
* Contribute to algorithm, hardware, software, and software\-defined radio development, from concept through implementation, integration, and test.
* Plan and conduct field evaluations to assess and validate system performance and improve designs.
* Collaborate with sponsors and engineering teams to understand mission challenges, develop technical requirements and solutions, and transition successful designs to the field.


  

**Qualifications** **You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...*** Possess a Bachelor’s degree and 5\+ years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or another relevant field.
* Bring experience in RF or electronic hardware design, communication system software development, or RF systems engineering in support of the build and integration of RF communication systems.
* Have deep understanding of signals and systems and digital communications, including modulation, estimation, and detection techniques with experience in link budgets, RF propagation, system performance analysis, and translating analysis into system requirements.
* Are proficient in developing communication system models and algorithms using MATLAB, Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages.
* Have demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and develop solutions.
* Are able to obtain a Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

**You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...**

* Have a Master’s or Ph.D. in a related technical field with a focus on communications or RF systems.
* Have broad experience spanning multiple aspects of RF system development, such as RF hardware, system software, embedded systems, software\-defined radios, or signal processing implementation.
* Have experience providing technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams.

jobs.title: Robotic Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Mowze’s commercial robotic lawn mowers are deployed in the field. However, a skilled operator on a manned mower still has a speed edge over our product, and we believe most of that gap is in the controller.

You will own the robot's motion stack, covering state estimation, planning, and control. That includes building and refining a dynamics model of the mower from real telemetry, and using it to drive smoother and more precisely on slopes and uneven turf. Your goal is to exceed a human's efficiency.

Hybrid, based in Gaithersburg, MD. On site 2\-5 days a week, as needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the motion stack: state estimation → planning → control → actuator commands. Choose the architecture and own the migration.
* Build, refine, and validate a dynamics model of the mower (mass properties, tire/turf interaction, slope effects, controller response) and fit it to real telemetry.
* Design model\-based control (MPC or equivalent) that holds line on slopes and varying turf, slows for sharp corners, and maximizes ground speed subject to cut quality and safety limits.
* Own coverage planning: detect missed or partially cut strips and re\-plan to cover them. Optimize path for throughput.
* Stand up simulation\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test infrastructure.
* Define what telemetry the mower must log to close the loop on model fidelity, work with other engineers to implement logging.

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years shipping control systems on physical vehicles or mobile robots — ground vehicles, agricultural/construction equipment, AMRs, off\-road platforms. Not drones\-only, not simulation\-only.
* Demonstrated system identification on real hardware: has fit a model to logged data, found it was wrong, and fixed it.
* Hands\-on with model\-based control in production (MPC, LQR/iLQR, or equivalent) — not just a course project.
* Strong state estimation (EKF/UKF, IMU \+ GNSS \+ wheel odometry fusion).
* Comfortable in C\+\+ and Python; has worked inside a real\-time embedded control loop, not only in a notebook.
* Has built a vehicle control stack from scratch or substantially rewritten one; understands what ArduPilot/PX4 do and do not model, so the replacement doesn't lose the parts that worked.
* Has built or substantially extended a vehicle simulator and can articulate where sim diverged from reality.

Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 per year

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Application Question(s):

* Do you have real world experience with a production fleet of robots / vehicles? (How many were in the fleet? Did the robots operate outdoors? Roughly how much did the robots weigh? What was and how long was your role?)
* How do you model a vehicle that is crabbing while driving sideways on a slope? While not sliding completely, there is some nonzero sideways slip.
* How do you fuse visual odometry, wheel odometry, IMU, and intermittent GPS for accurate pose estimates in GPS poor environments? About how far could the robot travel without GPS while still staying on the path? (State your assumptions about the system)
* Describe a time a model you identified from real data turned out to be wrong. How did you find out, and what did you change?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gaithersburg, MD 20879

At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high\-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.
Would you like to join a team of world\-class researchers and engineers commencing collectively starting Summer of 2027, focused on developing systems critical to national security? Are you seeking an opportunity to work in an environment where big ideas, sound technical arguments, and sponsor impacts are valued? Then MITRE might be the place for you!

  

At MITRE, we believe that good ideas lead to great solutions through testing, exploration, development, and demonstration. In MITRE's Electronic System Development and Embedded Security department, we apply this principle as we dig deep into hard problems to find innovative, practical ways to solve tough challenges for a variety of government sponsors across a range of technical applications.

As an applied research organization, we focus on capability development and demonstration while remaining decoupled from protracted product lifecycles and system support roles. They should have a firm grasp of the fundamentals of RF system architecture to support both software and hardware reverse engineering tasks and be able to use their hardware expertise to rapidly test prototype solutions.

* Prepare and execute test events for customers and internal and external stakeholders
* Lead efforts to develop lab\-based acquisition and control platforms to aid in test and characterization of hardware systems

* Participate in proposal efforts by providing input on technical path and BOM/cost and schedule estimates

As part of the Hardware Engineering team, you will develop a deep understanding of electrical system behavior through rigorous test, characterization, analysis, and hands\-on debugging, then translate those insights into architecture, schematic, and design improvements. This is a hands\-on player\-coach role for an engineer who combines deep electrical expertise with exceptional systems thinking and technical judgment. jobs.title: Senior Undersea Robotics Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Team:**  

  

The Sensors Division within STR focuses on the development and analysis of advanced sensor systems in the RF, acoustic, and electro\-optical domains. This includes the design and development of novel sensors and advanced information processing techniques from ideation to prototype implementations. The Subsea and Seabed Systems (SSS) Group develops and delivers advanced undersea sensor and signal processing systems, including bespoke undersea vehicles to deploy those systems. We apply those products to to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) and counter\-ISR applications to deliver missions success to our customers.


**The Role:**



We are seeking an Electrical Engineer with a strong interest and some experience in undersea robotics to design, develop, and implement the electrical systems that enable next‑generation uncrewed undersea vehicles, sensor systems, and command and control (C2\) systems. In this role, you will be the responsible for the full range of development for electrical systems in our products: from board‑level design and sensor integration through bring‑up, test, and support in the lab and at sea.



You will work closely with mechanical, software, and systems engineers as well as other electrical engineers. An ideal candidate would have exposure to control systems, embedded software, mechanical engineering as undersea vehicle and system design is inherently multi\-disciplinary. Ideal candidates are hands‑on engineers who are comfortable with analog and digital circuit design, can take a circuit board from concept through fabrication, and are adept at troubleshooting and resolving hardware issues.



Candidates with more experience are welcome and will be considered for greater responsibility, but the position is intended for an engineer early in their career who has solid, practical experience with electronics.  

  

**What you will do:**


* Design, implement, and document analog and digital circuitry for uncrewed undersea vehicles, including power distribution, signal conditioning, communications interfaces, and sensor integration
* Develop and lay out printed circuit boards (PCBs), including component selection, schematic capture, layout, and preparation of fabrication and assembly packages
* Bring up new boards and electronic modules: perform bench testing, debug hardware issues, and iterate designs based on test results and field feedback
* Integrate and interface onboard sensors (e.g., IMUs, depth sensors, navigation systems, acoustic sensors) with vehicle processors and control systems
* Work with embedded software engineers to define hardware‑software interfaces, support driver development, and ensure reliable real‑time operation
* Collaborate with mechanical and systems engineers to ensure proper packaging, environmental protection, thermal management, and compliance with undersea operational requirements
* Support hardware‑in‑the‑loop and system‑level testing in lab, pool, and at‑sea environments, including preparation, operation, and troubleshooting of vehicle electronics
* Contribute to the development of system‑level requirements and electrical architectures for novel undersea vehicles and sensor payloads
* Maintain design records, test reports, and configuration documentation to support the full lifecycle of undersea vehicle electrical systems
* Stay current with relevant technologies in electronics, embedded systems, and undersea robotics, and apply them to improve reliability, performance, and manufacturability


**Who you are:**


* Ability to obtain Top Secret security clearance with eligibility to support special access programs, for which U.S citizenship is needed by the U.S government
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field with at least 5\+ years of relevant hands‑on experience, or a Master's degree in one of these fields with significant practical experience in electronics design and debug (equivalent experience will be considered)
* Practical experience designing and testing analog and digital circuits, including:
	+ Schematic capture and PCB layout using common EDA tool
	+ Board bring‑up, lab testing, and hardware debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related equipment.
* Familiarity with embedded systems and real‑time control applications (e.g., microcontrollers, single‑board computers, FPGAs, or similar platforms)
* Experience integrating sensors and actuators into electronic systems, including understanding of signal integrity, noise mitigation, and power considerations
* Basic proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in embedded or robotics applications (e.g., C/C\+\+, Python) sufficient to interact productively with software teams and perform simple test and diagnostic scripts
* Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and communicate clearly about electrical design decisions, trade‑offs, and limitations
* Strong problem‑solving skills and a hands‑on approach to prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting


**Even Better:**


* Experience designing electronics specifically for marine or harsh environments (pressure, corrosion, moisture, vibration) or other rugged applications
* Exposure to robotic frameworks such as ROS, MOOS‑IvP, UMAA, or similar platforms, and an understanding of how vehicle electronics support autonomy and control
* Familiarity with control systems, sensor fusion concepts, and their implications for hardware design and timing
* Experience with hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) test setups and system‑level simulation
* Experience with agile development methodologies and version control systems (e.g., Git) for managing design files, firmware, and test scripts
* Experience setting performance expectations for advanced or novel UUV designs or sensor systems using modeling, simulation, or analytical tools
* Experience interacting with U.S. Navy or other U.S. Government organization

We are a world\-class team of professionals who deliver next generation technology and products in robotic and autonomous platforms, ground, soldier, and maritime systems in 50\+ locations world\-wide. Much of our work contributes to innovative research in the fields of sensor science, signal processing, data fusion, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and augmented reality (AR).  

QinetiQ US’s dedicated experts in defense, aerospace, security, and related fields all work together to explore new ways of protecting the American Warfighter, Security Forces, and Allies. Being a part of QinetiQ US means being central to the safety and security of the world around us. Partnering with our customers, we help save lives; reduce risks to society; and maintain the global infrastructure on which we all depend. **Why Join QinetiQ US?**  

If you have the courage to take on a wide variety of complex challenges, then you will experience a unique working environment where innovative teams blend different perspectives, disciplines, and technologies to discover new ways of solving complex problems. In our diverse and inclusive environment, you can be authentic, feel valued, be respected, and realize your full potential. Position Overview:

The Senior Systems engineer is responsible for logical and systematic transformation of customer requirements and needs into a total system solution using the best of practice processes and techniques. The candidate will be the primary technical interface with the customer on all processes involved in systems engineering.  

They will be a hands\-on person that will work closely with multi\-disciplined integrated product teams consisting of program managers, software, mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers throughout the product’s lifecycle including requirements development, design, verification/validation, deployment and sustainment. The position supports systems logistics and lifecycle management tasks, as well as various process improvement initiatives within the group.  

The candidate will be capable of performing a wide range of systems engineering functions, including requirements management, verification and validation (V\&V), and test engineering, using expert knowledge of systems engineering or systems engineering management processes to guide product development teams. Knowledge and experience in systems engineering is also desired in the following areas: mission requirements analysis, system hierarchy and specification tree development, functional analysis, systems integration, requirements flowdown and allocation, trade studies, system synthesis, configuration definition and management, risk analysis, and hazard analysis.  

This candidate must have a proven track record as a systems engineer working on development programs in DoD, robotics, and/or imaging systems.

* Use Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) and SysML to define and trace system design
* Development of product design descriptions, requirements and system test documentation, safety analysis reports, and technical analyses against requirements
* Support a system reliability program; gather and analyze reliability data
* Manage key product performance factors at a system level
* Verify and validate system and component performance to specifications
* Support development of test fixtures to validate complex systems, subsystems, and components
* Support hands\-on integration troubleshooting at system and subsystem levels


Required Qualifications:
* Bachelors of Science Degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electrical\-Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering; MS preferred.
* At least five years of relevant industry experience
* Experience with fielded DOD systems and/or prior work in the field of robotics or imaging systems
* Experience working in a multidisciplinary team environment
* Experience working independently and managing priorities and tasks over multiple projects
* Experience with Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) and SysML using MagicDraw
* Experience with requirements management and traceability
* Experience with validation of complex systems
* Experience with Military Standards, such as MIL\-STD\-810, MIL\-STD\-882, MIL\-STD\-461, MIL\-STD\-464

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. The Staff Software Engineer is an experienced software professional with medical device industry knowledge who plays a key role in the development, verification, and commercialization of the Spryte imaging platform and associated medical devices. This position serves as a hands\-on technical contributor, responsible for driving complex software projects, including software architecture, and delivering high\-quality, regulatory\-compliant software solutions. **Essential Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of the Spryte imaging application software and internal software tools.
* Lead and contribute to the definition, implementation, and evolution of robust and scalable software architectures.
* Perform software debugging, code reviews, verification, validation, and automated testing, including unit and integration testing.
* Translate signal processing and image processing algorithms into production\-quality software integrated within the imaging application.
* Design and develop innovative user interfaces and user experiences using modern software technologies.
* Develop rapid prototypes to evaluate new features, user interface concepts, algorithms, and hardware integrations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including systems engineering, marketing, clinical, quality, and regulatory affairs.
* Create, maintain, and review software documentation required for regulatory submissions, product development, and commercialization activities.

* Support intellectual property development, including invention disclosure generation and patent\-related activities.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to other software engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 12 years of software engineering experience, preferably in the medical device industry, with previous experience serving as a technical lead on software development projects.
* Extensive experience with modern C\+\+, including: Object\-oriented design, Multithreaded programming, and software architecture
* Experience with scripting languages. Preferred: Python and JavaScript.
* Experience with the Qt/QML framework for desktop application development.
* Experience developing software in regulated environments, including medical device software development processes.
* Familiarity with software lifecycle standards such as IEC 62304 and ISO 14971\.
* Experience working within FDA, MDR, or other regulated medical device environments.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and requirements for medical devices.
* Expertise in user interface and user experience (UI/UX) development.
* Experience implementing signal processing and image processing algorithms using frameworks such as OpenCV, ITK, or equivalent.
* Experience integrating machine learning models into production software. Experience with PyTorch and model deployment is preferred.
* Experience with DICOM and PACS integration.
* Experience visualizing and rendering medical imaging and biomedical data.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills.

jobs.description:
**Mission Summary:**



The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:


* **Data Processing**: We are building state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user\-friendly, and highly fault\-tolerant.
* **Data Discovery**: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
* **Data Lineage**: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.
  


**What You'll Be Doing:**


* Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
* Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
* Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
* Lead and champion high\-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.
  


**What We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
* BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
* Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
* Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
* Experience with distributed system design and development
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, continuous delivery environment
  


**Bonus Points (not required):**


* Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
* Experience working in cross\-functional development teams
* Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
* Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.
  


**We encourage a hybrid schedule with in\-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.**

  

**\#LI\-AE1**

 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.**


**Our journey is always people first.**



We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.


**Higher purpose, greater impact.**



We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do.


**Scale up, not starting up.**



Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges.



Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer II
jobs.description:
The Automation Engineer II will report to the Automation Engineering Manager and support the development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle maintenance of computerized control systems for KrosFlo large\-scale tangential flow filtration products. This role combines hands\-on controls engineering, structured change management, and cross\-functional execution to deliver reliable automation solutions in a regulated manufacturing environment. The engineer will partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Management, Service, and customers.
**Responsibilities**

  

* Develop, configure, test, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC, HMI, industrial computer, and SCADA applications used in automated process equipment.
* Program and support Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, and AutomationDirect PLC platforms.
* Develop and maintain HMI and SCADA applications using Wonderware System Platform. iFix and AutomationDirect C\-more development a plus.
* Troubleshoot application scripts, SQL queries, system communications, and control\-system interfaces.
* Configure and support industrial networks, including subnets, Network Address Translation, VLANs, and system connectivity.
* Integrate and troubleshoot OPC UA/DA, Modbus TCP/RTU, PROFINET, EtherCAT, and DeltaV connectivity.
* Troubleshoot electrical controls and instrumentation, including control loops, sinking and sourcing signals, and current\- versus voltage\-based devices.
* Apply software version control, documentation control, and formal change\-management practices to released code and system configurations.
* Participate in design reviews, risk reviews, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and deployment of custom automated skids.
* Write and execute clear test scripts and protocols for software FAT, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and system changes.
* Maintain automation standards, reusable templates, test practices, and supporting documentation through controlled change and continuous improvement.
* Provide automation expertise to internal teams, customers, and field personnel during design, build, deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Develop and deliver basic automation training for Manufacturing Associates, Field Service Technicians, and other internal users.
* Define contractor scope, review technical deliverables, track actions, and ensure work meets project, quality, and schedule requirements.
* Promote Repligen’s EHS culture by following safe work practices, identifying hazards or near misses, and supporting corrective actions.

  

**Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:**

  

* BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred. Relevant process\-control, industrial\-automation, or data\-acquisition experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 5\+ years of experience in automation, controls, software, or industrial systems engineering.
* Hands\-on experience programming and troubleshooting PLC\-based control systems and HMI/SCADA applications.
* Experience with Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley preferred. Experience with Siemens/DeltaV a plus.
* Working knowledge of industrial control\-system integration, instrumentation, electrical controls, networks, and communication protocols.
* Ability to read and work from electrical schematics, control narratives, P\&IDs, I/O lists, user requirements, and technical specifications.
* Experience developing and executing structured functional specifications, software design specifications, test protocols, documenting results, and resolving identified issues.
* Working knowledge of software version control, configuration management, and engineering change\-control practices.
* Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated attention to Good Documentation Practices.
* Experience in cGMP, computer system validation, and GAMP 5 environments preferred.
* Programming or scripting experience with Python, VBScript, C/C\+\+, and/or SQL preferred.
* Ability to manage priorities, contractor deliverables, and technical actions with ownership and follow\-through.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills in a fast\-paced engineering and manufacturing environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Demonstrated commitment to safety, PPE requirements, safe work practices, and leading by example in alignment with Repligen R\-Values.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AWS Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Location:** This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.


**The Opportunity**



You will own and shape how Praxis designs, governs, secures, and operates AWS at scale—from account structure and identity to the platforms and applications that run on them. You will be a hands\-on builder, using your depth in cloud infrastructure and software engineering to create secure, reliable systems that enable our teams to move quickly.



You will work at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and operations. You will build and improve the systems that keep our teams moving fast while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, and compliance. You will work primarily in TypeScript and Python, use modern AI tooling as part of your daily engineering workflow, and take direct accountability for production operations, including on\-call.



You will be expected to see problems, take ownership, and drive them through resolution. You will move quickly through incremental, well\-controlled changes, question assumptions when there is a better path, and turn operational learnings into durable improvements. Just as importantly, you will raise the bar for the people and systems around you by sharing what you know, communicating clearly, and helping the broader team build and operate better.


**Primary Responsibilities**


* Own and evolve AWS architecture for enterprise workloads, including multi\-account foundations, landing zone / Control Tower patterns, networking, security baselines, and shared platforms.
* Establish and continuously improve AWS governance, including organizational structure, SCPs, tagging, cost controls, compliance, audit readiness, and durable operational standards.
* Design and operate identity and access across AWS, including IAM, IAM Identity Center, and Microsoft Entra ID integrations for SSO, federation, role mapping, access reviews, and least\-privilege access.
* Build, harden, and operate AWS platforms and full\-stack services using TypeScript and Python, including compute, containers, serverless, data stores, messaging, and cloud automation as needed.
* Drive operational excellence across AWS platforms and workloads by building effective monitoring, alerting, dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, runbooks, incident response practices, and durable fixes to recurring problems; participate in the on\-call rotation and own incidents through resolution and learning.
* Automate infrastructure and delivery through Infrastructure as Code—preferably Pulumi and/or SST—and CI/CD using Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions, with an emphasis on safe, incremental delivery and low blast radius.
* Partner across engineering and IT to translate needs into secure, maintainable solutions, improve production readiness and operational practices, mentor other engineers, and use sound judgment to move fast without breaking things.


**Qualifications**


* Senior\-level software engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on experience building and operating production systems on AWS.
* Strong full\-stack engineering capability in TypeScript and Python, including APIs, services, tooling, and cloud automation.
* Deep experience with core AWS services used in enterprise environments, including IAM, Organizations, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, CloudWatch, KMS, Config, and GuardDuty.
* Proven ability to design and operate AWS governance at scale, including multi\-account strategy, policy guardrails, access control, security standards, and operational controls.
* Strong AWS networking fundamentals, including VPNs, peering, Transit Gateway, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with enterprise SSO; Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) federation into AWS is strongly preferred, including SAML/OIDC, IAM Identity Center, application and role mapping, and access lifecycle practices.
* Experience working in regulated or audit\-ready environments, with strong habits around change control, evidence and traceability, least privilege, and durable controls.
* Demonstrated operational ownership: able to establish meaningful alerts and monitors, reduce noise, improve reliability, respond to incidents, and turn operational learnings into engineering improvements.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience; Pulumi and/or SST strongly preferred. Terraform or AWS CDK experience is transferable and welcome.
* Experience with Bitbucket Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions.
* Proficient with modern AI coding and productivity tools, with the judgment to validate outputs, test changes, manage risk, and maintain production quality.
* The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**  

  

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and *their* people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company\-paid life insurance, AD\&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar\-for\-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long\-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company\-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let's achieve the impossible together!

General Motors is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to shape and scale the engineering platforms that build, test, integrate, validate, and deliver embedded software for software\-defined vehicles. * Experience shipping high quality safety critical products.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail.

* Demonstrated ability to work in an action\-oriented decision\-making environment.

* Strong Terraform/IaC experience with production‑grade module design.
* Experience with embedded or simulation workflows (vECUs, SIL, FMU, SSP).
Cloud architecture experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Master's degree in software engineering or equivalent experience
* 15\+ years of experience in software development .
* Experience in automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, or another embedded, real\-time, regulated, or safety\-critical environment.

* Experience with vehicle\-level integration and validation, including SIL, CoSIM, vECU, HIL, benches, physical systems, or other virtual and hardware\-based environments.
* A record of creating enterprise standards, platform strategies, technical communities, developer self\-service, reliability objectives, or measurable productivity improvements.

Advanced degree in a related technical field.

jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Technician (Client Opening)
jobs.description:
**About Treetown Tech**



Treetown Tech is an engineering and manufacturing company that takes ideas from a napkin sketch through low\-rate production, under one roof. Our teams work side by side across mechanical, manufacturing, electrical, software, and battery engineering to design, build, and manufacture hardware for clients ranging from early\-stage hardware startups to established aerospace, battery, and semiconductor companies.



Our team has built and shipped hardware behind UAV flight controllers, battery management systems and charging electronics, semiconductor test equipment, and industrial automation and control systems. If you like seeing a design go from a schematic to a working prototype to something that ships, you'll find real variety here.


**About the Opportunity**



Treetown Tech is looking for an on\-site, experienced, full\-time Electrical Engineering Technician. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is experienced in building real hardware alongside diverse engineering teams.



You'll fit well here if you keep an organized work area, are deeply committed to cooperation and communication, take safety and quality seriously as a matter of habit rather than compliance, and are comfortable digging into a variety of tasks in a fast\-paced, multi\-disciplined team.



Treetown Tech offers competitive compensation and benefits including healthcare, IRA matching, and generous PTO and sick time.


**What You'll Do**


**Solder \& Assembly**


* Perform PCB assembly including surface\-mount and through\-hole soldering, using solder pencils, hot\-air reflow, and reflow ovens.
* Handle general and rework soldering across a mix of straightforward assembly runs and more detailed, time\-critical rework or design changes.


**Wiring \& Harness Building**


* Build wiring harnesses and wire for AC and DC circuits, including industrial automation wiring, wire end termination/crimping, and connector assembly.
* Read schematics, wiring diagrams, and eCAD to build to print, working collaboratively with the designer or engineer on the project.


**Electrical Testing**


* Support electrical test activities such as charge/discharge testing and end\-of\-line test.
* Collect and record test data accurately and diligently.
* Follow and complete internal quality control documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**


* Keep your work area organized and follow safety protocols and quality standards on every task.
* Flag issues or quality concerns as they come up rather than working around them.


**PLC Cabinet Wiring (bonus capability – not required)**


* PLC cabinet wiring and fluency with wiring diagram/schematic conventions used in cabinet builds.
* Fabrication and assembly of PLC cabinets.
* PLC cabinet testing and quality control.


**What We’re Looking For**


* Electrical shop experience, and comfort working in a fast\-paced, multi\-disciplined team.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbally, with coworkers.
* A habit of showing up on time and staying on task throughout the day.
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to know when to ask for help rather than guess.
* Eagerness to roll with frequent design changes that come with R\&D and prototypes.
* Openness to receiving direction and training from others, and to navigating changing priorities.
* Genuine care for the wellbeing of the people around them. A true team player.
* Driven to reduce cost, complexity, and time for themselves and those around them.
* Ability to lift loads of up to 50 lbs.


**Additional Nice to Haves, but Not Required**


* Soldering/rework certification (IPC or similar).
* Prior troubleshooting experience on machine or PLC electrical systems.
* Experience with small\-scale line manufacturing.
* Experience with parts ordering and inventory.
* Forklift certification.
* Experience coordinating directly with external vendors.

  


*This organization provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Systems Engineer-IT
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:** Challenge Manufacturing’s mission is to manufacture with operational excellence by empowering our employee\-owners. As a leading tier 1 supplier of complex metal assemblies for the global automotive industry, we drive innovative solutions for future mobility. We believe the best ideas come from individual unique perspectives. These ideas combined with the teamwork of industry leaders allow us to accomplish any challenge. Our team members take pride in the work we do and embody our core values of safety, ownership, and teamwork every day; they are the true driving force in our operations.

  

Challenge is proud to be one of the largest employee\-owned automotive companies in North America. One of the many benefits of joining the Challenge team is the ESOP program. This program allows Challenge to give shares of the Company to all employee\-owners annually. These shares are an additional retirement benefit that will continue to grow during your time at Challenge. Being part of an ESOP means our employee\-owners share in Challenge’s success!

  

Challenge is *\#QualityDriven and \#PeoplePowered!*

 **Who We Want:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented, proactive, and technically skilled Systems Engineer to join our IT Infrastructure team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting core server infrastructure across both Windows Server and Linux environments.


The ideal candidate will manage enterprise services such as Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Exchange, PKI, Microsoft System Center, Nutanix AHV/Hyper\-V, and SAN storage, while driving automation, performance optimization, and security best practices. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy balancing innovation with reliability, we would like to hear from you.

**What You'll Do:**

* Design and engineer infrastructure solutions to meet project and operational requirements.
* Build, configure, patch, and maintain Windows and Linux servers according to best practices.
* Administer and optimize Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Microsoft Exchange, PKI, and Microsoft System Center.
* Implement and support virtualization platforms (Nutanix AHV, Hyper\-V) and manage SAN storage infrastructure.
* Monitor system health, track KPIs, perform tuning, and conduct capacity planning for physical and virtual environments.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, and process workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity problems quickly and effectively.
* Ensure systems are secure through regular patching, adherence to security best practices, and proactive threat hunting using SIEM platforms.
* Oversee and enhance backup processes to safeguard data integrity and availability.
* Prepare and deliver audit reports and provide clear documentation to support compliance and management requirements.
* Recommend and implement automated approaches to improve efficiency and reduce manual tasks.
* Administer Microsoft licensing for compliance/cost optimization and manage email security solutions to prevent phishing, malware, and unauthorized access.
* Work flexibly with other departments and share knowledge
* Participate in IT on\-call rotation and maintain availability outside of normal business hours to respond to critical system outages, emergencies, and other business impacting incidents as needed.

**When and Where:**  

This will be a **8am \- 4:30pm M\-F** position located at our **Corporate Office** in **Walker, MI**  

Occasionally, this may require you to arrive early, stay late, or work on weekends, outside of our regular hours, to ensure we successfully meet customer needs, deadlines, or urgent requests.

**What You Need to Have:**


Required Qualifications:

* Associates degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
* 3\+ years of network/support experience.
* Proven experience with Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Hands\-on expertise in Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Exchange, PKI, and System Center.
* Experience with virtualization technologies (Nutanix AHV, Hyper\-V).
* Experience with security tools such as; Sentinel One, Cisco Umbrella, Duo, and Cisco ISE.
* Familiarity with SAN infrastructure and performance monitoring.
* Experience with SCCM and Intune.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft products.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
* Customer\-focused mindset with urgency in addressing business needs.
* Willingness to work weekends and after\-hours to support scheduled maintenance or projects.


Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5\+ years of network/support experience.
* Experience with automated infrastructure management and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) in hybrid environments.
* Prior experience in enterprise\-scale, manufacturing, or global business environments.

jobs.title: Power Systems Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description


Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

  

SEL manufactures intelligent electronic devices (IED), Remote Terminal Units (RTU), and logic controllers that provide state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, communication, and protection of power systems in multiple industries.

  

SEL Engineering Services (SEL ES) is the sector of SEL that creates solutions to target applications of SEL equipment for worldwide customers. The SEL ES engineering team designs, develops, tests, and commissions projects to meet our customers’ requirements. Applications include, but are not limited to:

* Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution
* Industrial Plants and Universities– Substation and Switchgear
* Renewables – Wind, Solar, and BESS

  

SEL ES \- Automation projects focus on data collection of system IEDs, logic controls, and the presentation of data for the customer to monitor and control their power system.


Utilizing real\-time logic controllers and communication equipment, the SEL ES Automation engineer owns the planning, design, development, testing and commissioning of the project. Projects often include, but are not limited to:

* Communication network equipment
* Configuration of real\-time controllers to serve as RTUs.
* Human Machine Interface (HMI) or server to an upstream SCADA client.
* Configuration of real\-time controllers to perform custom logic such as automatic system fault location, isolation and restoration.
* Configuration of workstations for power system analytic software

 **Position:**

* Project Engineer \- Automation

 **Position Experience Requirement:**

* Minimum of 7\+ years
* Past work history, or equivalency, to meet position description and skill requirements

 **Position Description:**

* Working alongside Project Managers, Technical Leads, and Engineers from other focus areas
* Technical leading to assist Project Managers and Salesforce in planning applications for customers
* Joins customer meetings to provide SEL equipment expertise and recommendations for future and active projects
* Defines and oversees the execution of multiple objectives with minimal guidance and general high\-level direction
* Research of SEL equipment, third\-party equipment and solutions
* Branching into OT network solutions (Layer 1, Layer 2 Architecture and Applications Data Flow)
* Research of emerging technologies and trends within and beyond their focus area.
* Mentors their project team and teaches others in their disciplines.
* Reviews and certifies deliverables for quality standards prior to customer submittal
* Automation Design Specifications and drawings
* Product configurations
* Factory testing and procedures
* Field safety preparations and commissioning procedures
* Service reports
* Technical lead of the project engineering team that will define deliverables, schedule, and project execution from design through commissioning.

 **Position skill requirements:**

* Understanding of project engineering scope in relation to project budget (labor and equipment)
* Ownership of schedule and a self\-starter for research
* Professional communication skills to be the direct technical contact for customers and colleagues.
* Designing of control logic schemes and network configurations
* Ability to analyze electrical one\-line drawings, DC/AC Schematics, and Bill of Materials
* Experience with industry standard communication protocols (IEC\-61850, DNP, Modbus, etc.)
* Experience with server/client SCADA applications
* Experience with design/development suite of HMI applications
* Willing to travel at least 50% of the time domestically and abroad

 **Additions skills but not requirements:**

* Experience with phase I/O style project management
* Experience with SEL product configurations
* Experience with IEC\-61131 programming
* Experience with Python programming
* Experience with IT/OT Network design
* Experience with IT/OT Network troubleshooting (Wireshark)
* Substation safety training
* Work from home experience

**Location Information: We are open to MULTIPLE locations**

**Houston, TX**\-This position is on\-site located in Houston, TX. Ranked America's fourth largest city, whatever your interest you will find it here. Enjoy sports teams, world class dining, and first rate entertainment. Enjoy signature Houston attractions like Space Center Houston and The Grand Opera. Escape the city with easy beach access just one hour away. Houston offers exceptional schools and universities, making it a great place to live and work.


**West Lafayette, IN** – This position is located in West Lafayette, IN, a welcoming community that combines small\-town charm with the energy of world\-class university town. Home to Purdue University, the area is known for its innovation, strong schools, and vibrant community. Residents enjoy parks and outdoor recreation, local events, diverse dining options, and an affordable cost of living, all while being conveniently located within driving distance of Indianapolis and Chicago.

========================================================================================================================================================================================================================

  

  

**Who Are We?**


The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota\-based company that has been in business since 1914\. We pride ourselves on providing world class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to venues such as St. Andrews Links and Target Field, we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100 years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place in the Twin Cities to build a career.

  

  

The Electrical Systems Engineer will be working to advance electrified, automated, and smart connected products within The Toro Company’s Landscapes and Contractor Engineering Division, driving system level electrification, hybrid\-electric, and controls solutions across electromechanical products. This role is the nexus between mechanical, electrical, software, marketing, and systems, turning customer needs into architected designs, prototypes, and production ready platforms. You will lead fast fail experiments, mature designs through validation, and champion quality, safety, and cost from concept through launch.

  

  

**What Will You Do?**


In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:

  

  

**System Architecture, Electrification \& Controls**


* Own electrical and controls at the system level for electro mechanical machines, including requirements, architectures, interfaces, diagnostics, and verification plans.
* Architect, select, and integrate system components (motors, inverters, batteries, chargers, sensors, switches, and harnesses) to meet performance, durability, manufacturability, safety, and cost targets.
* Develop and tune controls systems for machine applications, including motors, actuators, and power\-stage electronics.
  

  

**Firmware / Software \& Model Based Engineering**


* Design and implement embedded control functionality for motors and machines (including C/C\+\+, RTOS, and state based architectures) in collaboration with firmware/software teams.
* Support development with model based tools (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW) to develop control algorithms, simulations, and HIL/SIL environments that support rapid development and validation.
  

  

**Electro Mechanical Integration \& Prototyping**


* Lead hands on prototyping, instrumentation, and integration of electrical, mechanical, and software systems to evaluate concepts and mature designs.
* Identify emerging technologies, develop innovative concepts and product proposals aimed at meeting targeted market requirements or addressing distinct customer challenges.
* Apply strong mechanical aptitude to mounting, cooling, sealing, and EMC considerations; support CAD and modeling activities for layouts, space claims, and harness routing.
* Execute fast fail experiments and structured testing to quickly learn, iterate, and reduce technical risk.
  

  

**Validation, Safety \& Compliance**


* Plan and execute system level validation using schematics, oscilloscopes, meters, DAQ systems, computer simulation methods, and data analysis to verify performance, durability, and reliability.
* Support compliance activities in partnership with regulatory teams and external labs for EMC, safety, and functional safety requirements.
  

  

**Cross Functional Delivery**


* Operate as the technical nexus between mechanical, electrical, software, marketing, systems, and other groups to align solutions with customer needs and program objectives.
* Contribute to feasibility studies, concept development, and production launch activities within cross functional teams.
* Support existing products through troubleshooting, debugging, and product improvement activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation including system requirements, DFMEAs, test plans, and design review materials.
* Provide day to day technical guidance to junior engineers and collaborate effectively with suppliers.
* Collaborate with the Legal team regarding possible patent initiatives and strategies to minimize liability.
* Occasionally travel to test sites, suppliers, distributors, customers, manufacturing facilities, and others as required.
  

  

**What Do You Need?**


To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:


* B.S. or M.S. Degree in Electrical, Mechatronics, or related Engineering field from an ABET accredited university required.
* **Engineer II\-2\-4 years** experience in consumer or industrial product development, having taken electromechanical systems from concept through production, demonstrated technical competency, engineering decision making and judgement.
* **Engineer III\-5\-7 years** experience in consumer or industrial product development, having taken electromechanical systems from concept through production, demonstrated technical competency, engineering decision making and judgement
* **Engineer IV\-8\+ years** experience in consumer or industrial product development, having taken electromechanical systems from concept through production, demonstrated technical competency, engineering decision making and judgement

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description:
The Mechatronics Engineer position is a technical leadership role within Operations that serves as a liaison between manufacturing engineering, product engineering, quality, and production teams. The role focuses on developing, implementing, and improving automated manufacturing systems, controls, robotics, and industrial equipment to enhance efficiency, quality, reliability, and safety. The engineer leads projects, supports new product launches, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and provides technical expertise for troubleshooting and process optimization. The position is reported to the Manufacturing \& Industrial Engineering Manager.  

  

Qualification 1: Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, or a related technical field.  

Qualification 2: 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing, automation, controls, or maintenance engineering within an industrial environment.  

Qualification 3: Demonstrates expertise in PLC programming, troubleshooting, modification, and commissioning, with the ability to diagnose complex control\-related issues and restore equipment to reliable operation. Experience should also include HMI configuration, machine interface development, industrial sensors, servo systems, variable frequency drives, and industrial communication networks.  

Qualification 4: Strong hands\-on experience with industrial robotics and automated manufacturing systems, including robot programming, troubleshooting, integration, optimization, and production support. Experience integrating robotics with other manufacturing equipment, controls, sensors, welding systems, or vision applications is preferred.  

Qualification 5: Strong electro\-mechanical troubleshooting skills, including the ability to diagnose equipment issues and read electrical schematics and technical drawings.  

Qualification 6: Experience with manufacturing data and production monitoring systems, including MES, SCADA, historian platforms, industrial data collection systems, and OEE analytics. Must be able to use manufacturing data to identify performance losses, equipment trends, downtime causes, quality concerns, and opportunities for process improvement.  

Qualification 7: Working knowledge of machine safety, functional safety systems, risk assessments, safety relays/PLCs, machine guarding, and LOTO requirements.  

Qualification 8: Strong project management, vendor coordination, and cross\-functional leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities.  

Qualification 9: Strong root cause analysis and structured problem\-solving capabilities using tools such as 5\-Why analysis, Fishbone/Ishikawa diagrams, FMEA, fault isolation, and other analytical problem\-solving methods. Must be capable of moving beyond short\-term equipment fixes and implementing sustainable corrective actions that prevent recurrence. Familiarity with predictive maintenance and AI/ML manufacturing applications.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Description: **IMPORTANT APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Applicants must live within a reasonable commuting distance of St. Charles, Missouri, at the time of application to be considered for this position. We do not provide relocation assistance and this role is fully onsite.
* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. TRUE does not provide or assume sponsorships.


TRUE Fitness is looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our engineering team and help design, test, troubleshoot, and improve the electrical systems behind our fitness equipment. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with both hardware and systems, and seeing their work become a real product.


You’ll work across electrical and electronic systems—from motors and control boards to wiring, sensors, power components, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). You’ll collaborate with engineering and other teams to ensure our products are safe, reliable, manufacturable, and perform as intended.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide technical support and engineering expertise for electrical systems used in fitness equipment, including:


AC and DC power systems


AC and DC motors and control boards


Linear actuators


Motor\-driven pulley conveyors


EMI filters


Capacitors, inductors, resistors, switches, and circuit breakers


Cables, wiring, and related electrical components

* Read, interpret, and follow electrical schematics to analyze and troubleshoot electrical systems.
* Design and create interface cables, wiring diagrams, schematics, and cable assemblies using CAD tools.
* Test and troubleshoot electrical and electronic systems using a variety of test equipment, including:


Digital multimeters


Oscilloscopes


Immunity test generators


Spectrum analyzers


Power meters

* Apply techniques to identify and reduce radiated and conducted electrical disturbances.
* Develop and perform testing of electrical products and components.
* Design and fabricate test fixtures, devices, and equipment needed to support product testing and validation.
* Review and evaluate engineering changes from internal engineering teams and outside suppliers or engineering firms.
* Maintain accurate digital engineering records, test documentation, and project information.
* Provide routine project and testing progress updates.
* Work collaboratively with engineering, product development, manufacturing, quality, and other teams to resolve technical issues and improve products.
* Support other engineering projects and initiatives as needed.

**What You Bring**


Required:

* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* At least 2 years of experience with:


Analog and digital circuits


Electrical system analysis


Electrical troubleshooting


Project management

* Experience using CAD software to create wiring diagrams, schematics, and cable assemblies.
* Experience with Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and electrical disturbance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.

**What You'll Get to Work On**


This isn't an engineering role where you'll spend all day behind a desk. You'll have opportunities to design, test, troubleshoot, build, and improve real products. You'll work directly with electrical and electronic components and help solve problems throughout the product development and manufacturing process.


If you enjoy figuring out why something isn't working, designing a better solution, and seeing that solution make its way into a finished product, we'd like to hear from you.

**Travel**


This position requires infrequent domestic and international travel.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Through the use of DevSecOps and Agile practices, we continue to evolve how we deliver critical national defense products and capabilities for the warfighter. This position supports the OIX program \- a platform which provides secure messaging and cross\-domain solution (CDS) products and services across the federal agencies and foreign partners. Our multi\-disciplinary team including software, systems, cyber, and test engineers employ the latest cutting\-edge technologies to deliver information across security domains.

* **Active Secret security clearance** enrolled in Continuous Evaluation, and ability to obtain TS/SCI

* Demonstrated ability to analyze system requirements to derive software design and performance requirements

* Experience with Git\-based or other software configuration management tools

* Experience implementing Cyber Security controls on Linux
* Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
