jobs.title: Next Gen Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability \& Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!  

  

About the Role:  

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross\-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state\-of\-the\-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence.  

  

What Do We Offer?  

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire\-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

  

You will apply Subject Matter Expertise (SME) on troubleshooting and dive deeps for engineering issues, supporting automation engineers to investigate the root cause and planning actions to eliminate/mitigate the downtime of critical assets  

You will collaborate with building Operations, Operations Engineering teams, FC Start\-up Team, AFT Software teams, ACES team, and Safety to support MHE systems optimization and project implementation  

You will understand, maintain and troubleshoot material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers and industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems  

You will monitor MHE metrics and partner with maintenance/operations to address system performance issues and provide analysis across all operations  

You will provide escalation support to automation engineers, during and after business hours, troubleshooting locally and remotely, to ensure that all hardware or controls software within the building is repaired on time  

You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 4\+ years of PLC programming or automation engineering experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* 4\+ years of process or production environment related PLC\-controlled automation and issue diagnosis experience
* 4\+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
* 4\+ years of Siemens, Allen\-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
* 4\+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
* Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
* Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
* Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
* Experience interpreting and modifying mechanical and electrical drawings

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

**Purpose**


The Process Controls Engineer supports the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the Texas facility through the design, implementation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of process control systems, automation technologies, instrumentation, and electrical distribution equipment. This role provides technical expertise for capital projects, process optimization, equipment reliability initiatives, and troubleshooting efforts while partnering with Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering to improve plant performance and support business objectives.

Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) is focused on making electric power safer, more reliable, and more economical.

SEL Engineering Services (SEL ES) is the sector of SEL that creates solutions to target applications of SEL equipment for worldwide customers. * Utilities – Generation, Transmission and Distribution
* Industrial Plants and Universities– Substation and Switchgear
* Renewables – Wind, Solar, and BESS

jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**


Job Summary  

  

Primoris Services Corporation is seeking a highly motivated and skilled Electrical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and implementation of electrical systems for our diverse infrastructure projects. This role involves applying electrical engineering principles to ensure the efficient and safe operation of power distribution, control systems, and related electrical components.  

  

Job Responsibilities  

  

* Design, develop, and test electrical systems and components for various projects, including power generation, transmission, and distribution.
* Prepare detailed electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and equipment specifications in compliance with industry standards and project requirements.
* Perform calculations for load analysis, voltage drop, short circuit, and protective device coordination.
* Conduct site visits to gather information, assess existing conditions, and oversee the installation and commissioning of electrical systems.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including civil, mechanical, and structural engineers, to integrate electrical designs into overall project plans.
* Develop and implement testing procedures for electrical equipment and systems to ensure performance and reliability.
* Troubleshoot electrical issues and provide solutions during project execution and post\-completion.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant electrical codes, safety regulations, and environmental standards.
* Prepare technical reports, project documentation, and cost estimates for electrical components.
* Stay abreast of new technologies, industry trends, and best practices in electrical engineering.

  

Job Qualifications\*\*  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the heavy civil, industrial, or utilities sectors.
* Proficiency in electrical design software (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, ETAP, SKM PowerTools).
* Strong understanding of National Electrical Code (NEC) and other relevant electrical standards.
* Experience with power distribution systems, control circuits, and instrumentation.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical specifications.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.

jobs.description:

Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what we can accomplish together. Do you love crafting elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Apple’s Platform Architecture group is seeking an experienced systems engineer, who will support our current, as well as develop new hardware/software interface technologies for chip development and verification. jobs.title: Advanced Product Development & Integration Engineer - Embedded Systems & Autonomy
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


SPiDRWORX is looking for a hands\-on Embedded Systems \& Autonomy Engineer to join our Advanced Product Development \& Integration team developing multi\-domain unmanned systems (UxS) across air, ground, and maritime environments. The team rapidly evaluates emerging technologies, builds new capabilities, and transitions successful concepts toward fielded products for defense customers.


In this role, you will work where hardware meets software and where software meets decision\-making: bringing up embedded electronics, developing and modifying firmware, integrating vehicle\-control stacks and onboard computers, and building or integrating the autonomy behaviors, navigation, and mission\-planning software that let unmanned systems operate with reduced human oversight — including in GPS\-denied or communications\-degraded environments. You will work closely with electrical, mechanical, RF/datalink, autonomy, test, and manufacturing engineers and will support bench and field testing across multiple vehicle domains.


This role is a strong fit for an engineer who is equally comfortable with a logic analyzer, a code editor, and an autonomy stack; enjoys debugging complex hardware/software interactions; and wants to see their code making real decisions on real vehicles in the field.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Research \& Embedded Architecture**

* Evaluate microcontrollers, compute platforms, sensors, autopilots, software frameworks, and partner technologies through hands\-on testing and rapid prototyping.
* Build proof\-of\-concept integrations to validate new capabilities and customer requirements before full development.
* Support architecture and trade studies considering compute performance, latency, size, weight, power, cost, software maturity, and integration risk.

**Firmware Development \& Hardware Bring\-Up**

* Develop and maintain C/C\+\+ firmware for vehicle controllers, payload electronics, motor\-control interfaces, and custom embedded boards.
* Work in bare\-metal and RTOS environments on microcontrollers such as ARM Cortex\-M/STM32\.
* Bring up new hardware, including power and clock validation, boot configuration, peripheral setup, communications interfaces, and low\-level drivers.
* Develop and integrate drivers for sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GNSS/INS, cameras, gimbals, rangefinders, radar, and LiDAR.

**Vehicle Software \& Compute Integration**

* Configure, modify, and extend vehicle\-control software such as Betaflight, ArduPilot, and PX4 for FPV, multirotor, fixed\-wing, ground, and maritime platforms.
* Integrate embedded Linux computers, including NVIDIA Jetson and similar edge\-compute platforms, with vehicle controllers, cameras, sensors, payloads, and autonomy applications.
* Develop system interfaces using MAVLink, ROS 2, DroneCAN, uORB, or custom messaging and APIs.
* Integrate third\-party sensors, payloads, and customer\-requested capabilities at the firmware and vehicle\-software layers.
* Integrate autonomy stacks and behavior\-execution frameworks (e.g., ROS 2 nodes, behavior trees, or custom mission\-planning software) with vehicle controllers and onboard compute.

**Autonomy Software \& Behaviors**

* Develop and integrate autonomy software for navigation, path/motion planning, obstacle avoidance, and mission execution across single\- and multi\-vehicle scenarios.
* Implement or integrate state estimation and sensor fusion (EKF/UKF, GNSS/INS, visual\-inertial odometry) to support reliable navigation in GPS\-denied or degraded environments.
* Support multi\-agent/swarm coordination behaviors, including task allocation, formation control, and collaborative mission planning across teamed unmanned systems.
* Combine classical autonomy techniques with machine\-learning components (e.g., perception, reinforcement learning) to improve robustness and adaptability of vehicle behaviors.
* Build and maintain simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments to develop, regression\-test, and verify autonomy behaviors before field deployment.
* Analyze flight/mission logs to diagnose autonomy failures, tune behavior parameters, and drive continuous improvement of planning and decision\-making software.

**Networking, Video \& Datalink Interfaces**

* Develop and integrate software/network interfaces for command and control, telemetry, video, and data services over vehicle datalinks.
* Troubleshoot latency, packet loss, connectivity, addressing, routing, streaming, and application\-level link behavior.
* Partner with RF/datalink and electrical engineers on radio integration while owning the embedded software, network, and protocol interfaces.

**Verification, Troubleshooting \& Productization**

* Build and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop and software\-in\-the\-loop test environments where practical.
* Support bench, flight, ground, and on\-water testing, including test preparation, log review, data analysis, and post\-test troubleshooting.
* Debug issues that cross firmware, operating systems, networking, and hardware, particularly failures that appear only under real\-world conditions.
* Develop Python scripts and engineering tools for testing, log analysis, automation, and manufacturing support.
* Support firmware releases, configuration control, code/design reviews, manufacturing test tools, customer demonstrations, and field test events.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2\+ years of embedded development experience on physical hardware, preferably for unmanned systems, robotics, aerospace, marine, automotive, or defense applications.
* Strong programming skills in C and C\+\+.
* Experience with ARM Cortex\-M/STM32 or similar microcontrollers and bare\-metal or RTOS development such as FreeRTOS, ChibiOS, NuttX, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with embedded interfaces

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

Fortem is looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a passion for solving difficult problems. In this role you will primarily be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving DroneHunter’s ability to autonomously seek and capture targets safely.


The ideal candidate combines technical expertise in embedded systems with architectural thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and a passion for building reliable, safety\-critical drone platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and test flight control and autonomy software, including state estimation, sensor fusion, and control loops
* Develop navigation and path\-planning algorithms, including obstacle avoidance and GPS/GNSS\-based positioning
* Build and maintain firmware for flight controllers and embedded hardware, working within real\-time constraints
* Implement communication protocols for telemetry, command\-and\-control, and failsafe/lost\-link scenarios
* Contribute to ground control station software for mission planning, monitoring, and post\-flight analysis
* Build and run hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) simulations to validate software before field testing
* Collaborate closely with hardware, mechanical, and regulatory/compliance teams to ensure system\-level reliability
* Participate in field testing and flight trials, iterating quickly based on real\-world results
* Write clean, well\-documented, and testable code, and participate in code reviews
* Other software engineering tasks and projects as assigned by engineering leadership


Requirements:
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, ideally in robotics, aerospace, embedded systems, or autonomous vehicles
* Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and/or Python; experience with real\-time or embedded systems is a plus
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment with frequent hardware testing
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to debug complex, multi\-layered systems (hardware \+ software)
* Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, debugging, and code review workflows
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2, PX4, or ArduPilot
* Understanding of communication protocols (MAVLink, UART, CAN, etc.)
* Part 107 Remote Pilot License

 **ABOUT US**


Fortem Technologies is the global leader in airspace security, delivering advanced solutions that protect against today’s autonomous aerial threats while ensuring the safety of tomorrow’s advanced air mobility. Fortem’s AI\-powered SkyDome® Family of Systems combines TrueView™ sensors, command\-and\-control software, and autonomous DroneHunter® interceptors to defend military, government, and commercial operations worldwide from hostile or unauthorized drones. Fortem is the only company authorized to deploy a drone\-on\-drone kinetic interceptor in U.S. airspace, and its technology has been validated in operational deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia.


Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Fortem is privately held and backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, AE Industrial Partners, AIM13, Signia Venture Partners, and others.

*Fortem Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We believe that diversity drives innovation and makes us stronger.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Integration
jobs.description:
Description:

Fortem Technologies is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (C\+\+) to lead the integration of third\-party sensors and mitigation systems into Fortem’s established SkyDome Family of Systems. In this role, you will design and build robust C\+\+ software that connects new radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic, and mitigator hardware into Fortem’s command\-and\-control platform, enabling rapid onboarding of best\-in\-class third\-party technology alongside Fortem’s own TrueView sensors and DroneHunter interceptors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or higher) software that integrates third\-party sensors (radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic) and mitigation systems (RF jammers, kinetic interceptors) into the SkyDome command\-and\-control platform
* Develop and maintain driver/interface layers, SDKs, and protocol adapters (e.g., ASTERIX, NMEA, proprietary vendor APIs) for new sensor and mitigator integrations
* Partner with hardware, systems engineering, and product teams to define integration requirements and interface control documents (ICDs)
* Build and maintain automated test harnesses to validate sensor and mitigator data fidelity and system\-level performance
* Debug and resolve real\-time data processing and multi\-threading issues across distributed sensor networks
* Participate in design and code reviews, upholding high standards for reliability and maintainability
* Support field testing and deployment of newly integrated capabilities at customer sites
* Other engineering duties and tasks as assigned by the Director of Software Engineering or otehr engineering leadership


Requirements:
**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience in C\+\+, with required proficiency in C\+\+17 or higher
* Experience integrating third\-party hardware/sensors (radar, RF, EO/IR, acoustic) via serial, Ethernet, or custom protocols
* Strong understanding of multi\-threaded, real\-time, and networked systems programming
* Experience developing in Linux\-based environments
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross\-functionally with hardware and systems teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with counter\-UAS, radar, or other defense/aerospace systems
* Familiarity with ASTERIX, DDS, ROS/ROS2, or similar sensor fusion middleware
* Experience with sensor fusion, track correlation, or multi\-sensor data processing
* Active or ability to obtain a U.S. government security clearance
* Experience with containerized deployment (Docker/Kubernetes)

**ABOUT US**


Fortem Technologies is the global leader in airspace security, delivering advanced solutions that protect against today’s autonomous aerial threats while ensuring the safety of tomorrow’s advanced air mobility. Fortem’s AI\-powered SkyDome® Family of Systems combines TrueView™ sensors, command\-and\-control software, and autonomous DroneHunter® interceptors to defend military, government, and commercial operations worldwide from hostile or unauthorized drones. Fortem is the only company authorized to deploy a drone\-on\-drone kinetic interceptor in U.S. airspace, and its technology has been validated in operational deployments across Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia.


Headquartered in Lindon, Utah, Fortem is privately held and backed by Lockheed Martin, DCVC, Toshiba, AE Industrial Partners, AIM13, Signia Venture Partners, and others.

*Fortem Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We believe that diversity drives innovation and makes us stronger.*

Most of our projects are one\-of\-a\-kind, which means you will never be stagnant and will always work on something new and compelling. And, by “work,” we don’t just mean “analyze and design” – most of our engineers do not simply sit behind a desk, but when the design is done choose to “get their hands dirty” assisting with building and testing their creations. Do you love working with connected devices, automation, and real\-world systems? Have you automated your own home, built integrations across smart devices, or thought deeply about how cloud software should control physical systems reliably?

**Who Are We?**


At Parry Labs we believe the modern combat advantage relies on the speed and scale of open systems. We’re redefining the edge of the ever\-changing and increasingly ever\-changing battlespace by delivering game changing capabilities to our warfighters through digital engineering, software, and hardware solutions that are essential to our core of being a Digital Systems Integrator.


Born digital and agile, Parry Labs is building a winning team to be the premier provider for Next Generation Mission Systems Integration across air, land, sea, space and cyber.


Are you ready to be an instrumental part of experts in the industry? Join us in the innovation of integration at Parry and apply to help develop the technologies of tomorrow while reaching new heights in your career today.

**About the Job**


You will build and test Rust software for distributed mission systems under senior engineer guidance. You will develop defined components, investigate defects and learn systems programming through code reviews and integration work. You will report to a functional software engineering manager, with technical direction from the Chief Engineer.


The target start is November 2026\.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Implement defined Rust components and fixes from agreed requirements with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write unit and integration tests for expected behavior, error handling and boundary conditions.
* Debug software issues using logs, tests and development tools. Document steps to reproduce defects.
* Build simple interfaces, message handling and telemetry features using established team designs.
* Use Cargo, Git and automated checks to build, test and submit changes for review.
* Participate in code reviews and apply feedback on correctness, readability and memory safety.
* Support laboratory integration and test activities with software, systems and security engineers.
* Maintain setup instructions and component documentation. Communicate progress and raise technical blockers early.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field, or equivalent training and practical experience.
* Hands\-on programming experience through coursework, internships, personal projects or employment. Prior full\-time engineering experience is not required.
* Working knowledge of Rust ownership, borrowing, basic types and error handling, plus Cargo build and test workflows.
* Understanding of basic data structures, functions and software testing. Ability to explain and debug your own code.
* Familiarity with Linux development tools and Git version control.
* Ability to work from defined requirements, ask focused questions and incorporate code\-review feedback.
* U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Rust coursework, internship work, open\-source contributions or a personal project with automated tests.
* Exposure to network programming, asynchronous code or concurrency.
* Experience with C/C\+\+, Python, embedded devices or hardware interfaces.
* Familiarity with continuous integration, distributed systems or positioning, navigation and timing (PNT).

**Why Join Parry Labs?**
At Parry Labs, we foster a culture of curiosity and collaboration. Employees are given the autonomy to leverage their skills in creating state\-of\-the\-art tech solutions that aid in the protection of the American Warfighter. * U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance if required. An active clearance is not required at hire.

jobs.description:
**About Decision Technologies, Inc.**


Decision Technologies was founded to help bridge the gap between Department of Defense and Federal Government acquisition programs and technology to help our customers optimize their decision\-making process. Over the years, our areas of expertise have expanded to include Systems Engineering, Program Management, In\-Service Engineering, Equipment Repair, Research and Development, Test and Evaluation, and Intelligence and Counterintelligence Support. Our growth and success have positioned us as a premier engineering and intelligence services provider contributing to our nation's defense.


Our company culture cultivates talented problem\-solvers on focused on performance with industry\-leading teamwork and responsiveness. We have established a reputation for offering superior services and solutions, proven integrity and innovation, employee engagement and development, and customer collaboration.


Bring your expertise and knowledge to our team!

  

Decision Technologies is seeking an experienced, high\-impact **Lead Systems Engineer** ready to take the next major step in their career trajectory by serving as the principal technical direction engineer embedded within a major U.S. Navy weapon system program office. **This is a 100% in\-office (Arlington, VA), on\-site position sitting inside the Navy program office spaces. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work arrangements.**

 **Position Description:**


This role is tailored for an accomplished surface weapons or combat systems engineer, especially those with direct experience at OEMs and Labs/Warfare Centers who are looking to move beyond isolated subsystem tasks and transition into high\-visibility technical leadership across the Navy enterprise. Embedded directly with program leadership, you will partner with the Government Technical Director to steer future weapon capability, analyze real\-world operational feedback from the Fleet, and translate emerging threat intelligence into actionable science \& technology (S\&T) roadmaps for the next generation of surface munitions and ship self\-defense capabilities.

 **YOU MUST HAVE AN ACTIVE DOD SECRET CLEARANCE / TOP SECRET PREFERRED**

**PLEASE NOTE:** This position requires an **ACTIVE** Top Secret/SCI Clearance with Polygraph. To be considered for this position, you **MUST** have an **ACTIVE** Clearance Level of **Top Secret/SCI with Polygraph**
**Position Code: 06\-SE0924\-3**
**The Opportunity:**
Seeking a talented Operational Systems Engineer to join our team in Chantilly, VA to help lead the implementation, software development of the application layer, and O\&M for client’s scalable cross\-platform software test automation system. Your work will focus on designing, engineering and extending an existing system (DART) and re\-implementation of an application layer for test automation that enables open\-source infrastructure as code (IAC) technologies (e.g. Ansible, Terraform), and DevOps tools (e.g. Bamboo, Bitbucket, Confluence, Jira) as well as supporting legacy python bindings and modern REST endpoints with swagger documentation. The successful candidate will provide a professional evaluation, use\-case alignment, and assessment of the potential technology stack, including support for physical hardware, KVM, Proxmox, and VMWare\-based and other hypervisor platforms and tradeoffs before initial implementation with management approval. The goal includes ability scale our software test automation to support AI\-integrated rapid software projects, including using LLMs for agile automation development in addition to legacy workloads.
**Responsibilities:**
* Design, engineer/develop, and implement IT systems used by the client’s mission network to support end users
* Apply knowledge of operational tradecraft at OSI model layers 1\-4
* Identify opportunities to integrate efficiencies into innovative IT systems that enhance the cyber mission
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous setting, distilling complex technical concepts into actionable insights for leadership
* Ability to run a project independently from inception to completion, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and final documentation with minimal supervision
* Brief colleagues and mission partners on operational methodology, tool development, equipment functionality, and technical/operational deconfliction

**Mandatory Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical discipline (i.e., Computer Science, Computer Engineering), with a minimum of 5\+ years’ experience in a relevant technical field to the position
* Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance, with polygraph
* 5\+ years programming efficiency in Python and strong knowledge of C\+\+ for developing robust applications
* 5\+ years demonstrating an ability to lead the design, architecture and development of enterprise\-scale applications
* 5\+ years developing agnostic operating system\-based platforms, to include applications across both Linux and Windows ecosystems to support diverse testing targets
* Experience automating and managing multiple hypervisor platforms (both VMWare and KVM) to host complex, scalable, and highly customized environments
* Familiarity with DevOps principles, experience with Docker for containerization, and working experience with CI/CD pipelines for automation of testing and deployment
* Experience developing end\-to\-end automation solutions implementing logic for automated resource scaling
* Understanding authentication protocols such as OAuth, JWT and OpenID Connect
* Strong understanding of SQL Server and ability to manage and optimize database performance and/or MongoDB for NoSQL data storage needs
* Sound judgment, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills with an ability to adapt to emerging issues and changing priorities under short deadlines
* Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and stay abreast of leading\-edge technologies

**Desired Requirements:**
* Programming efficiency in additional languages such as C\+\+, Go, or Rust to optimize low level hypervisor interactions
* 5\+ years programming efficiency in C\# and .NET Core for developing robust applications
* Experience automating and managing multiple hypervisor platforms (Harvester) to host complex, scalable, and highly customized environments
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience working with tools such as Ansible or Terraform and/or Helm to manage and version\-control the underlying virtualized testing hardware and configurations
* Experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration
* Experience with both on\-premise and cloud deployment technologies and automation
* Kernel and driver knowledge across Linux and Windows kernel drivers to assist in deep\-level application compatibility testing
* Experience in managing large\-scale remote workstation clusters, focusing on high\-availability and minimal latency for highly scalable resource capabilities
* Experience with AI\-assisted tools for enhancing development productivity and automation
* Ability to integrate Machine Learning models into applications
* Understanding of Event\-Driven architecture principles for designing scalable systems
* Knowledge of ElasticSearch for log management and search functionalities, or general knowledge integrating open\-source ELK stack tools
* Detail oriented, organized, able to multitask, and adaptable to shifting requirements
* Flexibility – Works well both independently and as a team player; must be eager to learn
* Candidate should be a self\-starter and possess a willingness to dive into new technologies when appropriate
* Experience implementing and documenting standard operating procedures of systems or networks

jobs.description:

Clearance: Secret
  

Type: Full\-time, On\-site

* Work alongside the development and operations teams to ensure speedy and reliable software deployments, monitor systems, and improve overall reliability of the platform. In addition, as you discover and document system bugs, you have the motivation to go off and fix them yourself.
* Develop features utilize the AI coding tool and repository of scripts to automate, scale, test, and secure the cloud infrastructure and the pipelines.
* Enhance performance monitoring of the various systems via Splunk or other dashboard reporting tools
* Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize the performance of cloud infrastructure
* Contribute to continuing our SRE journey by suggesting ways to improve engineering build, maintenance, automation and reliability across the platform with SRE/DevOps tools and Infrastructure\-as\-Code.

* Expertise in automating MECM administrative tasks using PowerShell, APIs, and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling.
* Strong background in Windows endpoint management, including patching strategies, compliance baselines, configuration items, and reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to improve endpoint reliability through monitoring, observability tooling, and proactive remediation.
* Experience integrating MECM with cloud\-based services such as Intune, Azure AD, and Windows Update for Business.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex MECM client and server issues using logs, diagnostics, and platform health data.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-wide operating system deployments and in\-place upgrades using MECM automation pipelines.

* Strong understanding of networking concepts supporting MECM components such as DP distribution, boundary groups, and PXE services

jobs.title: Senior Data Center Electrical Engineer , Mechanical Products and Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.  

  

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
* Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
* Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well\-thought\-out products.
* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

  

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.  

  

About the team  

Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.  

  

We value collaboration, creative problem\-solving, and a commitment to continuous improvement. If you are excited about working on large\-scale infrastructure challenges alongside a talented group of engineers, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation o

jobs.description:
Description:

Command Post Technologies (CPT) is seeking a highly motivated RF Electrical Engineer specializing in Software Defined Radios (SDR) to support the U.S. Navy's Advanced Hypersonic Weapons \& Guided Munitions Division (E20\) at the Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division in Dahlgren, Virginia.


The Mid\-level RF Engineer serves as a scientist/engineer who is expected to develop technology through experiments and statistical analysis of target vulnerabilities. The successful candidate will lead testing, experiment development, and data acquisition. The position will interface with technical personnel from various external groups and organizations to identify problems, suggest changes, and develop and document final solutions for systems. The position will also be responsible for presenting test reviews and technical briefs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, integrate, and test RF communication systems utilizing commercial and custom software\-defined radio platforms.
* Support the development and evaluation of telemetry, command and control, instrumentation, and wireless communication architectures for advanced weapon systems.
* Conduct RF performance analysis, link budget development, spectrum analysis, and signal characterization.
* Develop and execute laboratory, range, and field testing activities for SDR\-based systems and RF hardware.
* Configure and program SDR platforms using tools such as GNU Radio, MATLAB, Python, C\+\+, or vendor\-specific development environments.
* Support the integration of RF hardware, antennas, amplifiers, filters, and associated digital signal processing components.
* Analyze and troubleshoot RF system performance issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Develop technical documentation including test plans, engineering reports, interface control documents, and design analyses.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including systems engineers, software developers, test engineers, and government technical leads.
* Support technology assessments and prototyping efforts involving emerging RF and communications technologies.

Requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or related technical discipline.
* Minimum of four (4\) years of professional experience in RF engineering, wireless communications, software\-defined radios, or related fields.
* Active Secret security clearance.
* Experience with RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, vector network analyzers, oscilloscopes, and power meters.
* Experience integrating, configuring, or developing applications for software\-defined radio platforms.
* Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, C/C\+\+, MATLAB, or similar.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and technical writing skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative government\-contractor environment.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting U.S. Navy or Department of Defense weapons, missile, telemetry, or test range programs.
* Ability to design RF receiver chains to condition signals specifically for Software\-defined radio (SDR) reception and processing using antennas, amplifiers, transmission lines, filters, and downconverters
* Familiarity with scattering parameter measurement of RF subsystems using network analysis
* Ability to conduct RF impedance matching utilizing Smith chart applications
* Understanding of antenna technologies, feed methods, and impact of physical installation on antenna performance
* Understanding of RF propagation to conduct link budget calculations
* Familiarity with RF modeling and simulation

jobs.title: Agile Video Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**  

NTS is seeking an Agile Video Systems Engineer to support the design, engineering, integration, deployment, and sustainment of advanced video systems operating across both edge and enterprise environments. These systems support executive\-level and high\-threat operational environments where reliability, security, and mission readiness are essential.  

The Agile Video Systems Engineer will serve as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) working alongside the customer. The engineer will help ensure video system projects and field deployments meet established standards for performance, consistency, reliability, security, and configuration management.  

This position supports U.S. Department of State (DoS) requirements in domestic and overseas (OCONUS) locations, including potentially high\-threat and austere environments. The position may require travel of up to 50%, including extended Temporary Duty (TDY) assignments.

  

**Key Responsibilities** (Principal Duties and Accountabilities \*Essential Functions)

  


* Provide engineering and technical support for video systems, ensuring system availability, reliability, performance, and operational readiness.
* Support U.S. Department of State requirements across multiple domestic and overseas (OCONUS) theaters and operational locations.
* Design, engineer, integrate, test, deploy, and sustain modern video systems supporting mission\-critical and high\-threat environments.
* Research, evaluate, test, validate, and implement emerging technologies to improve system capabilities, reliability, efficiency, and mission effectiveness.
* Lead or support proof\-of\-concept (POC) activities and technology demonstrations in laboratory, testing, training, and operational environments.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering artifacts, test procedures, and deployment standards.
* Identify training requirements for field technicians and develop comprehensive digital training materials and curricula.
* Ensure compliance with DoS Protective Technology configuration management processes and established engineering standards.
* Collaborate with vendors, industry partners, and government agencies to develop and maintain standardized certification and validation processes for mobile video systems and program\-specific technologies.
* Develop comprehensive test plans and support verification and validation activities in accordance with established configuration management and engineering protocols.
* Provide on\-site U.S. Department of State technical oversight during system verification testing, acceptance testing, and related engineering activities.
* Apply broad technical knowledge and subject matter expertise to moderately complex engineering and operational assignments.
* Analyze technical issues, develop solutions, and make recommendations based on established engineering principles, operational requirements, and mission objectives.
* Collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary engineering, technical, security, and program teams.
* Support system deployments, troubleshooting, maintenance, and sustainment activities as required.

Perform other duties as assigned in support of program and mission requirements.  
* 
* Must have an active Secret clearance issued by the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA)
* Must be able to maintain all required security clearances, access approvals, and program\-specific authorizations.

  


**Education**


* Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, systems engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered where permitted by contract requirements.

  


**Required Skills, Experience \& Abilities**


* Minimum of 5 years of technical experience supporting modern countermeasures and integration systems, security technologies, video systems, or related mission systems.
* Demonstrated understanding of radio frequency (RF) theory and principles, including the impact of RF systems operating in electronic countermeasures (ECM) environments.

Network Configuration Automation \& CI/CD Pipeline Engineering• Write automation playbooks using tools like Ansible, Terraform, and Python to push global changes safely.• Maintain Git repositories for the network infrastructure code, managing pull requests and peer configuration reviews.• Build CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins) to validate, lint, and dry\-run network changes before deployment.• Develop automated validation workflows to check network health before and after a change window.4\. Change Control \& Third\-Tier Support• Review high\-impact modifications to ensure alignment with standard architecture templates.• Provide Tier\-3 troubleshooting for complex network outages caused by configuration discrepancies or failed software upgrades.• Coordinate mass patching campaigns to fix vendor software vulnerabilities across thousands of active network nodes. **Required Qualifications \& Technical Competencies****Technical Skills \& Toolsets** •Bachelor's Degree in Engineering discipline Network Automation: Ansible, Terraform, Python, Jinja2 and other template modeling.• NMS \& Tools: Cisco Catalyst Center, OpenText Network Automation, Nautobot, Infoblox IPAM, Wireshark.• DevOps Workflows: Git, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Docker.• Core Networking: Solid understanding of BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, ACLs, and SSH/SNMP protocols.• Vendor OS Fluency: Cisco IOS/IOS\-XE/XR, Juniper JunOS, Arista EOS.Soft Skills \& Certifications• Data\-driven analytical thinker skilled at tracking down anomalies in massive configuration text files.• Detail\-oriented planner capable of coordinating large\-scale automated pushes across global time zones.**LOCATION:**

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space\-based communications with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This multi\-orbit constellation will consist of optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO), providing enterprise\-grade connectivity for critical operations worldwide.
At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low\-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our diverse team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!


This role is part of the Emerging Systems business unit, which is focused on developing cutting\-edge space technologies including TeraWave, Blue Origin's revolutionary space\-based networking system. TeraWave is designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps, providing connectivity to locations unreachable by traditional methods and adding a space\-based layer to existing network infrastructure.


As a Senior Validation and Test Automation Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for integrating and verifying TeraWave RF and optical systems across satellite payloads, customer terminals, and ground gateways. You will develop Python\-based test infrastructure, automate laboratory equipment and system interfaces, and build repeatable hardware\-in\-the\-loop and end\-to\-end tests. You will work with RF, optical, embedded software, firmware, systems, and manufacturing teams to find defects early and demonstrate system performance.


You will own test architecture for a designated system area from prototype through qualification, define measurable acceptance criteria, and turn test results into clear engineering decisions. Successful senior engineers design maintainable automation, isolate failures across hardware and software boundaries, and improve the speed and coverage of integration testing.


**Special Mentions**

* This role will be onsite in one of these locations – Greater Seattle Area, WA. It is approved for temporary remote work exception while our local site is developed
* Relocation assistance available
* Travel may be required up to 10% of the time

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Design and develop Python\-based test automation for RF and optical subsystems on TeraWave satellite payloads, customer terminals, and ground gateway terminals.
* Build reusable automation frameworks with pytest fixtures, plugins, device abstractions, and APIs for system control, telemetry collection, and result reporting.
* Own integration and verification for a designated system area, including feasibility studies, prototypes, interface validation, test architecture, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead development of Agentic\-AI automation framework, use cases and failure models, and connect with MCPs.
* Integrate RF transceivers, antenna systems, optical terminals, embedded software, firmware, and network interfaces across laboratory and system\-level test environments.
* Develop automated software\-in\-the\-loop, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, subsystem, and end\-to\-end tests for functionality, performance, fault recovery, and regression coverage.
* Automate laboratory equipment using SCPI, VISA, Ethernet, serial, or vendor APIs, including signal generators, spectrum and network analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, optical analyzers, and bit\-error\-rate testers.
* Define and measure system KPIs such as EVM, bit\-error rate, throughput, latency, acquisition and tracking performance, optical power, receiver sensitivity, and link margin.
* Troubleshoot failures using telemetry, logs, packet captures, instrument traces, and statistical analysis, working across hardware and software teams to identify root cause.
* Create reproducible test configurations, scalable lab orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and traceable test artifacts that support parallel execution and unattended regression testing.
* Contribute to requirements\-based test plans, automation code reviews, and system architecture decisions; mentor engineers and lead delivery of reliable integration and test capabilities.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience developing Python software for test automation, system integration, or verification of complex hardware and software systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including object\-oriented design, modular architecture, packaging, type annotations, unit testing, and concurrent or asynchronous programming.
* Experience designing automated test frameworks with pytest, Robot Framework, or a similar framework, including fixtures, reusable libraries, reporting, and failure diagnostics.
* Hands\-on experience with Linux\-based test environments and interfaces such as Ethernet, TCP/IP, serial, SSH, REST, gRPC, SCPI, and VISA or PyVISA.

Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun, and make a positive impact on tens of millions of people.  

  

A day in the life  

You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. As an Electrical Engineer, your tasks would vary between board design, layout reviews, test plan development, qualification and root cause analysis. This is a cross\-functional role requiring constant interaction with multiple HW/SW design teams and end\-users.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in hardware development across multiple phases of the product life cycle in consumer electronics, power electronics, robotics, aerospace, automotive, communications, or a combination thereof.
* Demonstrated technical depth in board\-level electrical hardware design, including areas such as precision analog and sensor electronics, embedded digital systems, high\-speed interfaces, motor or actuator control, memory, or power regulation.
* Experience with PCB design, board bring\-up, and debugging involving components such as microprocessors, SoCs, FPGAs, memories, power supplies, ADCs, DACs, and sensors.
* Experience with complex board designs involving high\-speed interconnects, high\-reliability electronics, power regulation, or motor and actuator\-control electronics.
* Experience with schematic capture and PCB\-layout ECAD tools.
* Hands\-on experience performing bench design\-verification testing and debug using oscilloscopes and other common electrical laboratory equipment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* M.S. or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Broad hardware\-development experience spanning multiple electrical engineering disciplines.
* Experience designing precision analog circuits involving ADCs, DACs, low\-noise amplifiers, transimpedance amplifiers, sensors, or filters.
* Experience with motor drivers, current sensing, feedback circuits, or actuator\-control electronics.
* Experience with embedded processors, SoCs, FPGAs, or memories such as DDR, NOR flash, or FRAM.
* Experience with high\-speed circuit design, transmission lines, controlled\-impedance routing, signal integrity, or power integrity.
* Experience designing or debugging board\-level power supplies, including buck converters and LDOs.
* Experience using circuit simulation and analysis tools such as LTspice or MATLAB.

jobs.description:
**We Are:**


Do you believe that AI and robotics will redefine the way we work and live? Then help shape the future with us. As part of Accenture’s ambition “To reinvent industries,” the Next Gen Robotics Team operates at the forefront as a spearhead for groundbreaking robotics solutions. We combine Accenture’s global strength and reach with the latest breakthroughs in Physical AI and robotics—with a focus on the intersection of technology, industry, and society.

**You Are:**


In global and highly ambitious team, you will develop scalable robotics solutions—from AMRs and autonomous drones to quadrupedal robots, humanoid systems, and AI\-powered service platforms. Our goal: to make real industrial applications more efficient, safer, more economical—and smarter.


You work on the most pressing technology and industry challenges—in direct collaboration with experts in engineering, AI, and strategy. In an environment that encourages responsibility and takes learning seriously, you develop further with every challenge. You benefit from structured mentoring, open feedback, and projects that combine technical excellence with entrepreneurial impact.

**The Work:**

* Technical leadership of robotics innovation projects, including architecture design, implementation, and integration for global industrial clients.
* Development of scalable Physical AI architectures with a focus on autonomy, VLA model integration, real\-time systems, and scalable simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and Cosmos world models.
* Management of interdisciplinary delivery teams (3–10 people) across PoC, pilot, and production rollout phases.
* Execution of technology benchmarks, venture screenings, and establishment of robust demo and test setups.
* Close coordination with clients, partners, and Accenture industry units—from roadmap creation to productive implementation.
* Active contribution to the Next\-Gen Robotics strategy: tech roadmaps, partner development, and internal enablement initiatives.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0% to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.


  

**Here’s What You Need:**

* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in robotics, consulting, or software projects with a strong technical focus.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Solid experience with modern robotics stacks: ROS2, motion planning, sensor fusion, and simulation environments (Isaac Sim 6\.0, Isaac Lab 3\.0, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Hands\-on experience with Physical AI and foundation model technologies: working knowledge of VLA architectures (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, π0, OpenVLA), robot policy fine\-tuning, imitation learning, and sim\-to\-real transfer pipelines.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Experience with synthetic data generation and world models (NVIDIA Cosmos, Genesis, MuJoCo MJX) for scalable robot training at scale.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience Proficient in software development with Python and C\+\+—including clean code practices, Git, CI/CD, and architecture\-based development.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience You have taken responsibility in technical project roles—e.g., as an architect, lead engineer, or integrative tech generalist in interdisciplinary teams.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience Exposure to edge AI deployment for robotics: NVIDIA Jetson / Isaac platform, TensorRT inference optimization, and real\-time control at 30–100 Hz.
* Bachelor's degree in robotics, computer science (or related) or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Astronics Advanced Electronic Systems (AES)** is seeking a **Principal Electrical Engineer** with a strong track record of implementing advanced power conversion technologies into aerospace\-grade power supply and power conversion products.



Join our accomplished ***Cabin Electronics Power Team*** *in* ***Kirkland, WA*** and help us transform modern flight.



This is an on\-site position that offers flexibility to work from home 2–3 days per week, depending on project needs.


**Job Summary**



The Principal Electrical Engineer will provide technical leadership for the design and development of in\-seat power supplies and USB outlet units for commercial aircraft. You will lead the electrical design based on functional requirements, guide the engineering team through product certification, and drive technology innovation through targeted R\&D activities.



This role requires extensive knowledge of power conversion technologies—including resonant converter topologies and digitally controlled power supplies—along with strong leadership, mentoring, and presentation skills. You will independently apply a high degree of creative ability, engineering skill, and judgment to solve complex problems and move programs to successful completion.


**Role Objectives**



* Design power supplies and outlet units that meet defined functional and certification requirements.


* Produce high\-quality electrical design documentation to support development, test, and certification.


* Perform electrical simulations and trade studies to optimize designs for performance, reliability, and cost.


* Lead the electrical technical team to achieve successful product certification to DO\-160, Airbus, and Boeing requirements.


* Conduct R\&D activities and evaluate emerging power conversion technologies for potential integration into future products.


* Diagnose and resolve development hardware failures, implementing robust corrective design changes.



**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead the electrical design of aerospace\-grade in\-seat power supplies and USB outlet units for commercial aircraft from concept through certification.
* Translate functional and system\-level requirements into robust electrical architectures and detailed designs.
* Propose, plan, and execute R\&D activities that advance the group's power supply and power conversion capabilities, including evaluation of new technologies and topologies.
* Apply extensive knowledge of power conversion technologies, with emphasis on resonant converters and digital control techniques.
* Perform electrical simulations and trade studies using advanced tools (e.g., OrCAD, SPICE, SABER) to determine optimal design approaches.
* Stay current with industry trends in power electronics and incorporate relevant advancements into new product development.
* Ensure designs meet applicable aerospace industry standards, including DO\-160 as well as Airbus and Boeing requirements.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive electrical design documentation, including schematics, design descriptions, analyses, and compliance evidence.
* Create clear, technically rigorous test procedures, test reports, and requirements documents, and present them as a subject\-matter expert at internal and external design reviews.
* Prepare and present technical analyses, design justifications, and trade study results to internal stakeholders and customers.
* Lead and mentor the electrical engineering (EE) team on projects, providing technical direction and oversight to achieve performance, schedule, and certification objectives.
* Support product certification activities, coordinating closely with systems, compliance, and test teams to demonstrate requirements verification and validation.
* Troubleshoot development hardware issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement corrective design changes.
* Support bid and proposal efforts and assist with new business and follow\-on opportunities as a technical leader.


**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE required).
* Typically, **12 or more years of relevant experience in electrical design**, **with direct experience in power supply and/or power conversion product development.**
* Demonstrated expertise with resonant power converter topologies and digital control of power supplies.
* Broad experience with advanced electrical engineering simulation tools (such as OrCAD, SPICE, SABER) and conducting trade studies.
* Experience designing to DO\-160 and other applicable aerospace requirements, including Airbus and Boeing specifications.
* Proven ability to generate high\-quality technical documents: design descriptions, requirements, test procedures, test reports, and presentations.
* Experience leading electrical engineering teams or providing technical leadership on complex product development or research programs.


**Employment Eligibility Requirements**


* This role may involve access to items subject to U.S. export\-controls laws or other applicable U.S.\-government legal or contractual requirements. To assess whether any licenses, authorizations, or other exceptions are required, please indicate below whether you are a U.S. Person. If you are not a U.S. Person, the company does not guarantee and is under no obligation to seek such authorization if it would be necessary. This information is collected solely for this compliance purpose.
* An offer of employment is contingent upon successfully passing a pre\-employment background screen and drug test, including cannabis screening.
