jobs.title: Software Engineer, BigQuery Query Optimization
jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  

  

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience with developing large\-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies or storage.
* Experience programming in C\+\+.
* Experience with the following: Distributed Systems, Debugging.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Experience shipping mission\-critical code with high performance and correctness requirements.
* Experience in debugging performance of a multi\-node distributed systems.
* Domain knowledge in the SQL database query processing and query optimization space.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Join the Query Optimization team in BigQuery. We're at the forefront of cloud\-native data warehousing, powering mission\-critical analytics for the world’s largest enterprises. We make sure that customers can get the answers they need as quickly and smoothly as possible through a variety of means, including algebraic SQL enhancements and materialized views.  

In this role, you will learn execution dynamics and tuning at depth, test your limits, and deliver customer\-focused innovation across a growing set of crucial workloads. If you're ready to make a significant difference on a global platform used by millions and dive into the technical depths of high\-performance information processing, we want to hear from you.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 year of experience with one or more of the following: speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).
* 1 year of experience in software development with Java or Kotlin.
* Experience in infrastructure, platforms, or backend software engineering.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.
* 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* Experience programming in Kotlin.
* Working experience on Google Cloud Platform.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



The AI and Data Protection team engineers maintain the high\-throughput, high\-availability inspection services that power Google's safety capabilities. Our technology is fundamental to Cloud Sensitive Data Protection (Cloud SDP), Gmail/Chrome Enterprise/Google Drive's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) frameworks, AI (LLMs and Agents) inference safeguards with Model Armor, and a wide range of other Google offerings. We also perform storage scanning (GCS, BQ, etc), both thorough examination (reading every byte) and discovery (sampling records to create aggregate profiles).  

  

In this role, you will build the architecture, APIs, algorithms, and neural networks that provide fast, scalable classification and redaction of sensitive information and AI threat surfaces, both at runtime and at rest.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you passionate about designing and optimizing the critical systems that power some of the world's largest and most reliable infrastructure? As a Senior Data Center Infrastructure Electrical Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader responsible for the design, architecture, and continuous improvement of data center infrastructure systems. Your work will directly influence the availability and efficiency of the physical backbone that supports millions of customers worldwide.  

  

In this role, you will tackle complex, ambiguous problems across global projects, driving solutions that are inventive, scalable, and maintainable. You will collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams, influence facility strategy, and set standards for engineering excellence. Whether you are leading the design of new infrastructure systems or resolving root causes of endemic issues, your contributions will have a meaningful, long\-term impact on how Amazon builds and operates its data centers.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the Data Center Design Engineering, Principal Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to design and develop innovative concepts into new mechanical cooling products (AHUs, chiller, pump skids, ADACs) used in AWS data centers.
* Lead the electrical aspect of new product design and development for mechanical cooling equipment, including motor controls, VFDs, power distribution panels, control wiring, and instrumentation integration.
* Collaborate with other disciplines such as mechanical engineering, structural engineering, controls/automation, reliability, QA/QC, and compliance to create well\-thought\-out products.
* Design and specify electrical systems for rotating equipment including fans, pumps, and compressors, ensuring proper motor sizing, protection, and control schemes.
* Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements while delivering a return on investment.
* Work with global suppliers and manufacturers to specify appropriate electrical components, devices, and bill of materials for AHUs, skids, and ADACs.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes across different countries, including UL, CE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, and other applicable standards for mechanical cooling equipment.
* Prepare, review, and approve product design and drawings including electrical schematics, single\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules, and bill of materials.
* Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during manufacturing phases.
* Work with field engineering and commissioning teams to properly set up test processes and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems within mechanical cooling products.
* Develop and review control logic, interlocks, and safety circuits for AHU, skid, chillers and ADAC assemblies in coordination with controls engineers.
* Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
* Support of Operations including failure mode and root cause analysis, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for electrical systems in cooling equipment.
* Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 25% of the year.

  

A day in the life  

You might start your morning reviewing design documents for a new infrastructure deployment, providing feedback that strengthens the overall architecture. By midday, you could be leading a cross\-team project review, aligning engineers across regions on a shared technical approach. In the afternoon, you may dive into root\-cause analysis of a recurring facility issue, proposing a mechanism to prevent future occurrences. Throughout it all, you will coach teammates, share expertise, and help shape the direction of critical infrastructure at Amazon.  

  

About the team  

Our team is focused on ensuring that Amazon's data center infrastructure is reliable, efficient, and ready to meet the demands of tomorrow. We work at the intersection of electrical engineering, mechanical systems, and operational technology to design and maintain the physical environments that support Amazon's global services.

* 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
* Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation o

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Mixed-Signal Hardware
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


Join GE HealthCare and help develop the advanced electronics behind next\-generation Magnetic Resonance imaging systems.  

  

As a Senior Electrical Engineer on our Digital Controls \& Mixed Signal Engineering team, you will design and debug complex circuit boards and electronic subsystems incorporating analog circuitry, power, signal conditioning, data converters, communications, and embedded digital devices.  

  

We are seeking a strong, hands\-on hardware engineer with sound technical judgment and experience turning challenging designs into reliable products. This role also provides opportunities to lead projects, mentor engineers, influence technical decisions, and improve reusable designs and engineering practices.  

  

Candidates may come from many industries and technical backgrounds. Relevant experience may involve microcontrollers, processors, DSPs, SoCs, ASICs, or programmable logic. FPGA or HDL development experience is not required.  

  

We do not expect candidates to have experience with every technology listed. We encourage you to apply based on your engineering strengths and interest in learning adjacent technologies.**Job Description**
===================

**Essential Responsibilities**
------------------------------

* Design, implement, and verify mixed\-signal circuit boards and electronic subsystems for advanced MRI platforms.
* Develop hardware integrating analog signal chains, data converters, power circuitry, communication interfaces, and embedded or complex digital devices.
* Perform component selection, schematic development, circuit analysis, design reviews, board bring\-up, laboratory characterization, debugging, and system integration.
* Define and validate electrical interfaces across hardware, programmable devices, firmware, software, mechanical, and systems engineering.
* Develop verification approaches and lead or contribute to root\-cause investigations.
* Support signal integrity, power integrity, EMC, reliability, testability, and manufacturability activities.
* Support hardware throughout the product lifecycle, from early architecture through production and field support.
* Share knowledge through design reviews, documentation, collaborative problem solving, and mentoring.
* Technical leadership may include leading a project, owning a difficult subsystem, improving design practice, mentoring another engineer, or contributing deep expertise to a challenging investigation. Formal people\-management experience is not required.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* Five or more years of experience designing and debugging electronic hardware.
* Demonstrated strength in mixed\-signal board or subsystem design.
* Hands\-on experience in several areas such as analog signal conditioning, sensors, data converters, embedded processors, microcontrollers, power electronics, controls, or communications.
* Experience integrating analog circuitry with a microcontroller, processor, DSP, SoC, ASIC, programmable\-logic device, or similar digital device.
* Experience with schematic development, component selection, board bring\-up, laboratory testing, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Familiarity with embedded interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, or comparable technologies.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading a hardware project or major subsystem.
* Experience with precision analog circuitry, sensors, ADCs, DACs, power, EMC, signal integrity, or high\-speed digital interfaces.
* Experience with SPICE or similar analysis tools.
* Experience developing products in medical devices, professional power tools, industrial controls, robotics, automotive, aerospace, defense, scientific instrumentation, test and measurement, or similar industries.
* Experience with regulated, safety\-critical, high\-reliability, harsh\-environment, or high\-volume products.

 **Work Model**


This hybrid position requires a minimum of three days per week on site in Waukesha. On\-site work supports laboratory development, board bring\-up, system integration, and collaboration with engineering partners.


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

  

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

* CAD skills are preferred
* Knowledge of plant power distribution, control systems, and PLC’s

* Ability to be a self\-starter and take action on projects proactively
* Good communication skills both oral and written.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is seeking a highly skilled Non\-Propulsion Electronics Systems (NPES) Engineer to support U.S. Navy submarine operations and advanced undersea warfare systems. This position is ideal for a former Navy Fire Control Technician, Fire Controlman, or similarly experienced submarine systems professional who understands the technical, operational, and mission requirements of modern submarine combat systems.
The NPES engineer will apply hands\-on Navy experience and technical expertise to support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, and evaluation of submarine fire control and combat systems. The successful candidate will work closely with Navy personnel, engineers, program managers, and other technical professionals to ensure systems remain operational, reliable, and mission ready.  

**Must be able to obtain a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**  

Key Responsibilities
* Provide technical and operational expertise on Navy submarine fire control, combat control, and associated weapons systems.
* Support the operation, maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and evaluation of fire control and combat system equipment.
* Analyze system performance and assist in identifying, isolating, and resolving hardware, software, and integration issues.
* Provide subject\-matter expertise on submarine tactical systems, fire control processes, weapons employment, and associated operational procedures.
* Support system integration, verification, validation, and Test and Evaluation (T\&E) activities.
* Review technical documentation, system requirements, engineering specifications, test procedures, and configuration documentation.
* Assist with the development and execution of test plans, test procedures, demonstrations, and technical evaluations.
* Support configuration management and ensure system documentation accurately reflects approved system baselines and changes.
* Coordinate with Navy operators, engineers, government stakeholders, and industry partners to resolve technical and operational issues.
* Translate operational requirements and fleet feedback into clear technical requirements and recommendations.
* Support technical reviews, working groups, program meetings, and customer engagements.
* Prepare technical reports, briefings, presentations, and other program documentation.
* Provide recommendations to improve system performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational effectiveness.
* Maintain a strong understanding of Navy policies, procedures, safety requirements, and applicable security protocols.

  

Required Qualifications
* **Ability to obtain a U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.**
* Prior U.S. Navy experience as a Fire Control Technician (FT), Fire Controlman (FC), or equivalent experience supporting submarine combat or fire control systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
* Required: 5\+ years’ work experience within DoW, or Armed Services.
* Demonstrated experience with Navy fire control, combat control, weapons control, or related tactical systems.
* Strong understanding of submarine operations and the role of fire control systems in undersea warfare.
* Experience troubleshooting complex electronic, computer, weapons, or combat system equipment.
* Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, system documentation, schematics, and engineering documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with military, civilian, engineering, and contractor personnel.
* Ability to work independently while effectively contributing to a multidisciplinary team.
* Ability to travel 25% of the time.

  

Preferred Qualifications
* Former Navy submarine Fire Control Technician or Fire Controlman with significant fleet experience.
* Experience aboard Los Angeles\-, Seawolf\-, or Virginia\-Class submarines.
* Experience with submarine combat control, weapons control, sonar, navigation, or tactical systems.
* Experience supporting Navy acquisition programs, Program Executive Offices (PEOs), NAVSEA, Team Submarine, or other DoD organizations.

* Experience developing or reviewing technical requirements, test procedures, engineering documentation, or system specifications.

* Experience supporting submarine modernization, technology insertion, or combat system upgrades.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience working with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

  

Core Competencies
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
* Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of Navy fire control and submarine combat systems.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Veridos provides secure and innovative identity solutions to governments worldwide. We help ensure every citizen has access to a trusted legal identity – enabling participation in society and access to essential services. From passports and ID cards to mobile IDs and border control systems, we deliver end\-to\-end identity solutions tailored to national needs. Join our multicultural workforce to create innovative solutions that make a worldwide impact.


As a joint venture of Giesecke\+Devrient, a global SecurityTech company and Bundesdruckerei, the German state printing service, we are always looking for talented and motivated colleagues who share our vision and want to shape the future of identities with us.



**Position Overview**We are looking for a Software Engineer to design, develop, and expand our SDK \& Demo App ecosystem across multi\-device and network environments. Our software layer supports our core identity document scanning hardware. This is an onsite position located in San Diego, CA. In this role, you will architect the core SDK \& Demo App, directly embedding image processing, advanced calibration algorithms, and data capture libraries (OCR \& Barcode) to maximize hardware performance and production. You will be responsible for delivering both the core APIs and Apps for B2B client integration interactive Demo, alongside internal Engineering Apps required for device optimization, hardware testing, and factory calibration. **Role Summary**


* Job Title: Software Engineer (PC/Embedded SDK \& Demo App Development)
* Department: R\&D Dept.
* Core Tech Stack: C\+\+, C\# / .NET, Windows/Linux Systems Programming, Embedded Systems, Image Processing (OpenCV), Network Programming (RESTful APIs, WebSockets)

**Key Responsibilities**Core SDK and Apps (Image \& Data Recognition Engine)


* Design, build, and maintain the core SDK framework and associated apps, supporting both external B2B client demo applications and internal engineering tools for hardware verification, calibration, and factory production.
* Develop and optimize low\-latency image pre\-processing pipelines (including image enhancement, auto\-cropping, and ROI extraction).
* Integrate and optimize third\-party libraries (e.g., OCR, barcode decoders) into the core SDK framework.
* Work closely with firmware engineers to define device\-level communication protocols and debug hardware interface issues (USB, Serial, PC/SC).

Multi\-Device \& Network Expansion


* Port and expand existing SDK, Demo App, and recognition libraries into cross\-platform, networked environments (Linux, Embedded Systems, Tablets, and Edge devices).
* Consider future network scalability when defining core communication architectures. (e.g., RESTful APIs, WebSockets)

Technical Documentation \& Support


* Write clean English technical documentation and API references for global B2B clients.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**Education:


* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Image Processing, or a related technical discipline.

Experience \& Mindset


* 3–5\+ years of professional experience in software development with a strong focus on C\+\+ , C\#/ .NET.
* A proven self\-starter who demonstrates high autonomy and takes clear ownership of assigned tasks.

Image Processing:


* Solid hands\-on experience utilizing computer vision libraries (e.g., OpenCV) for raw sensor data, camera calibration, or frame\-level manipulation.

Communication Skills:


* Proven ability to write clean English technical documentation and communicate effectively with global technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience integrating and optimizing OCR technologies or 1D/2D Barcode decoding libraries (e.g., processing PDF417, QR codes) within an SDK environment.
* Embedded, Mobile \& Network OS Expertise: Experience with Linux systems programming, Android/Tablet integration, or building SDK \& Demo Apps for resource\-constrained embedded industrial devices.
* Experience with cross\-platform tools such as CMake, Qt, or multi\-OS packaging tools for SDK \& Demo App distribution.
* Experience interfacing software with hardware devices via USB, serial or PC/SC protocols, with a history of collaborating with firmware.

The pay range for this position is $ 135,815\-$141,130 per year. Benefits offered to eligible employees include, medical (PPO and HDHP with HSA), dental, vision, paid time off, paid holidays, 401K w/ employer match, short/long term disability, life insurance, healthcare and dependent care flexible spending, EAP, commuter benefits, education assistance, pet insurance, legal, and more.

new_jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Why RoboForce**



RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo\-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company's robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real\-world deployment and scalability.



We are seeking a Robotics Software Engineer to build the software that powers robot behavior in the real world. In this role, you will develop, integrate, and improve production\-grade robotics capabilities across autonomy, systems, and developer infrastructure. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to turn promising prototypes into reliable software that runs on deployed robots operating in complex outdoor environments.



This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing production code, debugging challenging real\-world problems, and seeing their work directly improve robot performance in the field.


**Responsibilities**


* **Robotics Software Development**: Design, implement, and maintain production software for real\-world robotic systems using C\+\+ and Python, with a focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* **System Integration**: Integrate and refine robotics capabilities across perception, planning, controls, teleoperation, and platform software to ensure robust behavior on physical robots.
* **Robustness \& Reliability Engineering**: Improve software quality through testing, validation, fault handling, performance tuning, and edge\-case analysis to make systems dependable in unstructured outdoor environments.
* **Debugging \& Root Cause Analysis**: Investigate complex failures across software, sensors, networking, timing, and hardware interfaces, and drive issues to resolution through disciplined technical analysis.
* **Tooling \& Infrastructure**: Build internal tools, scripts, and workflows that improve developer velocity, testing efficiency, observability, and release quality across the robotics software stack.
* **On\-Robot Validation**: Work directly with hardware to validate new features, evaluate system behavior, and iterate quickly between development and real\-world testing.


**Requirements**


* **Education:** B.S. or M.S. in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, or complex embedded systems, with a demonstrated track record of deploying **physical hardware products** into the field.
* **Programming Proficiency:** Strong command of both C\+\+ and Python, with the ability to read, debug, and write production\-level C\+\+ for core robot systems, alongside robust Python tooling.
* **Robotics Software Fundamentals**: Experience working with one or more core robotics domains such as perception, motion planning, controls, localization, state estimation, system integration, or robot behavior.
* **Linux Systems Expertise**: Strong comfort working in Linux development environments, including command\-line tools, debugging workflows, scripting, and system\-level troubleshooting.
* **Debugging Mindset**: Proven ability to diagnose and resolve problems that span software, hardware, sensors, and distributed system interactions.
* **Collaboration**: Requires 5 days/week in\-office collaboration with the team.


**Bonus Qualifications**


* **Outdoor Robotics Experience**: Background in autonomous driving, drones, mobile robotics, or other systems deployed in outdoor or unstructured environments.
* **Infrastructure Familiarity**: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD systems, or software release workflows for robotics platforms.
* **Developer Tooling**: Experience building tools for testing, simulation, telemetry, debugging, or log analysis.
* **Visualization \& Diagnostics**: Experience with robotics visualization and diagnostics tools such as Foxglove, Grafana, RViz, or custom internal interfaces.
* **Production Deployment Experience**: Experience taking robotics software from prototype to production and supporting reliability at fleet scale.


**Benefits**


* Competitive stock options/equity programs.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) plan.
* Visa sponsorship and green card support for qualified candidates.
* Lunches and dinners, a fully stocked kitchen, and regular team\-building events.

  



Compensation: Salary $165,000–$235,000 USD \+ Bonus \+ Equity

The base salary range above represents the expected compensation for this full\-time U.S. position. Final compensation will be determined based on role scope, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training, and may fall outside the listed range in exceptional cases.

new_jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer (Lead)
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**


Octavian Robotics is solving the \#1 complication in the $3T surgical industry. We are building robots for the sterilization of surgical tools. Only now with generalized robotics models have we been able to tackle this problem and save lives.


This company is a spin\-out from Sorting Robotics and we are inheriting a decade of robotics infrastructure and know\-how. We are hiring the Cognizant Engineer (CogE) to own our flagship: a VLA\-powered (Vision\-Language\-Action) gripping and manipulation system for surgical instruments. You will lead this product from the rig on the bench to machines running inside hospital Sterile Processing Departments, and you will own its technical success end to end.


This is a hands\-on technical leadership seat. You will design the end\-effector and mechatronics, integrate vision and force and tactile sensing into a 6DOF arm, and operationalize learned manipulation policies (VLA models) so the system reliably grips, sorts, and handles surgical instruments in the real world. You work directly with the founders. Expect to learn a lot fast, hit days where nothing works, and ship a product that saves lives in a room full of people who appreciate you.

**What you will own**

* Own the VLA gripping and manipulation system cradle to grave: concept, design, build, bring\-up, deployment, and field reliability. You are accountable for its technical success.
* Design the gripper and mechatronics: end\-effector design, actuation, GD\&T drawings, mass, cost and manufacturability tradeoffs, rapid prototyping (3D print, laser, CNC, PCB), and production\-ready designs.
* Integrate perception and sensing into the manipulation loop: cameras and vision, force, torque and tactile feedback, and the 6DOF arm.
* Operationalize VLA and learned manipulation policies: stand up the data pipeline (teleop and demonstration collection), wire policy inference into real\-time control, evaluate grasp and handling success, and close the sim\-to\-real and on\-robot iteration loop.
* Optimize with modeling and test: analytical and physical simulation, then validate on hardware.
* Interface with suppliers to build supply chain and vendor qualification for manufacturing feasibility, validation, and assigned commodities; deliver world\-class fit, finish, and craftsmanship for launch.
* Support deployment: help assemble and install systems at hospital sites as needed. Travel is approximately 1 to 5 percent.

**Ideal candidate skills**

* B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or Robotics (M.S. a plus).
* Real experience taking a robotic system from concept to delivery on an R\&D team.
* Manipulation and gripping experience: end\-effector or gripper design, grasping, pick\-and\-place, or assembly automation.
* 6DOF and cobot arm integration, including low\-level programming and motion control.
* Comfortable at the hardware and ML boundary: you do not have to train VLA models from scratch, but you can integrate learned policies, run inference on a robot, collect and curate demonstration data, and debug why a policy fails on real hardware. Familiarity with modern manipulation stacks (ROS or ROS 2, OpenVLA or pi\-0 style policies, RT\-style models, imitation learning, sim\-to\-real) is a strong plus.
* Strong Python; working knowledge of real\-time or embedded control.
* Fluent with prototyping tools: CAD, 3D printing, laser cutter, CNC, PCB.
* Takes initiative across whatever the company needs to win. Able to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

  

**Requirements**  

* B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or similar.
* Strong understanding of AI tools. We're looking for an "AI native" engineer.
* Technical depth in robotics, automation, or a related field; has shipped from concept to delivery.
* Demonstrated work on 6DOF or similar cobot arms.
* Working knowledge of Python or a similar language.
* Minimum 10 years of full\-time on the job experience.
* Bonus: hands\-on with manipulation or grasping, or with learned policies (VLA, imitation learning, ROS).
* Not currently enrolled in a college or graduate program.
* Free to work without visa sponsorship.
* On\-site in Van Nuys or Los Angeles (reliable commute or willing to relocate). Some travel to hospital sites will be required.

  

**Benefits**  

* $170,000 \- $190,000 per year full\-time salary.
* 401(k), health, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending account, paid time off, parental leave.
* Schedule: 12\-hour shift, Monday \- Saturday. This job is not for the weak of heart.
* In person, Van Nuys or Los Angeles, CA. Relocation package available.

new_jobs.description:
**RETHINK MANUFACTURING**  



The only way to ignite change is to build the best team. At Bright Machines®, we’re innovators and experts in our craft who have joined together to manufacture the AI and data center infrastructure at the edge. We believe unifying software, intelligent automation, and data is the answer to delivering quality and flexibility at scale. We deliver products to meet the demands of today while continuously investing in our Bright Factory model to take advantage of what comes next.



Working with us means you’ll have the opportunity to make lasting, impactful changes for our company and our customers. If you’re ready to apply your exceptional skills to a brighter way of manufacturing AI infrastructure, we’d love to speak with you.

  


ABOUT THE ROLE

At Bright Machines, we are transforming the future of manufacturing with intelligent, software\-driven automation. Our applications help designers create products that are optimized for automated assembly, making factories more efficient and effective.

As a Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate scalable, secure infrastructure while driving monitoring, alerting, CI/CD pipelines, and developer experience tooling that accelerate development and automation of complex, mission\-critical industrial manufacturing applications. Working closely with the Platform Engineering team, R\&D, and Operations, you will play a key role in shaping and maintaining the core platform that powers our automation solutions.

Our technology stack includes on\-prem compute and networking, AWS and Azure cloud, Terraform (IaC), ArgoCD, Kubernetes (self\-hosted and managed), GitLab and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with R\&D teams designing \& building software\-defined automation solutions for modern factories. Our integrated solution consists of both on\-prem infrastructure like full network stack (with switches, routers, firewalling) and Cloud\-native software applications running on\-prem and in the Cloud to operate and monitor the robotic assembly lines.
### **WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

* Design, implement, and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure to support applications and automation systems.
* Own and continuously improve platform engineering tools and services, including documentation and cross\-team communication.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment pipelines.
* Manage CI/CD systems to enable efficient and reliable delivery of software.
* Implement and operate observability solutions (logging, monitoring, alerting) to ensure uptime and system performance.
* Enforce security best practices, including vulnerability management and incident response readiness.
* Participate in the on\-call rotation for services owned by the Platform Engineering team.

### **WHAT WE WANT TO SEE**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field
* At least 5\+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
* Strong experience with physical infrastructure, including networking equipment and servers.
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools and GitOps workflows.
* Hands\-on coding experience in Python and Shell scripting.
* Solid understanding of Linux internals and system administration.
* Experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, Ansible).
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes (self\-hosted and managed), including Helm.
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

### **IT WOULD BE NICE IF YOU HAD**

* Experience with bare\-metal provisioning (MaaS or similar)

**BE EMPOWERED TO CHANGE AN INDUSTRY**

  

Bright Machines is a next\-generation, AI\-enabled manufacturer focused on data center infrastructure production. Bright Machines uses its proprietary AI\-based robotics and software to assemble AI infrastructure hardware products (i.e., data center servers) for hyperscalers, neoclouds, and leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) to reduce their time to revenue. With its Bright Factory model, Bright Machines builds higher quality data center infrastructure at scale, addresses increasing market demands for computing power due to the surge of AI, and answers the call to the U.S. national mandate to reshore manufacturing.  

  

Bright Machines is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with an integration center in Guadalajara, Mexico. The company has been recognized as one of Forbes’ AI 50, awarded “Best AI\-based Solution for Manufacturing” by AI Breakthrough, named a “Technology Pioneer” by the World Economic Forum, and highlighted by several other leading technology and innovation organizations.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
new_jobs.description:
**Payabli** is the Intelligent Fintech Operating System for software platforms. If you are a software company, you are a fintech company, and Payabli is your operating system. Built by payments industry and SaaS veterans and powered by its own models, Payabli gives platforms everything they need to embed, manage, and monetize financial services through a single developer\-friendly API spanning Pay In, Pay Out, and Pay Ops. Intelligence is not a layer on top, it is the foundation, expressed through Amigo, Payabli's native AI Agent Suite, and a growing set of capabilities that make payment operations smarter and more autonomous.




**Payabli** gives software companies PayFac capabilities without the heavy lift, administrative burden, or cost of becoming a payment facilitator themselves. With PayFac\-as\-a\-Service, embedded payment acceptance and issuance, and intelligent payment operations, platforms turn payments into a meaningful revenue stream while staying focused on their core product.

**Payabli** is backed by world\-class fintech investors including QED Investors, Fika Ventures, TTV Capital, and Bling Capital, and was recently named to the Forbes Fintech 50\.


For more information, visit payabli.com.


**About the Role**


As a Senior Software Engineer, Platform at Payabli, you'll own the infrastructure and developer experience that every engineer at the company builds on top of. You won't be handed a task list—you'll define the vision for how we build, test, deploy, and operate our platform on AWS, then execute against it. From CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code to local development and Cloud/Agent development environments, you'll be the person who makes every other engineer faster, safer, and more productive.


This is a high\-ownership role. We're looking for someone who sees a gap, builds a plan, and drives it forward—not someone who waits to be told what's next.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Own the infrastructure.** Design, build, and operate Payabli's cloud infrastructure. You'll make the architectural decisions around networking, compute, storage, and security that determine how our platform scales, performs, and stays resilient as transaction volume grows.

**Build the deployment backbone.** Own and evolve our CI/CD pipelines end\-to\-end. Every push to production should be fast, safe, and repeatable. You'll design the release process that lets engineers ship with confidence—automated testing, staged rollouts, rollback strategies, and deployment observability baked in.

**Make local development exceptional.** Engineers should be able to clone a repo and be productive in minutes, not days. You'll own the local development experience and make sure it mirrors production closely enough to catch real problems early.

**Enable AI\-assisted development.** As the team adopts AI coding agents and assistants, you'll build the environments that let engineers leverage these tools safely and effectively within a PCI\-compliant infrastructure.

**Define and drive the platform roadmap.** Assess where we are, define where we need to be, and build the plan to get there. You'll partner with engineering leadership to prioritize infrastructure investments and communicate the "why" behind them.

**Harden everything.** Infrastructure in payments means PCI\-DSS scoping, network segmentation, secrets management, access controls, and audit trails are your daily work. You'll ensure our infrastructure posture keeps pace with compliance requirements as we scale.

**Instrument and observe.** Build the monitoring, alerting, and observability stack that gives the team real\-time visibility into system health. When something goes wrong at 2 AM, the infrastructure should tell us what happened before we have to ask.

**Multiply the team.** Document patterns, write runbooks, and establish infrastructure standards that make the entire engineering organization more self\-sufficient. The best platform engineering is invisible—things just work.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Your skills and trajectory matter more than checking every box.

**5\+ years of professional infrastructure or platform engineering experience.** You've built and operated production AWS environments that serve real traffic at scale—not just spun up sandbox accounts.

**Deep AWS expertise.** You think natively in AWS services (ECS/EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudFormation/CDK/Terraform) and understand the trade\-offs between them. You've made architectural bets and lived with the consequences.

**Strong CI/CD experience.** You've designed and maintained deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) that teams actually trust and rely on. You understand the difference between a pipeline that exists and one that accelerates the business.

**Infrastructure\-as\-code fluency.** You define infrastructure declaratively, version it, review it, and deploy it the same way you would application code.

**Security\-minded by default.** You understand network segmentation, least\-privilege access, secrets management, and encryption at rest and in transit—especially in environments handling financial data.

**Proactive and opinionated.** You don't wait for someone to file a ticket. You see what's broken or missing, propose a path forward, and drive it. You bring a point of view about how infrastructure should work and can back it up.

**Strong communicator.** You can translate infrastructure decisions into business impact for engineering leadership, and explain complex systems clearly to engineers who aren't infrastructure specialists.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* Prior experience in fintech, payments, or a PCI\-DSS\-regulated environment. You know how compliance requirements shape infrastructure decisions.
* Experience supporting or enabling AI/ML development

The ideal candidate combines strong C\# software engineering skills with experience in architecture, testing, code review, requirements clarification, database\-backed applications, and hardware\-adjacent integration. **About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. In this role, you will lead our Data Initiative team. You have the opportunity to have the influence across the entire Google Global Infrastructure (GGI) organization. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and Process Innovation (PI) to join the Digital Planning (DP) Team. This role combines hands\-on MES development and operation with process innovation initiatives aimed at optimizing manufacturing efficiency. Strong performers in this role will be considered for advancement to the Software Application Lead track.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Factory IT Systems Ownership**

* Serve as the primary IT technical owner for an assigned factory, covering MES, infrastructure, and production systems.
* Monitor system health and proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure 24/7 production continuity.
* Respond to on\-site emergencies based on own judgment or upon direction from the Team Lead.
* Oversee and verify hardware/software readiness for IT equipment deployments; supervise preparation and installation activities.

**MES Development \& Operation**

* Design, develop, and implement MES functions to optimize manufacturing processes and improve production efficiency.
* Integrate MES with enterprise systems (ERP, PLCs, AMR, AGV, OHT, mobile robots) to ensure seamless data flow and process automation.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting for MES applications; maintain system reliability and performance.
* Design and develop transportation logic for logistics automation.

**Process Innovation (PI)**

* Identify and implement process improvement and innovation opportunities within manufacturing operations.
* Utilize big data from production, process, quality, and equipment sources to analyze defects, predict failures, and optimize processes through real\-time data analysis.
* Develop and implement Smart Factory solutions aligned with business objectives.

**Collaboration \& Documentation**

* Work closely with cross\-functional teams (Production, Engineering, Quality, IT) to align MES and PI initiatives with business goals.
* Lead and manage MES/PI projects, ensuring timely delivery within scope and budget.
* Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end\-users.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation for MES processes and systems.
* Monitor system performance, user feedback, and industry trends to continuously improve solutions.
* Perform routine (daily, monthly, etc.) system checklists and submit reports.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 8\+ years of experience in MES solution development and operation.
* Experience in automation within high\-tech industries such as solar or semiconductors.

**Language**

* Korean fluency required; working\-level English proficiency (reading, written communication).

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in MES software (e.g., Miracom MESPlus, LG CNS EzMES, ThiraUtech OpenMES, Wonderware, Siemens SIMATIC IT, Rockwell FactoryTalk).
* Strong understanding of equipment communication protocols (SEMI standard, OPC, PLC).
* Strong knowledge and experience in developing and designing manufacturing processes and platforms.
* Proficiency in Java\-based application development (front\-end and back\-end).
* Advanced database skills including query analysis, performance tuning, and stored procedure development (Oracle, MS\-SQL).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to analyze complex data and develop actionable insights.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders.

Overview:
**Job Purpose**


We are on a mission as a team. We are problem solvers and partners, always starting with our customers to solve their challenges and create opportunities. Our start\-up roots keep us nimble, flexible, and moving fast. We take ownership and make decisions. We all work for one company and work together to drive growth across the business. We engage in robust debates to find the best path, and then we move forward as one team. We take pride in what we do, acting with integrity and passion, so that our customers can perform better. We are experts and enthusiasts \- combining ever\-expanding knowledge with leading technology to consistently deliver results, solutions and opportunities for our customers and stakeholders. Every day we work toward transforming global markets.

  

The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for creating and maintaining availability and high\-performance in mixed Linux and Windows development, non\-production, and production environments. This individual works as part of a results\-oriented, service\-delivery team and assists in configuration analysts, release engineers, developers, and operations teams. Additionally, the Senior Systems Engineer performs root cause analysis of problems, selects, and implements automation tools, and actively participates in deep technical discourse. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of system tuning and fault\-tolerant design principles as used in high\-performance, low\-latency computing workloads.

 **Responsibilities**

* Assist in the design, planning and implementation of server solutions, ensuring maximum performance and reliability
* Automate manual tasks using scripting and application development
* Investigate and adopt new technologies/tools as needs arise
* Respond to and assist in production operations in a 24/7 environment
* Work efficiently in a fast\-paced environment and handle priorities effectively
* Ensure meticulous attention to detail and maintain excellent organizational skills
* Evaluate, test, and integrate new operating system versions, drivers, and patches
* Provide technical analysis, resolve problems, and propose solutions
* Lead and execute internal infrastructure initiatives including patching, refreshes, upgrades, and decommissions
* Provide support to, and coordinate with, developers, operations staff, release engineers, and end\-users
* Collaborate effectively with team members to achieve project goals and maintain system integrity
* Educate and mentor team members and operations staff
* Participate in a weekly on\-call rotation for after\-hours support

 **Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in engineering discipline or equivalent experience in Systems Engineering
* 5\+ years of experience with Linux operating systems (RedHat variants preferred)
* Experience with automation/configuration management using either Puppet, Ansible, Chef, or equivalent
* Familiarity with git, foreman, Jenkins, or equivalent tooling
* Demonstrable knowledge of multi\-tiered, highly available, and resilient application design
* Working knowledge of horizontal and vertical scaling for performance and high availability
* Ability to specify hardware requirements and make recommendations based on application needs
* Demonstrable experience leveraging AI tooling to improve work quality and efficiency
* Thorough understanding of core system security \& hardening concepts and processes
* Top\-tier analytics and problem solving
* Ability to work in a service\-oriented team environment
* Excellent project management, organization, and time management skills
* Customer\-focused, and dedicated to the best possible user experience
* Communicate effectively with both technical and business resources

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience building and supporting bare\-metal enterprise servers such as HPE, DELL, IBM, etc.
* Experience with server virtualization technologies (VMWare, Proxmox, etc)
* Familiarity and experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Tanzu, etc)
* Experience with Linux systems networking protocols and configuration (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, InfiniBand, etc.)
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining low\-latency computing ecosystems

 **Responsibilities**

* Own and deliver platform features and enhancements, driving work from design through deployment and documentation

* Collaborate with KPE\-Infrastructure and KPE\-Enablement sub\-teams on cluster lifecycle events, upgrades, and cross\-cutting platform concerns

 **Knowledge and Experience**

* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes in a production environment; OpenShift experience strongly preferred

* Strong communication skills. This team writes documentation and communicates changes to a broad consumer base

The Senior Systems engineer is responsible for logical and systematic transformation of customer requirements and needs into a total system solution using the best of practice processes and techniques. ### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you want to work on cutting\-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! WAG\-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.

* Using experience with lab equipment, assess and exploit circuity, processors, and memory chips and implement methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry

* Interface with DoD Anti\-Tamper Evaluation Teams to evaluate current designs and identify vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to foreign and adversary exploitation

If you are interested in supporting and working with our Air Force and other military branches and a dedicated Serco team, then submit your application now for immediate consideration. It only takes a few minutes!

  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. new_jobs.title: Advanced Product Development & Integration Engineer - Embedded Systems & Autonomy
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


SPiDRWORX is looking for a hands\-on Embedded Systems \& Autonomy Engineer to join our Advanced Product Development \& Integration team developing multi\-domain unmanned systems (UxS) across air, ground, and maritime environments. The team rapidly evaluates emerging technologies, builds new capabilities, and transitions successful concepts toward fielded products for defense customers.


In this role, you will work where hardware meets software and where software meets decision\-making: bringing up embedded electronics, developing and modifying firmware, integrating vehicle\-control stacks and onboard computers, and building or integrating the autonomy behaviors, navigation, and mission\-planning software that let unmanned systems operate with reduced human oversight — including in GPS\-denied or communications\-degraded environments. You will work closely with electrical, mechanical, RF/datalink, autonomy, test, and manufacturing engineers and will support bench and field testing across multiple vehicle domains.


This role is a strong fit for an engineer who is equally comfortable with a logic analyzer, a code editor, and an autonomy stack; enjoys debugging complex hardware/software interactions; and wants to see their code making real decisions on real vehicles in the field.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Research \& Embedded Architecture**

* Evaluate microcontrollers, compute platforms, sensors, autopilots, software frameworks, and partner technologies through hands\-on testing and rapid prototyping.
* Build proof\-of\-concept integrations to validate new capabilities and customer requirements before full development.
* Support architecture and trade studies considering compute performance, latency, size, weight, power, cost, software maturity, and integration risk.

**Firmware Development \& Hardware Bring\-Up**

* Develop and maintain C/C\+\+ firmware for vehicle controllers, payload electronics, motor\-control interfaces, and custom embedded boards.
* Work in bare\-metal and RTOS environments on microcontrollers such as ARM Cortex\-M/STM32\.
* Bring up new hardware, including power and clock validation, boot configuration, peripheral setup, communications interfaces, and low\-level drivers.
* Develop and integrate drivers for sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GNSS/INS, cameras, gimbals, rangefinders, radar, and LiDAR.

**Vehicle Software \& Compute Integration**

* Configure, modify, and extend vehicle\-control software such as Betaflight, ArduPilot, and PX4 for FPV, multirotor, fixed\-wing, ground, and maritime platforms.
* Integrate embedded Linux computers, including NVIDIA Jetson and similar edge\-compute platforms, with vehicle controllers, cameras, sensors, payloads, and autonomy applications.
* Develop system interfaces using MAVLink, ROS 2, DroneCAN, uORB, or custom messaging and APIs.
* Integrate third\-party sensors, payloads, and customer\-requested capabilities at the firmware and vehicle\-software layers.
* Integrate autonomy stacks and behavior\-execution frameworks (e.g., ROS 2 nodes, behavior trees, or custom mission\-planning software) with vehicle controllers and onboard compute.

**Autonomy Software \& Behaviors**

* Develop and integrate autonomy software for navigation, path/motion planning, obstacle avoidance, and mission execution across single\- and multi\-vehicle scenarios.
* Implement or integrate state estimation and sensor fusion (EKF/UKF, GNSS/INS, visual\-inertial odometry) to support reliable navigation in GPS\-denied or degraded environments.
* Support multi\-agent/swarm coordination behaviors, including task allocation, formation control, and collaborative mission planning across teamed unmanned systems.
* Combine classical autonomy techniques with machine\-learning components (e.g., perception, reinforcement learning) to improve robustness and adaptability of vehicle behaviors.
* Build and maintain simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments to develop, regression\-test, and verify autonomy behaviors before field deployment.
* Analyze flight/mission logs to diagnose autonomy failures, tune behavior parameters, and drive continuous improvement of planning and decision\-making software.

**Networking, Video \& Datalink Interfaces**

* Develop and integrate software/network interfaces for command and control, telemetry, video, and data services over vehicle datalinks.
* Troubleshoot latency, packet loss, connectivity, addressing, routing, streaming, and application\-level link behavior.
* Partner with RF/datalink and electrical engineers on radio integration while owning the embedded software, network, and protocol interfaces.

**Verification, Troubleshooting \& Productization**

* Build and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop and software\-in\-the\-loop test environments where practical.
* Support bench, flight, ground, and on\-water testing, including test preparation, log review, data analysis, and post\-test troubleshooting.
* Debug issues that cross firmware, operating systems, networking, and hardware, particularly failures that appear only under real\-world conditions.
* Develop Python scripts and engineering tools for testing, log analysis, automation, and manufacturing support.
* Support firmware releases, configuration control, code/design reviews, manufacturing test tools, customer demonstrations, and field test events.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2\+ years of embedded development experience on physical hardware, preferably for unmanned systems, robotics, aerospace, marine, automotive, or defense applications.
* Strong programming skills in C and C\+\+.
* Experience with ARM Cortex\-M/STM32 or similar microcontrollers and bare\-metal or RTOS development such as FreeRTOS, ChibiOS, NuttX, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience with embedded interfaces

This is an on\-site position that offers flexibility to work from home 2–3 days per week, depending on project needs.


**Job Summary**



The Principal Electrical Engineer will provide technical leadership for the design and development of in\-seat power supplies and USB outlet units for commercial aircraft. You will lead the electrical design based on functional requirements, guide the engineering team through product certification, and drive technology innovation through targeted R\&D activities.



This role requires extensive knowledge of power conversion technologies—including resonant converter topologies and digitally controlled power supplies—along with strong leadership, mentoring, and presentation skills. You will independently apply a high degree of creative ability, engineering skill, and judgment to solve complex problems and move programs to successful completion.


**Role Objectives**



* Design power supplies and outlet units that meet defined functional and certification requirements.


* Produce high\-quality electrical design documentation to support development, test, and certification.


* Perform electrical simulations and trade studies to optimize designs for performance, reliability, and cost.


* Lead the electrical technical team to achieve successful product certification to DO\-160, Airbus, and Boeing requirements.


* Conduct R\&D activities and evaluate emerging power conversion technologies for potential integration into future products.


* Diagnose and resolve development hardware failures, implementing robust corrective design changes.

**Minimum Qualifications**

new_jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls Engineer 2 - Nuclear
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

This role offers a hybrid work arrangement. You'll spend three days a week in the office, giving you the flexibility to work remotely for two days.

  

Nuclear Power is a carbon\-free energy source. Our nuclear power generation clients are digitizing their existing power plants and building new nuclear power plants, small modular reactors (SMR) due to the increasing demand for electric power. This is expanding our work in the Instrumentation and Controls Engineering group. Due to this influx of work, Sargent \& Lundy has a need for additional I\&C Engineers.

  

We offer you the opportunity to utilize and expand your academic background in engineering by digitizing nuclear power plants:

* Work on a multi\-discipline engineering team involved in nuclear power plant Instrumentation and Controls projects. These projects are a synergistic integration of electrical, computer and mechanical engineering along with control theory.
* Work with electronic process sensors, digital controllers, network topology, touchscreen displays, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, steam turbines and reactors.
* Prepare specifications for the procurement of instrumentation and control equipment as well as engineering calculations.
* Through mentoring, classroom\-style technical sessions, and on\-the\-job training, you will increase your knowledge and skills in your engineering discipline.
* Travel to client and vendor offices for design reviews and to plant site locations for project coordination and field verification of designs.


Qualifications:
**We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.*** A BS or MS degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (from an ABET accredited program) with a strong academic background and coursework in analog and digital control systems is required
* A minimum of 1 year of engineering experience or a MS degree.
* Coursework in mechatronics is desired, but not required
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


Technology \& Innovation:

Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.
  

  

We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology\-assisted tools.
  

  

Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.
